```ts
        items: page.items.map((row) => toSummary(row.refund, row.supplier, sourceOf(row))),
        nextCursor: page.nextCursor,
      };
    });
  }

  get(id: string): Promise<SupplierRefund> {
    return this.withTenant((tx) => this.read(tx, id));
  }

  async create(input: SupplierRefundInput): Promise<SupplierRefund> {
    try {
      return await this.withTenant(async (tx) => {
        const supplier = await assertSupplier(tx, input.supplierId);
        await assertBranch(tx, input.branchId, 'purchase_branch_invalid');
        await assertMoneyAccount(tx, input.accountId, 'supplier_refund_account_invalid');
        // Locked: a second refund of the same money, or applying it to a bill, waits for us
        const source = await this.lockSource(tx, supplier.id, input);
        if (compareMoney(input.amount, unappliedOf(source)) > 0) throw overSourceError();
        const number = await this.numbering.next(tx, 'purchase.refund', input.date);
        // Saved = posted: the trigger adds the amount to the source's `refunded` (migration 0042)
        const [row] = await tx
          .insert(supplierRefunds)
          .values({
            tenantId: getTenantId(),
            number,
            date: input.date,
            supplierId: supplier.id,
            amount: input.amount,
            accountId: input.accountId,
            method: input.method,
            reference: input.reference,
            branchId: input.branchId,
            note: input.note,
            debitNoteId: input.debitNoteId,
            paymentId: input.paymentId,
            createdBy: currentPrincipal().userId,
            updatedBy: currentPrincipal().userId,
          })
          .returning();
        if (!row) throw new Error('Supplier refund insert returned no row');
        // The journal checks the period of the date: a refund in a closed month is refused here
        const entry = await this.books.refund(
          tx,
          { id: row.id, number, date: row.date },
          {
            supplierId: supplier.id,
            branchId: row.branchId,
            accountId: row.accountId,
            amount: row.amount,
          },
        );
        await audit(tx, {
          action: 'supplier_refund.created',
          entityType: 'supplier_refund',
          entityId: row.id,
          changes: created({
            number,
            date: row.date,
            supplier: supplier.code,
            amount: row.amount,
            method: row.method,
            source: source.number,
            entry: entry.number,
          }),
        });
        return this.read(tx, row.id);
      });
    } catch (error) {
      throw overSourceRace(error);
    }
  }

  // A refund typed by mistake, or a cheque from the supplier that bounced: its entry is reversed
  // on the void date, and its money is the source's again (the trigger takes it off `refunded`).
  // The refund stays, voided, so its number is never reused or missing.
  void(id: string, input: VoidSupplierRefundInput): Promise<SupplierRefund> {
    return this.withTenant(async (tx) => {
      const row = await this.lock(tx, id, input.version);
      if (input.date < row.date) {
        throw new AppError(
          409,
          'payment_void_date',
          'A refund cannot be voided before the day it was received.',
          { fieldErrors: { date: ['payment_void_date'] } },
        );
      }
      const entry = await this.books.entryOf(tx, id, 'purchase_refund');
      if (entry === null) throw new Error(`Supplier refund ${id} has no entry`);
      await tx
        .update(supplierRefunds)
        .set({
          status: 'voided',
          voidDate: input.date,
          voidReason: input.reason,
          version: sql`${supplierRefunds.version} + 1`,
          updatedBy: currentPrincipal().userId,
        })
        .where(and(eq(supplierRefunds.tenantId, getTenantId()), eq(supplierRefunds.id, id)));
      const reversal = await this.books.reverse(tx, entry, {
        date: input.date,
        narration: `Supplier refund ${row.number} voided: ${input.reason}`,
      });
      await audit(tx, {
        action: 'supplier_refund.voided',
        entityType: 'supplier_refund',
        entityId: id,
        changes: created({ date: input.date, reason: input.reason, reversal: reversal.number }),
      });
      return this.read(tx, id);
    });
  }

  // The debit note or payment the money comes from: posted, and this supplier's. FOR UPDATE, the
  // lock its own page takes to apply its money (and a payment's void), so they all take turns.
  // Another workspace's, another supplier's, a voided payment and a draft debit note all get the
  // same answer, under the box that named it.
  private async lockSource(
    tx: Transaction,
    supplierId: string,
    input: Pick<SupplierRefundInput, 'debitNoteId' | 'paymentId'>,
  ): Promise<Source> {
    const tenantId = getTenantId();
    const invalid = (field: 'debitNoteId' | 'paymentId') =>
      new AppError(
        409,
        'supplier_refund_source_invalid',
        'Pick a posted debit note or supplier payment of this supplier.',
        { fieldErrors: { [field]: ['supplier_refund_source_invalid'] } },
      );
    if (input.debitNoteId !== null) {
      const [row] = await tx
        .select()
        .from(debitNotes)
        .where(and(eq(debitNotes.tenantId, tenantId), eq(debitNotes.id, input.debitNoteId)))
        .for('update');
      if (row?.supplierId !== supplierId || row.status !== 'posted' || row.number === null) {
        throw invalid('debitNoteId');
      }
      return { ...row, number: row.number, amount: row.total };
    }
    if (input.paymentId !== null) {
      const [row] = await tx
        .select()
        .from(supplierPayments)
        .where(
          and(eq(supplierPayments.tenantId, tenantId), eq(supplierPayments.id, input.paymentId)),
        )
        .for('update');
      if (row?.supplierId !== supplierId || row.status !== 'posted' || row.number === null) {
        throw invalid('paymentId');
      }
      return { ...row, number: row.number };
    }
    // The contract makes sure one of the two is there (supplier_refund_source)
    throw new AppError(
      409,
      'supplier_refund_source',
      'Pick the debit note or payment the money comes back from.',
      { fieldErrors: { debitNoteId: ['supplier_refund_source'] } },
    );
  }

  // FOR UPDATE: two voids of one refund take turns. A voided refund is final.
  private async lock(tx: Transaction, id: string, version: number): Promise<RefundRow> {
    const [row] = await tx
      .select()
      .from(supplierRefunds)
      .where(and(eq(supplierRefunds.tenantId, getTenantId()), eq(supplierRefunds.id, id)))
      .for('update');
    if (!row) throw notFound('Supplier refund');
    if (row.status === 'voided') {
      throw new AppError(
        409,
        'supplier_refund_voided',
        'This refund is voided and cannot be changed.',
      );
    }
    if (row.version !== version) throw versionConflict();
    return row;
  }

  private rows(tx: Transaction, where: SQL | undefined, limit: number) {
    return tx
      .select({
        refund: supplierRefunds,
        supplier: { id: parties.id, code: parties.code, name: parties.name },
        paymentNumber: sourcePayment.number,
        debitNoteNumber: sourceDebitNote.number,
      })
      .from(supplierRefunds)
      .innerJoin(
        parties,
        and(
          eq(parties.tenantId, supplierRefunds.tenantId),
          eq(parties.id, supplierRefunds.supplierId),
        ),
      )
      .leftJoin(
        sourcePayment,
        and(
          eq(sourcePayment.tenantId, supplierRefunds.tenantId),
          eq(sourcePayment.id, supplierRefunds.paymentId),
        ),
      )
      .leftJoin(
        sourceDebitNote,
        and(
          eq(sourceDebitNote.tenantId, supplierRefunds.tenantId),
          eq(sourceDebitNote.id, supplierRefunds.debitNoteId),
        ),
      )
      .where(and(eq(supplierRefunds.tenantId, getTenantId()), where))
      .orderBy(desc(supplierRefunds.date), desc(supplierRefunds.id))
      .limit(limit);
  }

  private async read(tx: Transaction, id: string): Promise<SupplierRefund> {
    const [found] = await this.rows(tx, eq(supplierRefunds.id, id), 1);
    if (!found) throw notFound('Supplier refund');
    const { refund: row } = found;
    const entry = await this.books.entryOf(tx, id, 'purchase_refund');
    if (entry === null) throw new Error(`Supplier refund ${id} has no entry`);
    const voidEntry = row.status === 'voided' ? await this.books.reversalOf(tx, entry.id) : null;
    return {
      ...toSummary(row, found.supplier, sourceOf(found)),
      note: row.note,
      entry,
      voidEntry,
      voidDate: row.voidDate,
      voidReason: row.voidReason,
    };
  }
}

// Where a refund's money came from. supplier_refunds_source_check keeps exactly one of the two
// ids, and a refund is only made from a posted debit note or payment, which always has a number:
// anything else is a broken row.
function sourceOf(row: {
  refund: RefundRow;
  paymentNumber: string | null;
  debitNoteNumber: string | null;
}): SupplierRefundSource {
  if (row.refund.debitNoteId !== null && row.debitNoteNumber !== null) {
    return { type: 'debit_note', id: row.refund.debitNoteId, number: row.debitNoteNumber };
  }
  if (row.refund.paymentId !== null && row.paymentNumber !== null) {
    return { type: 'supplier_payment', id: row.refund.paymentId, number: row.paymentNumber };
  }
  throw new Error(`Supplier refund ${row.refund.id} has no source`);
}
```

- **15d's refund with the purchase names.** One source, locked `FOR UPDATE` (the lock its own page takes to apply
  money, and a payment's void), saved = posted, and a void that reverses the entry and gives the money back to its
  source through the trigger.
- **The void uses the payment's codes** (`payment_void_date`), because its form is the payment's (17d.1).

### The controllers and the module

```ts
import { Controller } from '@nestjs/common';
import { type RouteInput, type RouteResponse, routes } from '@omnivo/contracts';

import { Endpoint } from '../common/http/endpoint.js';
import { DebitNotesService } from './debit-notes.service.js';
import { PurchaseReturnsService } from './purchase-returns.service.js';
import { SupplierRefundsService } from './supplier-refunds.service.js';

type ReturnRoutes = typeof routes.purchaseReturns;
type DebitNoteRoutes = typeof routes.debitNotes;
type RefundRoutes = typeof routes.supplierRefunds;

// Step 17d. Each method only moves the route's parts into the service. The permissions are in the
// contract's routes: purchase.return.manage, purchase.debit_note.manage and purchase.refund.manage,
// none for reading.
@Controller()
export class PurchaseReturnsController {
  constructor(private readonly returns: PurchaseReturnsService) {}

  @Endpoint(routes.purchaseReturns.list)
  list({ query }: RouteInput<ReturnRoutes['list']>): Promise<RouteResponse<ReturnRoutes['list']>> {
    return this.returns.list(query);
  }

  @Endpoint(routes.purchaseReturns.get)
  get({ params }: RouteInput<ReturnRoutes['get']>): Promise<RouteResponse<ReturnRoutes['get']>> {
    return this.returns.get(params.id);
  }

  @Endpoint(routes.purchaseReturns.create)
  create({
    body,
  }: RouteInput<ReturnRoutes['create']>): Promise<RouteResponse<ReturnRoutes['create']>> {
    return this.returns.create(body);
  }

  @Endpoint(routes.purchaseReturns.update)
  update({
    params,
    body,
  }: RouteInput<ReturnRoutes['update']>): Promise<RouteResponse<ReturnRoutes['update']>> {
    return this.returns.update(params.id, body);
  }

  @Endpoint(routes.purchaseReturns.remove)
  remove({ params, query }: RouteInput<ReturnRoutes['remove']>): Promise<void> {
    return this.returns.remove(params.id, query.version);
  }

  @Endpoint(routes.purchaseReturns.post)
  post({
    params,
    body,
  }: RouteInput<ReturnRoutes['post']>): Promise<RouteResponse<ReturnRoutes['post']>> {
    return this.returns.post(params.id, body.version);
  }
}

export class SupplierRefundsController {
```

- A supplier with a return, a debit note or a refund cannot be deleted (`supplier_in_use`), and a money account a
  refund came into cannot either (`account_in_use`): their history must keep them. Both are archived instead.

### Check this part

```bash
pnpm --filter @omnivo/contracts build
pnpm --filter @omnivo/db build
pnpm --filter @omnivo/api typecheck
pnpm --filter @omnivo/api test
npx eslint apps/api/src
```

The API type-checks, ESLint finds nothing in it, and its unit tests pass (107, among them the route test, which now
finds a controller for every return, debit note and refund route). The repo-wide `pnpm lint` still stops while it
builds `@omnivo/i18n`: the error texts for 17d.1's codes come in 17d.5. The app and the mock do not type-check yet
either: they learn the new words in 17d.5 and the screens in 17d.6.

> **What we checked.** The type checker, the linter and the unit tests above. Because this part changes 17b's goods
> receipts and 17c's bills and payments, their existing integration tests were run on a real database too: bills,
> goods receipts, supplier payments and purchase orders (60), all pass. The new documents' own tests come in 17d.4.

## 17d.4 — `apps/api`: the tests

This part adds two test files, both in `apps/api/src/purchase/`. Like every integration test since step 5, they run
against a real Postgres and the real worker:

- `purchase-returns.int.spec.ts` follows a garments factory's store and accounts desk through what goes back to the
  suppliers: torn twill sent back before the bill and after it, zippers sent back in three goes, poly bags that leave
  at what the stock still holds, hangers from before Omnivo debited with no bill, a motor debited after its bill was
  paid and its money paid back, a whole bill debited in one click, three races, and a last check that the books add
  up.
- `purchase-returns.tenant-leak.int.spec.ts`: workspace A must never see, change, post, apply or void anything of
  workspace B's, nor send back B's goods, debit B's bills or pay back from B's money.

They are also the first time 17d's code ran against a real database. **They found no bug in the 17d.3 code**: every
amount, every error code and every lock behaved as 17d.3 says. Two "break it on purpose" checks made sure the tests
would have noticed: working out each go of a return on its own (not over everything sent back so far) fails the
zippers test by a paisa and the books test with it, and posting a return without locking its receipt lines fails the
race test. One older test changes, at the end of this part: the number series list has the three new series.

### `purchase/purchase-returns.int.spec.ts` (new): the setup

```ts
function send(
  method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'DELETE',
  url: string,
  payload?: object,
  as = owner,
) {
  return app.inject({
    method,
    url,
    headers: bearer(as.accessToken),
    ...(payload && { payload }),
  });
}

function problemOf(res: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof send>>) {
  return problemSchema.parse(res.json());
}

function unitId(code: string): string {
  const found = units.find((unit) => unit.code === code);
  if (!found) throw new Error(`no unit ${code}`);
  return found.id;
}

function rateId(name: string): string {
  const found = rates.find((rate) => rate.name === name);
  if (!found) throw new Error(`no VAT rate ${name}`);
  return found.id;
}

function accountId(code: string): string {
  const found = accounts.find((item) => item.code === code);
  if (!found) throw new Error(`no account ${code}`);
  return found.id;
}

function codeOf(id: string | null): string | null {
  if (id === null) return null;
  const found = accounts.find((item) => item.id === id);
  if (!found) throw new Error(`no account ${id}`);
  return found.code;
}

function variantOf(product: Product): string {
  const [variant] = product.variants;
  if (!variant) throw new Error(`${product.name} has no variant`);
  return variant.id;
}

function orderLineOf(order: PurchaseOrder, product: Product): string {
  const found = order.lines.find((line) => line.variantId === variantOf(product));
  if (!found) throw new Error(`no ${product.name} on ${order.number ?? 'the order'}`);
  return found.id;
}

function receiptLineOf(receipt: GoodsReceipt, product: Product) {
  const found = receipt.lines.find((line) => line.variantId === variantOf(product));
  if (!found) throw new Error(`no ${product.name} on ${receipt.number ?? 'the receipt'}`);
  return found;
}

// The bill line of a product; with a receipt, the one that bills that receipt's line
function billLineOf(bill: Bill, product: Product, receipt?: GoodsReceipt): string {
  const found = bill.lines.find(
    (line) =>
      line.variantId === variantOf(product) &&
      (receipt === undefined || line.receiptLineId === receiptLineOf(receipt, product).id),
  );
  if (!found) throw new Error(`no ${product.name} on ${bill.number ?? 'the bill'}`);
  return found.id;
}

function returnLineOf(back: PurchaseReturn, product: Product): string {
  const found = back.lines.find((line) => line.variantId === variantOf(product));
  if (!found) throw new Error(`no ${product.name} on ${back.number ?? 'the return'}`);
  return found.id;
}

      { id: null, sku: '', optionValues: [], barcode: '', salePrice: '', archived: false },
    ],

    ...extra,
  } satisfies ProductFormValues);
  expect(res.statusCode, res.body).toBe(201);

}

async function addRole(name: string, permissions: PermissionKey[]): Promise<Role> {
  const made = await send('POST', '/roles', { name, description: '' });
  expect(made.statusCode, made.body).toBe(201);
  const role = roleSchema.parse(made.json());
  const matrix = await send('PUT', '/permission-matrix', {
    roles: [{ id: role.id, version: role.version, permissions }],

  return role;

// A user who signs up for a workspace of their own, then joins this one with one role
async function member(
  email: string,
  fullName: string,
  password: string,
  role: Role,
): Promise<SignedIn> {
  await signUp(app, {
    companyName: `${fullName} Trading`,
    workspaceSlug: email.split('@')[0] ?? 'trading',
    fullName,
    email,
    password,
  });
  await joinWithoutRoles(pg.superuserUrl, { email, workspace: 'padma-apparel' });
  const { items } = memberPageSchema.parse((await send('GET', '/members?limit=50')).json());
  const found = items.find((item) => item.email === email);
  if (!found) throw new Error(`${email} is not a member`);
  const assigned = await send('PUT', `/members/${found.membershipId}/roles`, {
    roleIds: [role.id],
    version: found.version,
  });
  expect(assigned.statusCode, assigned.body).toBe(200);
  return logIn(app, { workspace: 'padma-apparel', email, password, keepSignedIn: false });
}

// Written and submitted by the Owner: with no order levels, approved at once
async function approvedOrder(
  supplier: Supplier,
  lines: PurchaseOrderLineFormValues[],
  paymentTermsDays = 30,
): Promise<PurchaseOrder> {
  const made = await send('POST', '/purchase-orders', {
    supplierId: supplier.id,
    date: '2026-10-12',
    expectedDate: '',
    warehouseId: main.id,
    supplierReference: '',
    paymentTermsDays,
    pricesIncludeVat: false,
    note: '',
    lines,
  });
  expect(made.statusCode, made.body).toBe(201);
  const draft = purchaseOrderSchema.parse(made.json());
  const res = await send('POST', `/purchase-orders/${draft.id}/submit`, {
    version: draft.version,

  expect(order.status).toBe('approved');
  return order;
}

  const res = await send('POST', '/purchase-returns', body, as);
  expect(res.statusCode, res.body).toBe(201);
  return purchaseReturnSchema.parse(res.json());
}

// As the Owner reads it: with the values the store keeper does not see
async function returnNow(id: string): Promise<PurchaseReturn> {
  const res = await send('GET', `/purchase-returns/${id}`);
  expect(res.statusCode, res.body).toBe(200);
  return purchaseReturnSchema.parse(res.json());
}

// A debit note line of a bill line: its quantity in the bill line's unit, a price per that unit
function debitLine(
  billLineId: string,
  unitId: string,
  quantity: string,
  unitPrice: string,
  extra: Partial<DebitNoteLineFormValues> = {},
): DebitNoteLineFormValues {
  return {
    billLineId,
    returnLineId: '',
    taxRateId: '',
    unitId,
    quantity,
    description: '',
    unitPrice,
    discountType: 'percent',
    discount: '',
    ...extra,
  };
}

function debitForm(
  supplier: Supplier,
  bill: Bill | null,
  lines: DebitNoteLineFormValues[],
  extra: Partial<DebitNoteFormValues> = {},
): Omit<DebitNoteFormValues, 'version'> {
  return {
    supplierId: supplier.id,
    billId: bill?.id ?? '',
    date: '2026-10-17',
    branchId: '',
    pricesIncludeVat: false,
    reason: 'goods_returned',
    supplierCreditNumber: '',
    supplierCreditDate: '',
    note: '',
    lines,
    expenses: [],
    post: true,
    ...extra,
  };
}

async function debited(body: object, as = shirin): Promise<DebitNote> {
  const res = await send('POST', '/debit-notes', body, as);
  expect(res.statusCode, res.body).toBe(201);
  return debitNoteSchema.parse(res.json());
}

async function debitNoteNow(id: string): Promise<DebitNote> {
  const res = await send('GET', `/debit-notes/${id}`);
  expect(res.statusCode, res.body).toBe(200);
  return debitNoteSchema.parse(res.json());
}

function refundForm(
  supplier: Supplier,
  amount: string,
  source: { debitNoteId?: string; paymentId?: string },
  extra: Partial<SupplierRefundFormValues> = {},
): SupplierRefundFormValues {
  return {
    supplierId: supplier.id,
    date: '2026-10-18',
    amount,
    accountId: accountId('1121'),
    method: 'bank_transfer',
    reference: '',
    branchId: main.branchId,
    note: '',
    debitNoteId: source.debitNoteId ?? '',
    paymentId: source.paymentId ?? '',
    ...extra,

}

async function refunded(body: object, as = shirin): Promise<SupplierRefund> {

async function paymentNow(id: string): Promise<SupplierPayment> {
  const res = await send('GET', `/supplier-payments/${id}`);
  expect(res.statusCode, res.body).toBe(200);
  return supplierPaymentSchema.parse(res.json());
}

// A supplier payment the accountant posts at once (no payment levels): to bills, or an advance
async function paid(
  supplier: Supplier,
  amount: string,
  allocations: { billId: string; amount: string }[],
): Promise<SupplierPayment> {
  const res = await send(
    'POST',
    '/supplier-payments',
    {
      supplierId: supplier.id,
      date: '2026-10-17',
      amount,
      accountId: accountId('1121'),
      method: 'bank_transfer',
      reference: '',
      supplierBankAccountId: '',
      branchId: main.branchId,
      orderId: '',
      note: '',
      allocations,
      submit: true,
    },
    shirin,
  );
  expect(res.statusCode, res.body).toBe(201);
  const payment = supplierPaymentSchema.parse(res.json());
  expect(payment.status).toBe('posted');
  return payment;
}

async function superuserSql<T>(fn: (sql: postgres.Sql) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const sql = postgres(pg.superuserUrl, { max: 1, onnotice: () => undefined });
  try {
    return await fn(sql);
  } finally {
    await sql.end();
  }
}

// A journal entry as [account code, debit, credit, branch code] rows, sorted: summed per account
// and branch, the entry's own order is not the point
async function entryLines(id: string | undefined) {
  const entry = journalEntrySchema.parse(
    (await send('GET', `/journal-entries/${id ?? 'none'}`)).json(),
  );
  return entry.lines
    .map((item) => [
      codeOf(item.accountId),
      item.debit,
      item.credit,
      item.branchId === ashulia.branchId ? 'ASH' : 'HO',
    ])
    .toSorted(
      (a, b) =>
        String(a[0]).localeCompare(String(b[0])) || String(a[3]).localeCompare(String(b[3])),
    );
}

// The stock card's count and value, in every warehouse
async function stockOf(product: Product) {
  const card = stockCardSchema.parse(
    (await send('GET', `/stock/variants/${variantOf(product)}`)).json(),
  );
  return [card.item.onHand, card.item.value];
}

// The bill form's "Add from goods receipts" list for a supplier: [number, bill state]
async function toBill(supplier: Supplier) {
  const page = goodsReceiptPageSchema.parse(
    (await send('GET', `/goods-receipts?bill=to_bill&supplierId=${supplier.id}`)).json(),
  );
  return page.items.map((item) => [item.number, item.billState]);
}
```

- **One workspace, one story** (Padma Apparels). The returns, bills and debit notes count up across the file, and
  the last test adds up the books of all of them. When a test fails, read the first failure first.
- **Four people, each for one rule.** Rafiq is the Owner: his orders are approved when he submits them, and he is the
  one who sees what the stock is worth (`inventory.stock.value`). Jamal, the store keeper, receives goods and sends
  them back (`purchase.return.manage`), and moves no money. Shirin, the accountant, books the bills, the debit notes,
  the payments and the money back. Rina, from the buying house, has a role with no permission at all: she can read
  every list and page, and is the 403 for every write.
- **No approval levels.** A bill or a payment Shirin submits is posted at once, so every test starts from posted
  documents (17c's approvals have their own tests).
- **Two stores of two branches** (main and Ashulia), so a debit note is seen clearing goods received not billed at the
  receipt's branch, not the bill's (decision 22).
- **Seven products, each for one rule:** twill by the metre; buttons and zippers by the piece, bought by the box of
  144 (a return or a debit note in another unit than the receipt's); poly bags, partly from before Omnivo, for
  decision 32; hangers, all from before Omnivo, for a line on its own; serial-numbered motors (one from before
  Omnivo, so a serial number in the store that did not come on the receipt line exists); and care labels that were
  never in stock, so they have no cost.
- **Opening stock** is a step 13 adjustment "in" on 1 October, with its cost: that is how goods from before Omnivo
  get an average cost.
- **The bank account 1121** is added first: a refund comes into a money account, and the template's banks group is
  empty.
- **`fromReceipt()` fills a line the way "Add from goods receipts" does:** the receipt line and the item, in the base
  unit unless the test names a pack. `returnLine()` is a line on its own.
- **`receiptBillLine()` takes the quantity:** a bill bills what the receipt line kept, so the test says how much
  that is.
- **`debitLine()` names a bill line**, with no item and no VAT rate: both are the bill line's. A line of a debit note
  without a bill passes `billLineId: ''`, a `returnLineId` and a `taxRateId` instead.
- **`entryLines()` sorts the entry's lines and names the branch** (`HO` or `ASH`), like 17c's tests.
- **`stockOf()` reads the stock card's count and value** across every warehouse (the Owner sees the value).
- **`superuserSql()`** reads the journal for the last test, which adds up an account per branch: no report groups by
  branch and account at once.

### Purchase returns

```ts
describe('purchase returns', () => {
  it('sends goods back before the bill, at what they came in at, and the order expects them again', async () => {
    expect((await orderNow(orderA.id)).status).toBe('received');
    // 50 m of the main store's twill is torn: the store keeper loads it back on the mill's truck
    firstReturn = await returned(
      returnForm(mill, [fromReceipt(grn1, twill, '50')], { note: 'Torn at the fold' }),
    );
    expect(firstReturn).toMatchObject({
      number: 'PRN-2026-27-0001',
      status: 'posted',
      receipts: [{ id: grn1.id, number: 'GRN-2026-27-0001' }],
      debitNotes: [],
    });
    // Not billed yet: nothing to debit. The store keeper does not see what it was worth.
    expect(firstReturn.lines[0]).toMatchObject({
      receiptLineId: receiptLineOf(grn1, twill).id,
      receiptNumber: 'GRN-2026-27-0001',
      billed: false,
      billLineId: null,
      debitedQuantity: '0.0000',
      value: null,
    });
    // 50 m at the receipt's ৳312.50: Dr Goods received not billed / Cr Inventory
    expect((await returnNow(firstReturn.id)).lines[0]?.value).toBe('15625.0000');
    expect(await entryLines(firstReturn.entry?.id)).toEqual([
      ['1154', '0.0000', '15625.0000', 'HO'],
      ['2115', '15625.0000', '0.0000', 'HO'],
    ]);
    const entry = journalEntrySchema.parse(
      (await send('GET', `/journal-entries/${firstReturn.entry?.id ?? ''}`)).json(),
    );
    expect(entry).toMatchObject({
      source: 'purchase_return',
      narration: 'Purchase return PRN-2026-27-0001',
    });

    const receipt = await receiptNow(grn1.id);
    expect(receipt.returnState).toBe('partly_returned');
    expect(receipt.returns).toEqual([{ id: firstReturn.id, number: 'PRN-2026-27-0001' }]);
    expect(receiptLineOf(receipt, twill).returnedQuantity).toBe('50.0000');
    // The order counts the 50 m as not received (decision 3): the mill can send them again
    const order = await orderNow(orderA.id);
    expect(order.status).toBe('approved');
    expect(order.version).toBe(orderA.version + 3);
    expect(order.lines.map((line) => line.receivedQuantity)).toEqual(['950.0000', '1440.0000']);
    expect(await stockOf(twill)).toEqual(['950.0000', '296875.0000']);

    // It does: the order is received again
    const again = await received(orderA, main, [{ product: twill, quantity: '50' }], '2026-10-16');
    expect(again.number).toBe('GRN-2026-27-0004');
    expect((await orderNow(orderA.id)).status).toBe('received');
    expect(await toBill(mill)).toEqual([
      ['GRN-2026-27-0004', 'not_billed'],
      ['GRN-2026-27-0002', 'not_billed'],
      ['GRN-2026-27-0001', 'not_billed'],
    ]);
  });

  it('bills what was kept, and a return after the bill points at its bill line', async () => {
    // The bill bills what the receipt line kept: 550 m, not the 600 m that came in
    const twice = await send(
      'POST',
      '/bills',
      billForm(mill, [receiptBillLine(grn1, twill, '600', '315')], {
        supplierBillNumber: 'NWM/2026/1187',
      }),
      shirin,
    );
    expect(problemOf(twice).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      'lines.0.quantity': ['bill_receipt_line_quantity'],
    });
    bill1 = await billed(
      billForm(
        mill,
        [
          receiptBillLine(grn1, twill, '550', '315'),
          receiptBillLine(grn1, buttons, '10', '150'),
          receiptBillLine(grn2, twill, '400', '312.50'),
        ],
        {
          supplierBillNumber: 'NWM/2026/1187',
          expenses: [expense('5240', 'Truck rent from the mill', '3000')],
        },
      ),
    );
    // ৳1,73,250 + ৳1,500 + ৳1,25,000 + ৳3,000, and 15% VAT
    expect([bill1.number, bill1.status, bill1.net, bill1.vat, bill1.total]).toEqual([
      'BILL-2026-27-0001',
      'posted',
      '302750.0000',
      '45412.5000',
      '348162.5000',
    ]);
    // The receipt's value less what went back: ৳1,71,875 for the 550 m
    expect(bill1.lines[0]?.orderValue).toBe('171875.0000');

    // After the bill: 30 m more is torn, and a box of buttons has the wrong shade
    billedReturn = await returned(
      returnForm(
        mill,
        [
          fromReceipt(grn1, twill, '30'),
          fromReceipt(grn1, buttons, '1', { unitId: unitId('box') }),
        ],
        { date: '2026-10-16', reason: 'wrong_item' },
      ),
    );
    expect(billedReturn.number).toBe('PRN-2026-27-0002');
    expect(
      billedReturn.lines.map((line) => [line.billed, line.billLineId, line.billNumber]),
    ).toEqual([
      [true, billLineOf(bill1, twill, grn1), 'BILL-2026-27-0001'],
      [true, billLineOf(bill1, buttons), 'BILL-2026-27-0001'],
    ]);
    // 30 m at ৳312.50 and 144 buttons of 1,440 that came in at ৳1,500
    expect((await returnNow(billedReturn.id)).lines.map((line) => line.value)).toEqual([
      '9375.0000',
      '150.0000',
    ]);
    expect(await entryLines(billedReturn.entry?.id)).toEqual([
      ['1154', '0.0000', '9525.0000', 'HO'],
      ['2115', '9525.0000', '0.0000', 'HO'],
    ]);
    // Billed already: the order and the receipt's billing stay as they are; a debit note takes the
    // money off
    const order = await orderNow(orderA.id);
    expect([order.status, order.lines.map((line) => line.receivedQuantity)]).toEqual([
      'received',
      ['1000.0000', '1440.0000'],
    ]);
    const receipt = await receiptNow(grn1.id);
    expect([receipt.billState, receipt.returnState]).toEqual(['billed', 'partly_returned']);
    expect(receipt.lines.map((line) => line.returnedQuantity)).toEqual(['80.0000', '144.0000']);
  });

  it('refuses goods that did not come in on that receipt line, each under its own box', async () => {
    // The form's own rules: a receipt line's goods go back in its own batch, and once per return
    const form = await send(
      'POST',
      '/purchase-returns',
      returnForm(mill, [
        fromReceipt(grn1, twill, '1', { batchId: grn1.id }),
        fromReceipt(grn1, twill, '1'),
      ]),
      jamal,
    );
    expect(form.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(problemOf(form).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      'lines.0.batchId': ['purchase_return_batch_not_allowed'],
      'lines.1.receiptLineId': ['purchase_return_line_twice'],
    });
    // The parts centre's receipt line on the mill's return; buttons on the twill's line
    const foreign = await send(
      'POST',
      '/purchase-returns',
      returnForm(mill, [
        fromReceipt(grn3, motors, '1', { serialNumbers: ['JK-55001'] }),
        returnLine(buttons, '1', { receiptLineId: receiptLineOf(grn1, twill).id }),
      ]),
      jamal,
    );
    expect(foreign.statusCode).toBe(409);
    expect(problemOf(foreign).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      'lines.0.receiptLineId': ['purchase_return_receipt_line_invalid'],
      'lines.1.receiptLineId': ['purchase_return_receipt_line_invalid'],
    });
    // More than the line kept (600 − 80 = 520 m); labels never had a cost to leave at
    const more = await send(
      'POST',
      '/purchase-returns',
      returnForm(mill, [fromReceipt(grn1, twill, '521'), returnLine(labels, '1')]),
      jamal,
    );
    expect(problemOf(more).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      'lines.0.quantity': ['purchase_return_over_received'],
      'lines.1.variantId': ['purchase_return_cost_unknown'],
    });
    // JK-40001 is in the store, but it came before Omnivo, not on this receipt line
    const serial = await send(
      'POST',
      '/purchase-returns',
      returnForm(parts, [fromReceipt(grn3, motors, '1', { serialNumbers: ['JK-40001'] })]),
      jamal,
    );
    expect(problemOf(serial).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      'lines.0.serialNumbers': ['purchase_return_serial_invalid'],
    });
    // JK-55002 did: it goes back before the bill
    const motor = await returned(
      returnForm(parts, [fromReceipt(grn3, motors, '1', { serialNumbers: ['JK-55002'] })], {
        reason: 'damaged',
        note: 'Hums and overheats',
      }),
    );
    expect(motor.lines[0]?.serialNumbers).toEqual(['JK-55002']);
    expect(motor.lines[0]?.billed).toBe(false);
    expect((await returnNow(motor.id)).lines[0]?.value).toBe('18000.0000');
  });

  it("gives a receipt line's value back to the paisa, however many goes it takes", async () => {
    // 3 boxes of zippers at ৳1,000: 432 pieces for ৳3,000, ৳6.9444… each. Each go is worth its
    // share to the paisa.
    const order = await approvedOrder(trims, [
      orderLine(zippers, '3', '1000', { unitId: unitId('box') }),
    ]);
    const receipt = await received(order, main, [{ product: zippers, quantity: '3', unit: 'box' }]);
    const values: (string | null | undefined)[] = [];
    for (const quantity of ['100', '100', '232']) {
      const back = await returned(returnForm(trims, [fromReceipt(receipt, zippers, quantity)]));
      values.push((await returnNow(back.id)).lines[0]?.value);
    }
    // Each go is worked out over everything back so far: no paisa is lost or made by rounding
    expect(values).toEqual(['694.4400', '694.4500', '1611.1100']);
    expect(await stockOf(zippers)).toEqual(['0.0000', '0.0000']);
    const after = await receiptNow(receipt.id);
    expect([after.returnState, after.billState]).toEqual(['returned', 'not_billed']);
    // Nothing left on it to bill, and the order expects all of it again
    expect(await toBill(trims)).toEqual([]);
    const now = await orderNow(order.id);
    expect([now.status, now.lines[0]?.receivedQuantity]).toEqual(['approved', '0.0000']);
  });

  it('leaves at what the stock still holds, and books the difference (decision 32)', async () => {
    // 100 bags at ৳2 from before Omnivo and 100 at ৳3 from the receipt: 200 bags worth ৳500.
    // 100 are written off at the average, ৳250. The receipt's 100 go back: they came in at ৳300,
    // but the stock holds ৳250 for its last 100 bags.
    const order = await approvedOrder(packaging, [orderLine(polyBags, '100', '3')]);
    const receipt = await received(order, main, [{ product: polyBags, quantity: '100' }]);
    await adjusted('out', [{ product: polyBags, quantity: '100' }], '2026-10-15');
    expect(await stockOf(polyBags)).toEqual(['100.0000', '250.0000']);
    const back = await returned(
      returnForm(packaging, [fromReceipt(receipt, polyBags, '100')], { date: '2026-10-16' }),
    );
    // Goods received not billed gets the receipt's ৳300 back, so the bill or debit note can clear
    // it; the stock gives its ৳250; the ৳50 is a price difference
    expect((await returnNow(back.id)).lines[0]?.value).toBe('300.0000');
    expect(await entryLines(back.entry?.id)).toEqual([
      ['1154', '0.0000', '250.0000', 'HO'],
      ['2115', '300.0000', '0.0000', 'HO'],
      ['5180', '0.0000', '50.0000', 'HO'],
    ]);
    expect(await stockOf(polyBags)).toEqual(['0.0000', '0.0000']);
  });

  it('sends back goods from before Omnivo at the average cost', async () => {
    ownReturn = await returned(
      returnForm(packaging, [returnLine(hangers, '40')], { reason: 'damaged' }),
    );
    expect(ownReturn.lines[0]).toMatchObject({
      receiptLineId: null,
      receiptNumber: null,
      billed: false,
    });
    expect(ownReturn.receipts).toEqual([]);
    expect((await returnNow(ownReturn.id)).lines[0]?.value).toBe('240.0000');
    expect(await entryLines(ownReturn.entry?.id)).toEqual([
      ['1154', '0.0000', '240.0000', 'HO'],
      ['2115', '240.0000', '0.0000', 'HO'],
    ]);
  });

  it('keeps drafts free, and checks them again when they are posted', async () => {
    // Two drafts for Ashulia's twill, each fine on its own: a draft holds nothing
    const draft = (quantity: string) =>
      returned(
        returnForm(mill, [fromReceipt(grn2, twill, quantity)], {
          warehouseId: ashulia.id,
          post: false,
        }),
      );
    const first = await draft('250');
    const second = await draft('250');
    expect([first.number, first.status, first.entry]).toEqual([null, 'draft', null]);
    const posted = await send(
      'POST',
      `/purchase-returns/${first.id}/post`,
      { version: first.version },
      jamal,
    );
    expect(posted.statusCode, posted.body).toBe(200);
    // Ashulia's goods put their cost back at Ashulia, where the receipt booked it
    const firstNow = purchaseReturnSchema.parse(posted.json());
    ashuliaReturn = firstNow;
    expect(await entryLines(firstNow.entry?.id)).toEqual([
      ['1154', '0.0000', '78125.0000', 'ASH'],
      ['2115', '78125.0000', '0.0000', 'ASH'],
    ]);
    // 150 m are left on the line: the second draft is checked again, and stays a draft
    const late = await send(
      'POST',
      `/purchase-returns/${second.id}/post`,
      { version: second.version },
      jamal,
    );
    expect(late.statusCode).toBe(409);
    expect(problemOf(late).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      'lines.0.quantity': ['purchase_return_over_received'],
    });
    expect((await returnNow(second.id)).status).toBe('draft');
    // A stale version, a posted return changed, and a draft deleted
    const stale = await send(
      'PUT',
      `/purchase-returns/${second.id}`,
      {
        ...returnForm(mill, [fromReceipt(grn2, twill, '100')], { warehouseId: ashulia.id }),
        version: second.version + 1,
      },
      jamal,
    );
    expect(problemOf(stale).code).toBe('version_conflict');
    const changed = await send(
      'PUT',
      `/purchase-returns/${first.id}`,
      { ...returnForm(mill, [fromReceipt(grn2, twill, '1')]), version: firstNow.version },
      jamal,
    );
    expect(problemOf(changed).code).toBe('stock_not_draft');
    const removed = await send(
      'DELETE',
      `/purchase-returns/${second.id}?version=${String(second.version)}`,
      undefined,
      jamal,
    );
    expect(removed.statusCode).toBe(204);
    expect((await send('GET', `/purchase-returns/${second.id}`)).statusCode).toBe(404);
    const drafts = purchaseReturnPageSchema.parse(
      (await send('GET', '/purchase-returns?status=draft')).json(),
    );
    expect(drafts.items).toEqual([]);
    const ashuliaReturns = purchaseReturnPageSchema.parse(
      (await send('GET', `/purchase-returns?warehouseId=${ashulia.id}`)).json(),
    );
    expect(ashuliaReturns.items.map((item) => item.number)).toEqual([firstNow.number]);
  });

  it('leaves a closed order closed', async () => {
    const order = await approvedOrder(trims, [
      orderLine(buttons, '20', '150', { unitId: unitId('box') }),
    ]);
    const receipt = await received(order, main, [{ product: buttons, quantity: '5', unit: 'box' }]);
    const before = await orderNow(order.id);
    const closed = await send('POST', `/purchase-orders/${order.id}/close`, {
      version: before.version,
    });
    expect(closed.statusCode, closed.body).toBe(200);
    const closedOrder = purchaseOrderSchema.parse(closed.json());
    await returned(
      returnForm(trims, [fromReceipt(receipt, buttons, '1', { unitId: unitId('box') })]),
    );
    // The line counts what is kept, but nobody reopens a closed order by sending goods back
    const now = await orderNow(order.id);
    expect([now.status, now.version, now.lines[0]?.receivedQuantity]).toEqual([
      'closed',
      closedOrder.version,
      '576.0000',
    ]);
  });
});
```

- **Before the bill** (decision 3): 50 m of torn twill leaves at the receipt's ৳312.50 (Dr Goods received not billed
  / Cr Inventory, ৳15,625). Jamal does not see the value; Rafiq does. The receipt line counts 50 m returned, the
  receipt is "partly returned", and the order goes back from Received to Approved (partly received) with 950 m
  received. The mill sends 50 m again on the same order, and the order is Received again.
- **The bill bills what was kept:** 600 m on the 600 m line is now `bill_receipt_line_quantity`; 550 m is right. The
  line's `orderValue` is the receipt's value less what went back (৳1,71,875).
- **After the bill:** 30 m of twill and a box of buttons go back. Each line points at the bill line that billed it
  (`billed`, `billLineId`, `billNumber`), and nothing on the order or the receipt's billing changes: a debit note
  takes the money off.
- **The refusals, each under its own box:** first the contract's (a batch on a receipt line, the same receipt line
  twice), then the server's (another supplier's receipt line, another item's, more than the line kept, an item with
  no cost, a serial number that is in the store but came before Omnivo). The last one is why the setup has motor
  JK-40001.
- **To the paisa:** 432 zippers came in at ৳3,000. Sent back 100, 100 and 232, each go is worked out over everything
  sent back so far (৳694.44, ৳694.45, ৳1,611.11): together exactly ৳3,000, and the stock is worth ৳0 at 0 pieces.
  The receipt is "returned", the bill form no longer offers it, and the order expects all 432 again.
- **Decision 32:** 100 poly bags at ৳2 from before Omnivo and 100 at ৳3 from a receipt; 100 are written off at the
  average (৳250). When the receipt's 100 go back, they are the last of the stock, which holds ৳250. Goods received
  not billed still gets the receipt's ৳300; the stock gives ৳250; the ৳50 is credited to the purchase price
  difference. The stock ends at 0 pieces worth ৳0.
- **A line on its own** (40 hangers) leaves at the average ৳6 and has no receipt, no bill and nothing to debit yet.
- **Drafts hold nothing:** two drafts of 250 m from Ashulia's 400 m line are both saved. The first posts, at
  Ashulia's branch (where the receipt booked the goods). The second is checked again when it is posted, refused under
  its quantity, and stays a draft. Then a stale version, a posted return that cannot change, and a deleted draft.
- **A closed order stays closed:** its line counts 576 received (5 boxes less 1), but its status and version do not
  move.

### Debit notes

```ts
describe('debit notes', () => {
  it('takes the money off for goods that went back after the bill', async () => {

        ],

      ),
    );
    // ৳9,450 + ৳150, and 15% VAT. The mill billed the twill at ৳315: ৳75 more than it came in at.
    expect(note).toMatchObject({

      [bill1.id, '11040.0000'],
    ]);
    // Dr Accounts payable / Cr Goods received not billed (the goods' receipt cost) / Cr Purchase
    // price difference (what the bill charged above it) / Cr Input VAT. GRNI for them is now zero.
    expect(await entryLines(note.entry?.id)).toEqual([
      ['1170', '0.0000', '1440.0000', 'HO'],
      ['2110', '11040.0000', '0.0000', 'HO'],

    expect([bill.amountDebited, bill.debitNoteTotal, bill.version]).toEqual([

    ]);
    expect(bill.lines.map((line) => line.debited)).toEqual(['10867.5000', '172.5000', '0.0000']);
    // A posted debit note exists: "Debit whole bill" would take off more than is left
    expect(canDebitWhole(bill)).toBe(false);
    const back = await returnNow(billedReturn.id);
    expect(back.lines.map((line) => line.debitedQuantity)).toEqual(['30.0000', '144.0000']);
    expect(back.debitNotes).toEqual([{ id: note.id, number: 'DN-2026-27-0001' }]);
    const list = debitNotePageSchema.parse(

    );
    expect(list.items.map((item) => item.number)).toEqual(['DN-2026-27-0001']);
  });

  it('refuses what the bill did not bill, each under its own box', async () => {
    const twillLine = billLineOf(bill1, twill, grn1);
    // The form's own rules: a bill line brings its VAT rate; a Mushak date needs its number;
    // something must come off
    const form = await send(
      'POST',

    expect(form.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(problemOf(form).fieldErrors).toEqual({

    expect(problemOf(empty).fieldErrors).toEqual({ lines: ['purchase_lines_required'] });
    // Another supplier's bill; a day before the bill
    const supplier = await send(

    expect(problemOf(supplier).fieldErrors).toEqual({ billId: ['debit_note_bill_invalid'] });

    expect(problemOf(early).fieldErrors).toEqual({ date: ['debit_note_date'] });
    // A bill that is still a draft has nothing to take off yet

    const lines = await send(

  it('caps the money on each bill line and expense, under every line that takes from it', async () => {
    const ashuliaLine = billLineOf(bill1, twill, grn2);
    const truck = bill1.expenses[0]?.id ?? '';
    // Ashulia's line charged ৳1,25,000 + ৳18,750 VAT. Two cuts together come to ৳1,44,900.
    const over = await send(

    const foreign = await send(

    // What the mill agreed: ৳2.50 off each of Ashulia's 400 m, and ৳1,000 off the truck rent
    const cut = await debited(

  it("clears goods received not billed at the receipt's branch, below the receipt's cost too", async () => {

    const note = await debited(

  it('keeps what a paid bill no longer owes as money the supplier owes, and applies it later', async () => {

    const motorBill = await billed(

    await paid(parts, motorBill.total, [{ billId: motorBill.id, amount: motorBill.total }]);
    // Then JK-55001 fails too: it goes back, and the debit note finds nothing left to owe
    const back = await returned(

      ['2115', '0.0000', '18000.0000', 'HO'],
    ]);
    expect(billPaymentStatusOf(await billNow(motorBill.id))).toBe('paid');

    // The next bill shows the money the supplier owes, like an advance
    serviceBill = await billed(
      billForm(parts, [], {
        supplierBillNumber: 'JPC-0958',
        expenses: [expense('5270', 'Servicing of 12 lockstitch machines', '10000')],
      }),

    expect(serviceBill.openDebitNotes).toEqual([

        debitNoteId: motorNote.id,

        date: '2026-10-17',
        bill: { id: motorBill.id, number: motorBill.number },
        unapplied: '20700.0000',
      },
    ]);
    // Applied to a bill of another supplier, past what the bill owes, past what the note has
    const allocate = (allocations: { billId: string; amount: string }[], version: number) =>
      send('PUT', `/debit-notes/${motorNote.id}/allocations`, { version, allocations }, shirin);
    const foreign = await allocate([{ billId: bill1.id, amount: '100' }], motorNote.version);
    expect(problemOf(foreign).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      'allocations.0.billId': ['debit_note_allocation_invalid'],
    });
    const overBill = await allocate(
      [{ billId: serviceBill.id, amount: '11501' }],
      motorNote.version,
    );
    expect(problemOf(overBill).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      'allocations.0.amount': ['debit_note_over_bill'],
    });
    const overNote = await allocate(
      [
        { billId: serviceBill.id, amount: '11500' },
        { billId: motorBill.id, amount: '9201' },
      ],
      motorNote.version,
    );
    expect(problemOf(overNote).code).toBe('debit_note_over_allocated');
    const applied = await allocate([{ billId: serviceBill.id, amount: '5000' }], motorNote.version);
    expect(applied.statusCode, applied.body).toBe(200);
    motorNote = debitNoteSchema.parse(applied.json());
    expect(motorNote.applied).toBe('5000.0000');
    serviceBill = await billNow(serviceBill.id);
    expect([serviceBill.amountDebited, billPaymentStatusOf(serviceBill)]).toEqual([
      '5000.0000',
      'partly_paid',
    ]);
    // Applied money is not a debit of the bill: it was written for the motor's bill
    expect([serviceBill.debitNoteTotal, debitStateOf(serviceBill)]).toEqual(['0.0000', 'none']);
  });

  it('takes money off goods from before Omnivo, with no bill', async () => {
    // The form's own rules without a bill: a return line, a VAT rate, a branch, no expenses
    const form = await send(
      'POST',
      '/debit-notes',
      debitForm(packaging, null, [debitLine('', unitId('pcs'), '40', '6.50')], {
        expenses: [{ billExpenseId: bill1.expenses[0]?.id ?? '', amount: '1' }],
      }),
      shirin,
    );
    expect(form.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(problemOf(form).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      branchId: ['purchase_branch_invalid'],
      expenses: ['debit_note_expense_invalid'],
      'lines.0.returnLineId': ['debit_note_return_required'],
      'lines.0.taxRateId': ['tax_rate_invalid'],
    });
    // A return line of a receipt is debited on its bill; more than went back
    const lines = await send(
      'POST',
      '/debit-notes',
      debitForm(
        packaging,
        null,
        [
          debitLine('', unitId('m'), '1', '1', {
            returnLineId: returnLineOf(firstReturn, twill),
            taxRateId: rateId('VAT 15%'),
          }),
          debitLine('', unitId('pcs'), '41', '6.50', {
            returnLineId: returnLineOf(ownReturn, hangers),
            taxRateId: rateId('VAT 15%'),
          }),
        ],
        { branchId: main.branchId },
      ),
      shirin,
    );
    expect(problemOf(lines).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      'lines.0.returnLineId': ['debit_note_return_invalid'],
      'lines.1.quantity': ['debit_note_over_return'],
    });
    // The 40 hangers at the supplier's ৳6.50 a piece and 15% VAT
    const note = await debited(
      debitForm(
        packaging,
        null,
        [
          debitLine('', unitId('pcs'), '40', '6.50', {
            returnLineId: returnLineOf(ownReturn, hangers),
            taxRateId: rateId('VAT 15%'),
          }),
        ],
        { branchId: main.branchId },
      ),
    );
    expect(note).toMatchObject({
      bill: null,
      net: '260.0000',
      vat: '39.0000',
      total: '299.0000',
      applied: '0.0000',
    });
    expect(note.lines[0]).toMatchObject({ billLineId: null, returnNumber: ownReturn.number });
    // The ৳240 the return put on goods received not billed comes off; ৳20 above it is a difference
    expect(await entryLines(note.entry?.id)).toEqual([
      ['1170', '0.0000', '39.0000', 'HO'],
      ['2110', '299.0000', '0.0000', 'HO'],
      ['2115', '0.0000', '240.0000', 'HO'],
      ['5180', '0.0000', '20.0000', 'HO'],
    ]);
    expect((await returnNow(ownReturn.id)).debitNotes).toEqual([
      { id: note.id, number: note.number },
    ]);
  });

  it('lets two debit notes of one bill line take turns: the second finds less left', async () => {
    // The buttons line charged ৳1,725 and ৳172.50 came off: ৳1,552.50 is left. Two drafts of
    // ৳1,150 each fit alone, not together.
    const buttonLine = billLineOf(bill1, buttons);
    const draft = () =>
      debited(
        debitForm(mill, bill1, [debitLine(buttonLine, unitId('box'), '1', '1000')], {
          reason: 'price_adjustment',
          post: false,
        }),
      );
    const [a, b] = [await draft(), await draft()];
    const answers = await Promise.all(
      [a, b].map((note) =>
        send('POST', `/debit-notes/${note.id}/post`, { version: note.version }, shirin),
      ),
    );
    expect(answers.map((res) => res.statusCode).toSorted()).toEqual([200, 409]);
    const refused = answers.find((res) => res.statusCode === 409);
    expect(refused && problemOf(refused).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      'lines.0.unitPrice': ['debit_note_over_line'],
    });
    expect((await billNow(bill1.id)).lines[1]?.debited).toBe('1322.5000');
    // The one that lost is still a draft: lowered to ৳200 a box it fits, or it is deleted
    const loser = answers[0]?.statusCode === 409 ? a : b;
    const lowered = await send(
      'PUT',
      `/debit-notes/${loser.id}`,
      {
        ...debitForm(mill, bill1, [debitLine(buttonLine, unitId('box'), '1', '200')], {
          reason: 'price_adjustment',
          post: false,
        }),
        version: loser.version,
      },
      shirin,
    );
    expect(lowered.statusCode, lowered.body).toBe(200);
    const kept = debitNoteSchema.parse(lowered.json());
    expect([kept.status, kept.total, kept.version]).toEqual([
      'draft',
      '230.0000',
      loser.version + 1,
    ]);
    const removed = await send(
      'DELETE',
      `/debit-notes/${kept.id}?version=${String(kept.version)}`,
      undefined,
      shirin,
    );
    expect(removed.statusCode).toBe(204);
    expect((await send('GET', `/debit-notes/${kept.id}`)).statusCode).toBe(404);
  });
});
```

- **For goods that went back after the bill:** ৳9,450 + ৳150 + 15% VAT = ৳11,040, with the supplier's Mushak 6.7
  number. The entry: Dr Accounts payable ৳11,040 / Cr Goods received not billed ৳9,525 (what the return put there) /
  Cr Purchase price difference ৳75 (the mill billed the twill ৳2.50 above its receipt price) / Cr Input VAT ৳1,440.
  It is applied to its own bill at once (decision 4). The bill keeps its version (decision 31), shows the debit note,
  its lines show what was debited, and "Debit whole bill" is no longer offered.
- **The refusals:** the contract's (a VAT rate on a bill's line, a Mushak date with no number, nothing to take off),
  then the header's (another supplier's bill, a date before the bill, a bill that is still a draft), then line by
  line, all in one answer: a line of another bill, a return line this bill line did not bill, more than the line
  billed in another unit (1,441 buttons of 10 boxes), a unit that is not the item's, and more than went back less
  what was debited.
- **The money caps** (decision 20): two cuts that each fit, but not together, are refused under both lines; an
  expense more than it charged, and another kind of id, under the expense. What the mill agreed then posts: ৳2.50 off
  400 m and ৳1,000 off the truck rent. No goods went back, so the twill's part is all price difference, and the
  truck rent comes off the account it was charged to.
- **Below the receipt's cost, at the receipt's branch:** Ashulia's 250 m are debited at ৳310, ৳625 below what they
  came in at. Goods received not billed is cleared at Ashulia for the full ৳78,125, and the ৳625 is a debit to the
  price difference: the same rule, the other way.
- **Debit whole bill:** a bill bought over the counter with prices including VAT (7 boxes at ৳173.33 and a courier at
  ৳575, amounts that do not divide evenly). `wholeBillDebit()` makes the draft; posted, it takes off exactly the
  bill's net, VAT and total, every line and expense in full, and the bill is "Debited" and paid.
- **Money the supplier owes:** the parts centre's motor bill was paid in full before the second motor failed. Its
  debit note applies nothing (the bill owes nothing) and stays the supplier's debt to the company. The next bill
  lists it under `openDebitNotes`. Applying it is checked like a payment: another supplier's bill, past what the bill
  owes, past what the note has; then ৳5,000 goes on the servicing bill. Applied money is not a debit of that bill: its
  debit state stays "none".
- **Without a bill** (decision 9): the contract's rules (a return line, a VAT rate, a branch, no expenses), then a
  return line of a receipt (debited on its bill instead) and more than went back. The 40 hangers at ৳6.50 + VAT: Cr
  Goods received not billed ৳240 (what the return put there), Cr price difference ৳20, applied to nothing.
- **Two at once:** two drafts of ৳1,150 each on a buttons line with ৳1,552.50 left are posted together. The bill's
  lock makes them take turns: one posts, the other is refused under its price. The loser is still a draft, so it can
  be lowered or deleted.

### Supplier refunds

```ts
describe('supplier refunds', () => {

  it("records a debit note's money paid back, and gives it back when voided", async () => {

  it("pays back a payment's advance, and the payment cannot be voided while it is", async () => {

  it('pays back only from a posted source of the same supplier', async () => {

  it('lets two refunds of the last money take turns: the second finds nothing left', async () => {
    // After the void the motor's ৳15,700 is the supplier's to pay back again
    const answers = await Promise.all(
      [1, 2].map(() =>

```

- **From a debit note:** the parts centre pays the motor's last ৳15,700 into the bank (Dr bank / Cr Accounts
  payable). Nothing is left to pay back or to apply, and the servicing bill no longer lists the note. A void the day
  before is refused (`payment_void_date`); the void on the day reverses the entry and gives the money back to the
  note; a second void is refused.
- **From a payment's advance:** ৳20,000 of a ৳50,000 advance comes back. Only ৳30,000 can be applied now, and the
  payment cannot be voided while a refund takes money from it (`payment_has_refunds`): void the refund first.
- **Only a posted source of the same supplier:** neither or both sources (the contract), another supplier's debit
  note, a draft one.
- **Two at once:** two refunds of the same last ৳15,700. The source's lock makes them take turns; the second finds
  nothing left.

### Permissions, what they keep, the race, the books, the period lock

```ts
describe('who may do what', () => {
  it('lets anyone read returns, debit notes and refunds, and only the right people write them', async () => {
    for (const url of [
      '/purchase-returns',
      `/purchase-returns/${firstReturn.id}`,
      '/debit-notes',
      `/debit-notes/${motorNote.id}`,
      '/supplier-refunds',
    ]) {
      expect((await send('GET', url, undefined, rina)).statusCode, url).toBe(200);
    }
    const ownLine = returnLine(hangers, '1');
    const writes = [
      send('POST', '/purchase-returns', returnForm(packaging, [ownLine]), rina),
      send(
        'POST',
        '/debit-notes',
        debitForm(mill, bill1, [debitLine(billLineOf(bill1, buttons), unitId('box'), '1', '1')]),
        rina,
      ),
      send(
        'PUT',
        `/debit-notes/${motorNote.id}/allocations`,
        { version: 1, allocations: [] },
        rina,
      ),
      send(
        'POST',
        '/supplier-refunds',
        refundForm(parts, '1', { debitNoteId: motorNote.id }),
        rina,
      ),
    ];
    for (const res of await Promise.all(writes)) {
      expect(res.statusCode).toBe(403);
      expect(problemOf(res).code).toBe('permission_missing');
    }
    // The store keeper sends goods back and moves no money; the accountant the other way round
    const refused = await Promise.all([
      send(
        'POST',
        '/debit-notes',
        debitForm(mill, bill1, [debitLine(billLineOf(bill1, buttons), unitId('box'), '1', '1')]),
        jamal,
      ),
      send(
        'POST',
        '/supplier-refunds',
        refundForm(parts, '1', { debitNoteId: motorNote.id }),
        jamal,
      ),
      send('POST', '/purchase-returns', returnForm(packaging, [ownLine]), shirin),
    ]);
    expect(refused.map((res) => problemOf(res).params?.permissions)).toEqual([
      'purchase.debit_note.manage',
      'purchase.refund.manage',
      'purchase.return.manage',
    ]);
  });
});

describe('what returns, debit notes and refunds hold on to', () => {
  it('keeps a supplier and a money account that they name', async () => {
    const supplier = await send(
      'DELETE',
      `/suppliers/${packaging.id}?version=${String(packaging.version)}`,
    );
    expect(problemOf(supplier).code).toBe('supplier_in_use');
    // The bank the refunds came into
    const bank = accountSchema.parse((await send('GET', `/accounts/${accountId('1121')}`)).json());
    const removed = await send('DELETE', `/accounts/${bank.id}?version=${String(bank.version)}`);
    expect(problemOf(removed).code).toBe('account_in_use');
  });
});

describe('a return and a bill of one receipt line', () => {
  it('lets the second one see what the first did', async () => {
    const order = await approvedOrder(trims, [orderLine(zippers, '200', '7')]);
    const receipt = await received(order, main, [{ product: zippers, quantity: '200' }]);
    // The bill of all 200 first, the return of 20 while the bill is still posting. Holding the
    // receipt line's lock would not set their order: each has already taken a weak lock on the
    // line (the foreign key of its own lines), and Postgres lets a transaction that holds a lock on
    // a row skip the queue for it, so both would wake at once and either could win. So hold the
    // journal's number counter instead: the bill locks the receipt line, then waits to number its
    // entry; the return, sent then, waits for the bill on the receipt line. The bill posts, and the
    // return, which waited for it, finds the line billed and points at the bill line.
    const superuser = postgres(pg.superuserUrl, { max: 1 });
    // A second connection watches who waits: the first one is busy holding the lock
    const watcher = postgres(pg.superuserUrl, { max: 1 });
    // A bill does a lot before it reaches the counter, so a fixed pause is not enough: wait until
    // one request waits on a lock in a query on `table`. The table counts, not any lock: the
    // worker waits on locks of its own (advisory ones).
    const waitingOn = (table: string) =>
      eventually(async () => {
        const [row] = await watcher<{ n: number }[]>`
          SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM pg_stat_activity
           WHERE wait_event_type = 'Lock' AND query LIKE ${`%${table}%`}`;
        expect(row?.n).toBe(1);
      });
    let bill: ReturnType<typeof send> | undefined;
    let back: ReturnType<typeof send> | undefined;
    await superuser.begin(async (tx) => {
      // This database holds one workspace, so its journal counter is the only one
      await tx`SELECT last_value FROM number_series_counters
                WHERE document_type = 'accounting.journal' FOR UPDATE`;
      bill = send(
        'POST',
        '/bills',
        billForm(trims, [receiptBillLine(receipt, zippers, '200', '7')], {
          date: '2026-10-17',
          supplierBillNumber: 'KTA-7802',
        }),
        shirin,
      );
      await waitingOn('number_series_counters');
      back = send(
        'POST',
        '/purchase-returns',
        returnForm(trims, [fromReceipt(receipt, zippers, '20')], { date: '2026-10-17' }),
        jamal,
      );
      await waitingOn('goods_receipt_lines');
    });
    await Promise.all([superuser.end(), watcher.end()]);
    const [billedRes, came] = await Promise.all([bill, back]);
    if (!billedRes || !came) throw new Error('the requests were never sent');
    expect(billedRes.statusCode, billedRes.body).toBe(201);
    expect(came.statusCode, came.body).toBe(201);
    const posted = billSchema.parse(billedRes.json());
    expect(purchaseReturnSchema.parse(came.json()).lines[0]).toMatchObject({
      billed: true,
      billLineId: posted.lines[0]?.id,
    });
    // Billed first: the order keeps its 200 received
    expect((await orderNow(order.id)).lines[0]?.receivedQuantity).toBe('200.0000');
  });
});

describe('the books', () => {
  it('add up: goods received not billed is what no bill or debit note has cleared yet', async () => {
    const rows = await superuserSql(
      (sql) => sql<{ code: string; branch: string; balance: string }[]>`
        SELECT a.code, b.code AS branch, sum(l.debit - l.credit)::numeric(19, 4)::text AS balance
          FROM journal_lines l
          JOIN journal_entries e ON e.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND e.id = l.entry_id
          JOIN ledger_accounts a ON a.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND a.id = l.account_id
          JOIN branches b ON b.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND b.id = l.branch_id
         WHERE e.status = 'posted' AND a.code = '2115'
         GROUP BY a.code, b.code
         ORDER BY b.code`,
    );
    // Ashulia: received, billed, sent back, debited: nothing left. The main store: the 50 m that
    // came again and 4 boxes of buttons on the closed order are not billed (৳15,625 + ৳600), and
    // the 20 zippers that went back after their bill wait for a debit note (৳140).
    expect(rows.map((row) => [row.branch === 'ASH' ? 'ASH' : 'HO', row.balance])).toEqual([
      ['ASH', '0.0000'],
      ['HO', '-16085.0000'],
    ]);
    // The parts centre: the motor's bill, paid; its debit note, refunded (voided once); the
    // servicing bill less the ৳5,000 applied. The company owes ৳6,500.
    const [parts1] = await superuserSql(
      (sql) => sql<{ balance: string }[]>`
        SELECT sum(l.debit - l.credit)::numeric(19, 4)::text AS balance
          FROM journal_lines l
          JOIN journal_entries e ON e.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND e.id = l.entry_id
         WHERE e.status = 'posted' AND l.party_id = ${parts.id}`,
    );
    expect(parts1?.balance).toBe('-6500.0000');
    expect(billAmountDueOf(await billNow(serviceBill.id))).toBe('6500.0000');
  });
});

describe('the period lock', () => {
  it('refuses a return, a debit note or a refund on a day the books are closed', async () => {
    const lockedDay = '2026-10-18';
    const draftReturn = await returned(
      returnForm(packaging, [returnLine(hangers, '1')], { date: lockedDay, post: false }),
    );
    const draftNote = await debited(
      debitForm(mill, bill1, [debitLine(billLineOf(bill1, buttons), unitId('box'), '1', '1')], {
        date: lockedDay,
        reason: 'price_adjustment',
        post: false,
      }),
    );
    const lock = await send('PUT', '/period-lock', { lockDate: lockedDay, version: 0 });
    expect(lock.statusCode, lock.body).toBe(200);
    const postReturn = await send(
      'POST',
      `/purchase-returns/${draftReturn.id}/post`,
      { version: draftReturn.version },
      jamal,
    );
    expect(problemOf(postReturn).code).toBe('journal_period_locked');
    expect((await returnNow(draftReturn.id)).status).toBe('draft');
    const postNote = await send(
      'POST',
      `/debit-notes/${draftNote.id}/post`,
      { version: draftNote.version },
      shirin,
    );
    expect(problemOf(postNote).code).toBe('journal_period_locked');
    expect((await debitNoteNow(draftNote.id)).status).toBe('draft');
    const refund = await send(
      'POST',
      '/supplier-refunds',
      refundForm(mill, '1', { paymentId: advance.id }, { date: lockedDay }),
      shirin,
    );
    expect(problemOf(refund).code).toBe('journal_period_locked');
  });
});
```

- **Who may do what:** Rina reads every list and page and is refused every write with `permission_missing`. Jamal
  may not write a debit note or a refund; Shirin may not write a return. The error names the permission missing.
- **What they keep:** a supplier with returns cannot be deleted, nor the bank account a refund came into.
- **A return and a bill of one receipt line:** the test holds the journal's number counter itself, sends the bill,
  waits until the bill waits for the counter (it holds the receipt line's lock by then), then sends the return and
  waits until it waits for the bill on the receipt line. Released, the bill posts first, and the return, posted
  second, finds the line billed and points at the bill line. The test does not hold the receipt line itself:
  each of the two has already taken a weak lock on that line (the foreign key check of its own lines), and Postgres
  lets a transaction that holds a lock on a row skip the queue for it. Both would wake at once and either could
  win: both outcomes are right (a bill that comes second is refused under its quantity), but the test could not
  say which to expect, and it failed 3 runs in 6 (17d.8). Waiting on `pg_stat_activity` (not a fixed pause) matters
  too: a bill does much more than a return before it reaches the counter. Only waits in queries on the table named
  count: the worker waits on advisory locks of its own.
- **The books add up:** after everything above, goods received not billed is ৳0 at Ashulia, and at the main branch
  ৳16,085 credit: the 50 m that came again and 4 boxes on the closed order (৳15,625 + ৳600, not billed yet), less the
  ৳140 of zippers that went back after their bill and wait for a debit note. The parts centre's account is ৳6,500
  credit, which is exactly what the servicing bill still owes.
- **The period lock:** a return, a debit note and a refund dated on a locked day are refused with
  `journal_period_locked`, and the drafts stay drafts.

### `purchase/purchase-returns.tenant-leak.int.spec.ts` (new)

```ts
import type { INestApplicationContext } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { NestFastifyApplication } from '@nestjs/platform-fastify';
import {
  type Account,
  accountListSchema,
  type Bill,
  billSchema,
  type DebitNote,
  debitNotePageSchema,
  debitNoteSchema,
  type GoodsReceipt,
  goodsReceiptSchema,
  type Product,
  productSchema,
  problemSchema,
  purchaseOrderSchema,
  type PurchaseReturn,
  purchaseReturnPageSchema,
  purchaseReturnSchema,
  setupSchema,
  type Supplier,
  type SupplierPayment,
  supplierPaymentSchema,
  type SupplierRefund,
  supplierRefundPageSchema,
  supplierRefundSchema,
  supplierSchema,
  type TaxRate,
  taxRateListSchema,
  type Unit,
  unitListSchema,
  type Warehouse,
  warehouseListSchema,
} from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import {
  createTestApp,
  createTestWorker,
  eventually,
  testConfig,
  testWorkerConfig,
} from '../testing/app.js';
import {
  startPostgres,
  startRedis,
  type TestPostgres,
  type TestRedis,
} from '../testing/containers.js';
import { bearer, type SignedIn, signUp } from '../testing/http.js';

// Step 17d. Two workspaces: A must never see, change, post or delete B's purchase returns and
// debit notes, nor apply B's debit note or void B's supplier refund; nor send back B's goods
// receipt lines, debit B's bills, bill lines, expenses or return lines, or pay back from B's debit
// notes, payments or money. Every answer is 404, or the same "pick one from the list" as for an id
// that does not exist.
let pg: TestPostgres;
let redis: TestRedis;
let app: NestFastifyApplication;
let worker: INestApplicationContext;
let tenantA: SignedIn;
let tenantB: SignedIn;
let unitsOfA: Unit[];
let ratesOfA: TaxRate[];
let ratesOfB: TaxRate[];
let accountsOfA: Account[];
let accountsOfB: Account[];
let warehouseOfA: Warehouse;
let warehouseOfB: Warehouse;
let productOfA: Product;
let productOfB: Product;
let supplierOfA: Supplier;
let supplierOfB: Supplier;
// 100 cones received and billed
let receiptOfB: GoodsReceipt;
// Posted: bills the receipt line, and a repair
let billOfB: Bill;
// Posted, after the bill: 10 cones back
let returnOfB: PurchaseReturn;
let draftReturnOfB: PurchaseReturn;
// Posted for the 10 cones, applied to the bill; and a draft
let noteOfB: DebitNote;
let draftNoteOfB: DebitNote;
// ৳5,000 in advance, ৳1,000 of it paid back
let advanceOfB: SupplierPayment;
let refundOfB: SupplierRefund;

function as(
  who: SignedIn,
  method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'DELETE',
  url: string,
  payload?: object,
) {
  return app.inject({
    method,
    url,
    headers: bearer(who.accessToken),
    ...(payload && { payload }),
  });
}

function problemOf(res: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof as>>) {
  return problemSchema.parse(res.json());
}

async function setUp(who: SignedIn): Promise<void> {
  expect((await as(who, 'POST', '/setup', { industry: 'garments' })).statusCode).toBe(200);
  await eventually(async () => {
    expect(setupSchema.parse((await as(who, 'GET', '/setup')).json()).status).toBe('ready');
  });
}

function pcsOf(units: Unit[]): string {
  const pcs = units.find((unit) => unit.code === 'pcs');
  if (!pcs) throw new Error('no pcs');
  return pcs.id;
}

function vatOf(rates: TaxRate[]): string {
  const found = rates.find((rate) => rate.name === 'VAT 15%');
  if (!found) throw new Error('no VAT 15%');
  return found.id;
}

function codeIn(accounts: Account[], code: string): string {
  const found = accounts.find((item) => item.code === code);
  if (!found) throw new Error(`no account ${code}`);
  return found.id;
}

function variantOf(product: Product): string {
  const [variant] = product.variants;
  if (!variant) throw new Error(`${product.name} has no variant`);
  return variant.id;
}

async function firstWarehouse(who: SignedIn): Promise<Warehouse> {
  const [found] = warehouseListSchema.parse((await as(who, 'GET', '/warehouses')).json()).items;
  if (!found) throw new Error('no warehouse');
  return found;
}

async function addProduct(who: SignedIn, name: string, units: Unit[]): Promise<Product> {
  const res = await as(who, 'POST', '/products', {
    code: '',
    name,
    type: 'goods',
    categoryId: '',
    description: '',
    baseUnitId: pcsOf(units),
    salesUnitId: '',
    purchaseUnitId: '',
    tracking: 'none',
    hasExpiry: false,
    taxRateId: '',
    options: [],
    variants: [
      { id: null, sku: '', optionValues: [], barcode: '', salePrice: '', archived: false },
    ],
    units: [],
    customFields: {},
  });
  expect(res.statusCode, res.body).toBe(201);
  return productSchema.parse(res.json());
}

async function addSupplier(who: SignedIn, name: string): Promise<Supplier> {
  const res = await as(who, 'POST', '/suppliers', {
    code: '',
    name,
    groupId: '',
    contactPerson: '',
    phone: '',
    email: '',
    documentLanguage: 'en',
    bin: '',
    paymentTermsDays: 30,
    address: '',
    bankAccounts: [],
    notes: '',
  });
  expect(res.statusCode, res.body).toBe(201);
  return supplierSchema.parse(res.json());
}

// A return line: from a receipt line, or on its own
function returnLine(variantId: string, unitId: string, extra: object = {}) {
  return {
    variantId,
    unitId,
    quantity: '1',
    batchId: '',
    serialNumbers: [],
    receiptLineId: '',
    ...extra,
  };
}

function returnForm(supplierId: string, warehouse: Warehouse, lines: object[], extra = {}) {
  return {
    supplierId,
    date: '2026-10-17',
    warehouseId: warehouse.id,
    reason: 'damaged',
    note: '',
    lines,
    post: false,
    ...extra,
  };
}

// A debit note line: of a bill line, or of a return line with no bill
function debitLine(unitId: string, extra: object = {}) {
  return {
    billLineId: '',
    returnLineId: '',
    taxRateId: '',
    unitId,
    quantity: '1',
    description: '',
    unitPrice: '100',
    discountType: 'percent',
    discount: '',
    ...extra,
  };
}

function debitForm(supplierId: string, extra = {}) {
  return {
    supplierId,
    billId: '',
    date: '2026-10-17',
    branchId: '',
    pricesIncludeVat: false,
    reason: 'goods_returned',
    supplierCreditNumber: '',
    supplierCreditDate: '',
    note: '',
    lines: [],
    expenses: [],
    post: false,
    ...extra,
  };
}

function refundForm(supplierId: string, warehouse: Warehouse, accounts: Account[], extra = {}) {
  return {
    supplierId,
    date: '2026-10-18',
    amount: '100',
    accountId: codeIn(accounts, '1110'),
    method: 'cash',
    reference: '',
    branchId: warehouse.branchId,
    note: '',
    debitNoteId: '',
    paymentId: '',
    ...extra,
  };
}

async function returnOfBNow(id: string): Promise<PurchaseReturn> {
  return purchaseReturnSchema.parse((await as(tenantB, 'GET', `/purchase-returns/${id}`)).json());
}

async function noteOfBNow(id: string): Promise<DebitNote> {
  return debitNoteSchema.parse((await as(tenantB, 'GET', `/debit-notes/${id}`)).json());
}

beforeAll(async () => {

  expect(draftNote.statusCode, draftNote.body).toBe(201);
```
