```tsx
}
```

- **A receipt line's row is `fixed`** (no batch box: its lot is the receipt line's), and a line on its own is `out`,
  which picks a batch in this warehouse like any line that takes stock out.
- **Under a receipt line:** its receipt and lot, what can still go back (posted returns only; this draft is not
  counted yet), and why the item and the batch cannot change. Under a line on its own: that it leaves at the
  average cost (decision 2), so nobody expects the receipt's price.
- **The line's own error** is either the item (no cost: `purchase_return_cost_unknown`) or the receipt line (not this
  supplier's, or twice); there is one place for both under the item.
- **`allowArchived` on the item picker:** an archived product's goods can still be on the shelf and go back, the
  API's rule.

```tsx
// "Add from goods receipts": the supplier's posted receipts with goods that can still go back. Each
// click adds what is kept on that receipt. The dialog stays open: one truck may take back goods of
// several receipts.
function ReceiptPicker({
  supplierId,
  onAdd,
}: {
  supplierId: string;
  onAdd: (receipt: GoodsReceipt) => boolean;
}) {
  const { t, errorText } = useLocale();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const isoDate = useIsoDate();
  const { data: receipts } = useQuery(returnableReceiptsQuery(tenantId, supplierId));
  const [added, setAdded] = useState<ReadonlySet<string>>(new Set());
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const pick = async (receiptId: string) => {
    setLoading(receiptId);
    setProblem(null);
    try {
      const found = await queryClient.query(goodsReceiptQuery(tenantId, receiptId));
      if (onAdd(found)) setAdded((before) => new Set(before).add(receiptId));
      else setProblem(t('salesLines.tooMany', { max: MAX_STOCK_LINES }));
    } catch (error) {
      setProblem(errorText(failureOf(error instanceof Error ? error : null) ?? 'unknown_error'));
    } finally {
      setLoading(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <DialogContent
      title={t('purchaseReturns.receiptPickerTitle')}
      description={t('purchaseReturns.receiptPickerDescription')}
    >
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4">
        <PickProblem message={problem} />
        {receipts?.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={PackageReceiveIcon}
            title={t('purchaseReturns.receiptPickerEmpty')}
            description={t('purchaseReturns.receiptPickerDescription')}
          />
        ) : (
          <ul className="grid max-h-[min(420px,55dvh)] grid-cols-1 gap-px overflow-y-auto">
            {receipts?.map((found) => (
              <li
                key={found.id}
                className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg px-2 py-2 hover:bg-subtle"
              >
                <span className="grid min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className="font-mono text-body-sm font-medium tabular-nums">
                    {found.number ?? ''}
                  </span>
                  <span className="truncate text-caption text-ink-3 tabular-nums">
                    {isoDate(found.date)} · {t('salesLines.lineCount', { count: found.lineCount })}
                    {found.order?.number && ` · ${found.order.number}`}
                  </span>
                </span>
                <PickButton
                  added={added.has(found.id)}
                  loading={loading === found.id}
                  onClick={() => void pick(found.id)}
                />
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>
    </DialogContent>
  );
}
```

"Add from goods receipts" lists the supplier's receipts with something to send back. Each click reads the receipt
and adds what is left on it; the dialog stays open, because one truck often takes back goods of several receipts.

```tsx
import { NoteRemoveIcon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { HugeiconsIcon } from '@hugeicons/react';
import { isZeroQuantity, type PurchaseReturn, type PurchaseReturnLine } from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import { Button, Card, PageHeader } from '@omnivo/ui';
import { Link, useNavigate } from '@tanstack/react-router';

import { useCan } from '../lib/permissions';
import { debitStartOf } from '../lib/purchase-returns';
import { purchaseReturnReasonKey } from '../lib/returns';
import { Fact } from './adjustment-view';
import { EntryLinks } from './entry-links';
import { PrintButton, PurchaseReturnPrint } from './print-documents';
import { PurchaseBackLink, SupplierLink } from './purchase-parts';
import { DocumentNotice, LINK_NUMBER, LINK_ROW, LinkList } from './sales-parts';
import { DocumentStatusPill } from './sales-pills';
import { StockLinesTable } from './stock-lines-table';
import { useIsoDate, useQuantity, useWarehouses, warehouseLabel } from './stock-parts';

const LINK = 'font-medium text-brand underline-offset-3 hover:underline';

// A posted purchase return (or a draft for someone who may not write returns), read only, like the
// sales return of 15d. Each line says where it came from and whether a bill had billed it when the
// return was posted: a billed line, or a line on its own, needs a debit note to take its money off,
// which the notice and "Write debit note" offer until every such line is debited.
export function PurchaseReturnView({ purchaseReturn }: { purchaseReturn: PurchaseReturn }) {
  const { t, format } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isoDate = useIsoDate();
  const quantity = useQuantity();
  const { byId } = useWarehouses();
  const canDebit = useCan()('purchase.debit_note.manage');
  const posted = purchaseReturn.status === 'posted';
  // The receipts by number: a line names its receipt by number, the page links it by id
  const receiptIds = new Map(purchaseReturn.receipts.map((ref) => [ref.number, ref.id]));
  const debitable = posted && debitStartOf(purchaseReturn) !== null;
  const warehouse = warehouseLabel(byId.get(purchaseReturn.warehouseId));

  const detail = (line: PurchaseReturnLine) => {
    const debited = !isZeroQuantity(line.debitedQuantity) && (
      <span className="tabular-nums">
        {t('purchaseReturns.lineDebited', {
          quantity: quantity(line.debitedQuantity, line.baseUnitId),
        })}
      </span>
    );
    if (line.receiptNumber === null) {
      return (
        <span className="mt-1 grid gap-0.5 text-caption text-ink-3">
          <span>{t('purchaseReturns.ownLine')}</span>
          {debited}
        </span>
      );
    }
    const receiptId = receiptIds.get(line.receiptNumber);
    return (
      <span className="mt-1 grid gap-0.5 text-caption text-ink-3">
        {receiptId === undefined ? (
          <span>{t('purchaseReturns.fromReceipt', { number: line.receiptNumber })}</span>
        ) : (
          <Link to="/goods-receipts/$receiptId" params={{ receiptId }} className={LINK}>
            {t('purchaseReturns.fromReceipt', { number: line.receiptNumber })}
          </Link>
        )}
        {/* Fixed when the return was posted; a draft has not looked yet */}
        {posted &&
          (line.billId !== null && line.billNumber !== null ? (
            <Link to="/bills/$billId" params={{ billId: line.billId }} className={LINK}>
              {t('purchaseReturns.lineBilled', { number: line.billNumber })}
            </Link>
          ) : (
            <span>{t('purchaseReturns.lineNotBilled')}</span>
          ))}
        {debited}
      </span>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
      <PurchaseBackLink to="/purchase-returns" label={t('purchaseReturns.back')} />
      <PageHeader
        title={purchaseReturn.number ?? t('purchaseReturns.draftTitle')}
        description={purchaseReturn.supplier.name}
        actions={
          <>
            <DocumentStatusPill
              status={purchaseReturn.status}
              label={t(`purchaseReturns.statuses.${purchaseReturn.status}`)}
            />
            {posted && <PrintButton />}
          </>
        }
      />
      {debitable && (
        <DocumentNotice tone="neutral">{t('purchaseReturns.debitNotice')}</DocumentNotice>
      )}
      <Card className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-6 gap-y-4 p-5 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <div className="grid min-w-0 gap-0.5">
          <span className="text-caption font-medium text-ink-3">
            {t('purchaseReturns.supplier')}
          </span>
          <span className="text-body-sm">
            <SupplierLink supplier={purchaseReturn.supplier} />
          </span>
        </div>
        <Fact label={t('purchaseReturns.date')} value={isoDate(purchaseReturn.date)} />
        <Fact
          label={t('purchaseReturns.reason')}
          value={t(purchaseReturnReasonKey(purchaseReturn.reason))}
        />
        <Fact label={t('purchaseReturns.warehouse')} value={warehouse} />
        {purchaseReturn.postedAt !== null && (
          <Fact
            label={t('purchaseReturns.statuses.posted')}
            // A moment, not a date: shown in the reader's own time zone
            value={t('purchaseReturns.postedOn', {
              date: format.date(new Date(purchaseReturn.postedAt)),
            })}
          />
        )}
        {posted && (
          <EntryLinks
            label={t('purchaseReturns.entry')}
            entries={purchaseReturn.entry ? [purchaseReturn.entry] : []}
            none={t('purchaseReturns.noEntry')}
          />
        )}
        {purchaseReturn.note !== null && (
          <div className="sm:col-span-3">
            <Fact label={t('purchaseReturns.note')} value={purchaseReturn.note} />
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>
      <StockLinesTable lines={purchaseReturn.lines} detail={detail} />

      {posted && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 lg:grid-cols-2">
          {purchaseReturn.receipts.length > 0 && (
            <LinkList
              title={t('purchaseReturns.receiptsTitle')}
              subtitle={t('purchaseReturns.receiptsSubtitle')}
            >
              {purchaseReturn.receipts.map((receipt) => (
                <li key={receipt.id}>
                  <Link
                    to="/goods-receipts/$receiptId"
                    params={{ receiptId: receipt.id }}
                    className={LINK_ROW}
                  >
                    <span className={LINK_NUMBER}>{receipt.number ?? ''}</span>
                  </Link>
                </li>
              ))}
            </LinkList>
          )}
          {/* Drafts too (17d.1), so nobody writes a second debit note by mistake */}
          <LinkList
            title={t('purchaseReturns.debitNotesTitle')}
            subtitle={t('purchaseReturns.debitNotesSubtitle')}
            empty={
              purchaseReturn.debitNotes.length === 0 ? t('purchaseReturns.noDebitNotes') : undefined
            }
          >
            {purchaseReturn.debitNotes.map((note) => (
              <li key={note.id}>
                <Link
                  to="/debit-notes/$debitNoteId"
                  params={{ debitNoteId: note.id }}
                  className={LINK_ROW}
                >
                  <span className={LINK_NUMBER}>
                    {note.number ?? t('debitNotes.statuses.draft')}
                  </span>
                </Link>
              </li>
            ))}
          </LinkList>
        </div>
      )}

      {debitable && canDebit && (
        <div className="flex justify-end">
          <Button
            onClick={() =>
              void navigate({ to: '/debit-notes/new', search: { returnId: purchaseReturn.id } })
            }
          >
            <HugeiconsIcon icon={NoteRemoveIcon} size={17} strokeWidth={1.5} />
            {t('purchaseReturns.makeDebitNote')}
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
      {posted && <PurchaseReturnPrint purchaseReturn={purchaseReturn} warehouse={warehouse} />}
    </div>
  );
}
```

A posted return, read only. Each line says where it came from and, once posted, whether a bill had billed it (with a
link to the bill) or not ("Not billed yet: the bill bills less"), and how much debit notes took off. The notice and
"Write debit note" show while `debitStartOf()` finds something: lines that were billed or that came from no receipt
and are not all debited. The debit note list includes drafts (17d.1), so nobody writes a second one by mistake. Only
a posted return prints: a draft on paper would look like goods that left.

```tsx
import { AlertCircleIcon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import { EmptyState } from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useParams, useSearch } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { lazy, Suspense } from 'react';

import { PurchaseBackLink } from '../components/purchase-parts';
import { useTenantId, useToday, useWarehouses } from '../components/stock-parts';
import { useCan } from '../lib/permissions';
import { goodsReceiptQuery, purchaseReturnQuery, unitsQuery } from '../lib/queries';

// The page loads the data and picks the form or the view, each a lazy chunk of its own (the
// delivery's pattern), like the sales return of 15d
const PurchaseReturnForm = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('../components/purchase-return-form')).PurchaseReturnForm,
}));
const PurchaseReturnView = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('../components/purchase-return-view')).PurchaseReturnView,
}));

// The units and the warehouses: the lines and the warehouse box need them
function useReady(): boolean {
  const units = useQuery(unitsQuery(useTenantId())).data;
  const { active } = useWarehouses();
  return units !== undefined && active !== undefined;
}

function CantFind({ message }: { message: string }) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
      <PurchaseBackLink to="/purchase-returns" label={t('purchaseReturns.back')} />
      <EmptyState icon={AlertCircleIcon} title={t('purchaseReturns.title')} description={message} />
    </div>
  );
}

// A new return; "Send goods back" on a goods receipt comes here with ?receiptId=
export function NewPurchaseReturnPage() {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const canWrite = useCan()('purchase.return.manage');
  const today = useToday();
  const ready = useReady();
  const { receiptId = '' } = useSearch({ strict: false });
  const { data: receipt, isError } = useQuery({
    ...goodsReceiptQuery(useTenantId(), receiptId),
    enabled: receiptId !== '',
  });
  if (!canWrite) {
    return (
      <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
        <PurchaseBackLink to="/purchase-returns" label={t('purchaseReturns.back')} />
        <p className="text-body-sm text-ink-3">{t('purchaseReturns.cantWrite')}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (isError) return <CantFind message={t('goodsReceipts.notFound')} />;
  // The form waits for the receipt: drawing it empty and filling it a moment later would let the
  // person type into a form that is about to be replaced
  if (!ready || (receiptId !== '' && !receipt)) return null;
  // Only a posted receipt's goods can go back; a draft's start the form empty
  const posted = receipt?.status === 'posted' ? receipt : null;
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={null}>
      <PurchaseReturnForm purchaseReturn={null} receipt={posted} today={today} />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

export function PurchaseReturnPage() {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const { returnId = '' } = useParams({ strict: false });
  const canWrite = useCan()('purchase.return.manage');
  const today = useToday();
  const ready = useReady();
  const { data: purchaseReturn, isError } = useQuery({
    ...purchaseReturnQuery(useTenantId(), returnId),
    enabled: returnId !== '',
  });

  if (isError) return <CantFind message={t('purchaseReturns.notFound')} />;
  if (!purchaseReturn || !ready) return null;
  if (purchaseReturn.status === 'draft' && canWrite) {
    // key: a saved draft comes back with a new version, and the form starts from it again
    return (
      <Suspense fallback={null}>
        <PurchaseReturnForm
          key={`${purchaseReturn.id}-${String(purchaseReturn.version)}`}
          purchaseReturn={purchaseReturn}
          receipt={null}
          today={today}
        />
      </Suspense>
    );
  }
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={null}>
      <PurchaseReturnView purchaseReturn={purchaseReturn} />
    </Suspense>
  );
}
```

The page picks the form or the view, each a lazy chunk, like every document. `?receiptId=` starts a new return from a
receipt; the form waits for the receipt, because drawing it empty and filling it a moment later would let the person
type into a form that is about to be replaced. Only a posted receipt starts a return: a draft's goods are not in
stock. A saved draft is drawn again with a `key` of its id and version, so the form starts from what was saved.
