### Debit notes: `debit-note-lines.tsx`, `debit-note-form.tsx`, `debit-note-view.tsx` and their routes (new)

```tsx
import {
  Alert02Icon,
  Delete02Icon,
  InvoiceIcon,
  PlusSignIcon,
  TruckReturnIcon,
} from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { HugeiconsIcon } from '@hugeicons/react';
import {
  type Bill,
  type BillExpense,
  type BillLine,
  compareMoney,
  type DebitNoteExpenseFormValues,
  type DebitNoteLineFormValues,
  defaultLineDescription,
  draftLineAmounts,
  isMoneyAmount,
  MAX_BILL_EXPENSES,
  MAX_BILL_LINES,
  priceInUnit,
  wholeBillDebit,
} from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import {
  Button,
  Card,
  CardHeader,
  cn,
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DiscountInput,
  EmptyState,
  IconButton,
  Input,
  MoneyInput,
  Select,
} from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { type ReactNode, useState } from 'react';
import type { FieldErrors } from 'react-hook-form';

import { draftExpenseAmounts } from '../lib/bills';
import {
  type DebitItem,
  debitableExpenses,
  debitableReturnLines,
  debitLeft,
  debitLineRate,
  expenseToDebit,
  ownReturnLineToDebit,
  returnLineItem,
  returnLineToDebit,
} from '../lib/purchase-returns';
import {
  postedPurchaseReturnsQuery,
  purchaseReturnQuery,
  taxRatesQuery,
  unitsQuery,
} from '../lib/queries';
import { basePreview, unitChoices } from '../lib/stock';
import { taxRateOptions, useRateText } from '../lib/tax-rates';
import { failureOf } from './journal-parts';
import { FixedValue, SALES_LINE_COLUMNS, SalesField } from './sales-line-editor';
import { PickButton, PickProblem } from './sales-parts';
import { useIsoDate, useQuantity, useTenantId, VariantCell } from './stock-parts';

// The lines and the expenses of a debit note (step 17d): the credit note's line editor (15d) seen
// from the buyer's side, plus a card for the bill's expenses. With a bill, every line takes off a
// line of that bill: the item and the VAT rate are the bill line's (the VAT taken off is the VAT
// that was claimed), so they are shown, not picked; the unit, quantity, price and discount can
// change. Without a bill (decision 9), every line takes off goods that went back on a return line
// of its own: the item is the return line's, and the VAT rate is picked here, from the supplier's
// credit note. Lines come only from the pickers. Its own chunk, loaded by the debit note form.

export type DebitNoteLinesErrors = FieldErrors<{ lines: DebitNoteLineFormValues[] }>['lines'];
export type DebitNoteExpensesErrors = FieldErrors<{
  expenses: DebitNoteExpenseFormValues[];
}>['expenses'];

// What the form knows about a return line on the form, by its id: the return's number, for "Goods
// sent back on PRN-…", and the item, for a line without a bill (which has no bill line to show)
export interface DebitReturnSource {
  number: string;
  item: DebitItem;
}

let lastKey = 0;
function nextKey(): string {
  lastKey += 1;
  return `debit-${String(lastKey)}`;
}

// A unit's size in the base unit: "1" for the base unit itself
function factorOf(item: DebitItem, unitId: string): string | null {
  if (unitId === item.baseUnitId) return '1';
  return item.units.find((unit) => unit.unitId === unitId)?.factor ?? null;
}

export function DebitNoteLinesEditor({
  lines,
  onChange,
  getLines,
  bill,
  supplierId,
  pricesIncludeVat,
  returnSources,
  onReturnSources,
  errors,
}: {
  lines: DebitNoteLineFormValues[];
  onChange: (lines: DebitNoteLineFormValues[]) => void;
  // The form's lines right now (getValues): a picker that waited for the API appends to these
  getLines: () => DebitNoteLineFormValues[];
  // The chosen bill with its lines; null for a debit note without a bill
  bill: Bill | null;
  supplierId: string;
  pricesIncludeVat: boolean;
  returnSources: ReadonlyMap<string, DebitReturnSource>;
  onReturnSources: (entries: readonly (readonly [string, DebitReturnSource])[]) => void;
  errors: DebitNoteLinesErrors;
}) {
  const { t, format, errorText } = useLocale();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const quantityText = useQuantity();
  const rateText = useRateText();
  const units = useQuery(unitsQuery(tenantId)).data ?? [];
  const rates = useQuery(taxRatesQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const rateOf = (id: string) => rates?.find((rate) => rate.id === id)?.rate ?? null;
  // React's key for each line: stays with the line when a line above it is removed
  const [keys, setKeys] = useState<string[]>(() => lines.map(() => nextKey()));
  const [picking, setPicking] = useState<'lines' | 'returns' | null>(null);
  const billLines = new Map(bill?.lines.map((line) => [line.id, line]));
  const money = (value: string) => format.money(value, { decimals: 2 });

  // The line's item and its bill line (null for a line without a bill)
  const sourceOf = (
    line: DebitNoteLineFormValues,
  ): { item: DebitItem; billLine: BillLine | null } | null => {
    const billLine = billLines.get(line.billLineId ?? '');
    if (billLine) return { item: billLine, billLine };
    const own = returnSources.get(line.returnLineId ?? '');
    return own ? { item: own.item, billLine: null } : null;
  };

  // Lines from a picker. false = the debit note would hold too many; nothing is added.
  const add = (added: readonly DebitNoteLineFormValues[]): boolean => {
    if (getLines().length + added.length > MAX_BILL_LINES) return false;
    onChange([...getLines(), ...added]);
    setKeys((before) => [...before, ...added.map(() => nextKey())]);
    return true;
  };

  const remove = (index: number) => {
    onChange(lines.filter((_, at) => at !== index));
    setKeys((before) => before.filter((_, at) => at !== index));
  };

  const update = (index: number, patch: Partial<DebitNoteLineFormValues>) => {
    onChange(lines.map((line, at) => (at === index ? { ...line, ...patch } : line)));
  };

  // A price is per unit, so another unit moves the typed price with it: ৳7,800 a bag is ৳156 a kg.
  // A price being typed stays as it is.
  const changeUnit = (index: number, unitId: string) => {
    const line = lines[index];
    const source = line ? sourceOf(line) : null;
    if (!line || !source) return;
    const from = factorOf(source.item, line.unitId);
    const to = factorOf(source.item, unitId);
    const price = line.unitPrice.trim();
    update(index, {
      unitId,
      ...(from !== null && to !== null && isMoneyAmount(price)
        ? { unitPrice: priceInUnit(price, from, to) }
        : {}),
    });
  };

  const listError = errors?.root?.message ?? errors?.message;
```

The credit note's line editor (15d) seen from the buyer's side, and a lazy chunk of its own: it brings the money and
discount boxes.

- **`DebitReturnSource` is what the form keeps per return line:** its return's number, for "Goods sent back on
  PRN-…", and its item, for a line without a bill, which has no bill line to draw from.
- **`sourceOf()` finds a line's item and bill line.** A line of a bill draws from the bill line; a line without one
  from its return line. `null` means the bill is still loading, and the row waits for it.
- **`add()` takes the lines from `getLines()`, not from the prop:** a picker that waited for the API appends to the
  form as it is now, so two quick clicks never drop the first one's lines.
- **A new unit moves the typed price with it** (৳18,000 a roll is ৳360 a metre); a price being typed stays as it is.

```tsx
  return (
    <Card
      className="@container grid grid-cols-1 overflow-hidden"
      aria-label={t('salesLines.items')}
    >
      {lines.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="px-5 py-6 text-body-sm text-ink-2">{t('salesLines.noLines')}</p>
      ) : (
        <div
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={cn(
            'hidden bg-subtle px-5 py-2 text-caption font-medium text-ink-3 @5xl:grid',
            SALES_LINE_COLUMNS,
          )}
        >
          <span>{t('salesLines.item')}</span>
          <span>{t('salesLines.unit')}</span>
          <span className="text-right">{t('salesLines.quantity')}</span>
          <span className="text-right">
            {pricesIncludeVat ? t('salesLines.priceWithVat') : t('salesLines.priceWithoutVat')}
          </span>
          <span className="text-right">{t('salesLines.discount')}</span>
          <span>{t('salesLines.vatRate')}</span>
          <span className="text-right">{t('salesLines.amount')}</span>
        </div>
      )}
      {lines.map((line, index) => {
        const source = sourceOf(line);
        const key = keys[index] ?? `line-${String(index)}`;
        if (!source) return null;
        const { item, billLine } = source;
        const number = index + 1;
        const lineErrors = errors?.[index];
        const id = (field: string) => `lines.${String(index)}.${field}`;
        const preview = basePreview(item, line.unitId, line.quantity, units);
        const amount = draftLineAmounts(
          {
            quantity: line.quantity,
            unitPrice: line.unitPrice,
            discountType: line.discountType,
            discount: line.discount,
          },
          debitLineRate(line, billLines, rateOf),
          pricesIncludeVat,
        );
        const returnLineId = line.returnLineId ?? '';
        const taxRateId = line.taxRateId ?? '';
        // The line's own problem: not a line of this bill, or a return line it cannot debit
        const lineError = lineErrors?.billLineId?.message ?? lineErrors?.returnLineId?.message;
        const removeButton = (
          <IconButton
            icon={Delete02Icon}
            label={t('salesLines.remove', { number })}
            onClick={() => {
              remove(index);
            }}
          />
        );
        return (
          <div
            key={key}
            role="group"
            aria-label={t('salesLines.line', { number })}
            className={cn(
              'grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 border-t border-line px-5 py-4',
              SALES_LINE_COLUMNS,
            )}
          >
            <div className="col-span-2 grid min-w-0 gap-2 @5xl:col-span-1">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <VariantCell item={item} />
                <span className="@5xl:hidden">{removeButton}</span>
              </div>
              <span className="grid gap-0.5 text-caption text-ink-3">
                <span className="font-medium text-ink-2">
                  {returnLineId === ''
                    ? t('debitNotes.fromBillLine', {
                        number: billLine ? (bill?.lines.indexOf(billLine) ?? 0) + 1 : 0,
                      })
                    : t('debitNotes.fromReturn', {
                        number: returnSources.get(returnLineId)?.number ?? '',
                      })}
                </span>
                {/* The money cap of 17d.1: what posted debit notes left on the bill line */}
                {billLine && (
                  <span className="tabular-nums">
                    {t('debitNotes.leftToDebit', { amount: money(debitLeft(billLine)) })}
                  </span>
                )}
                {lineError && (
                  <span className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-label text-crit">
                    <HugeiconsIcon
                      icon={Alert02Icon}
                      size={15}
                      strokeWidth={1.5}
                      className="mt-px shrink-0"
                    />
                    {errorText(lineError)}
                  </span>
                )}
              </span>
              <SalesField
                id={id('description')}
                label={t('salesLines.description')}
                error={lineErrors?.description?.message}
              >
                <Input
                  id={id('description')}
                  autoComplete="off"
                  placeholder={billLine ? defaultLineDescription(billLine) : item.productName}
                  value={line.description ?? ''}
                  invalid={lineErrors?.description !== undefined}
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    update(index, { description: event.target.value });
                  }}
                />
              </SalesField>
            </div>
            <SalesField
              id={id('unitId')}
              label={t('salesLines.unit')}
              error={lineErrors?.unitId?.message}
            >
              <Select
                id={id('unitId')}
                options={unitChoices(item, units)}
                value={line.unitId}
                invalid={lineErrors?.unitId !== undefined}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  changeUnit(index, event.target.value);
                }}
              />
            </SalesField>
            <SalesField
              id={id('quantity')}
              label={t('salesLines.quantity')}
              error={lineErrors?.quantity?.message}
            >
              <Input
                id={id('quantity')}
                inputMode="decimal"
                autoComplete="off"
                align="end"
                value={line.quantity}
                invalid={lineErrors?.quantity !== undefined}
                aria-describedby={lineErrors?.quantity ? `${id('quantity')}-error` : undefined}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  update(index, { quantity: event.target.value });
                }}
              />
              {preview !== null && (
                <span className="text-right text-caption text-ink-3 tabular-nums">
                  {t('stockLines.equals', { quantity: quantityText(preview, item.baseUnitId) })}
                </span>
              )}
            </SalesField>
            <SalesField
              id={id('unitPrice')}
              label={
                pricesIncludeVat ? t('salesLines.priceWithVat') : t('salesLines.priceWithoutVat')
              }
              error={lineErrors?.unitPrice?.message}
            >
              <MoneyInput
                id={id('unitPrice')}
                value={line.unitPrice}
                invalid={lineErrors?.unitPrice !== undefined}
                aria-describedby={lineErrors?.unitPrice ? `${id('unitPrice')}-error` : undefined}
                onChange={(value) => {
                  update(index, { unitPrice: value });
                }}
              />
            </SalesField>
            <SalesField
              id={id('discount')}
              label={t('salesLines.discount')}
              error={lineErrors?.discount?.message}
            >
              <DiscountInput
                id={id('discount')}
                value={line.discount}
                discountType={line.discountType}
                invalid={lineErrors?.discount !== undefined}
                aria-describedby={lineErrors?.discount ? `${id('discount')}-error` : undefined}
                onChange={(value) => {
                  update(index, { discount: value });
                }}
                onDiscountTypeChange={(discountType) => {
                  update(index, { discountType });
                }}
              />
            </SalesField>
            {billLine ? (
              <FixedValue
                label={t('salesLines.vatRate')}
                value={`${billLine.taxRate.name} · ${rateText(billLine.taxRate.rate)}`}
              />
            ) : (
              // Without a bill, the rate on the supplier's credit note (tax_rate_invalid when
              // none is picked)
              <SalesField
                id={id('taxRateId')}
                label={t('salesLines.vatRate')}
                error={lineErrors?.taxRateId?.message}
              >
                <Select
                  id={id('taxRateId')}
                  options={[
                    { value: '', label: t('salesLines.vatRate') },
                    ...taxRateOptions(rates ?? [], rateText, taxRateId),
                  ]}
                  value={taxRateId}
                  invalid={lineErrors?.taxRateId !== undefined}
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    update(index, { taxRateId: event.target.value });
                  }}
                />
              </SalesField>
            )}
            <div className="grid content-start gap-1.5">
              <span className="text-label font-medium text-ink @5xl:sr-only">
                {t('salesLines.amount')}
              </span>
              <span className="py-2.5 text-right text-body-sm font-medium tabular-nums">
                {amount ? money(pricesIncludeVat ? amount.total : amount.net) : '—'}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="hidden @5xl:block @5xl:pt-1">{removeButton}</div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
      {listError && (
        <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 border-t border-line px-5 py-3 text-label text-crit">
          <HugeiconsIcon icon={Alert02Icon} size={15} strokeWidth={1.5} className="shrink-0" />
          {errorText(listError)}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-t border-line px-5 py-3">
        {/* A debit note without a bill has no bill lines to take off: only returned goods */}
        {bill !== null && (
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => {
              setPicking('lines');
            }}
          >
            <HugeiconsIcon icon={InvoiceIcon} size={16} strokeWidth={1.5} />
            {t('debitNotes.addBillLines')}
          </Button>
        )}
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          size="sm"
          disabled={supplierId === ''}
          onClick={() => {
            setPicking('returns');
          }}
        >
          <HugeiconsIcon icon={TruckReturnIcon} size={16} strokeWidth={1.5} />
          {t('debitNotes.addReturns')}
        </Button>
        {supplierId === '' && (
          <span className="text-label text-ink-3">{t('debitNotes.pickSupplierFirst')}</span>
        )}
      </div>

      <Dialog
        open={picking !== null}
        onOpenChange={(open) => {
          if (!open) setPicking(null);
        }}
      >
        {picking === 'lines' && bill && <BillLinePicker bill={bill} add={add} />}
        {picking === 'returns' && (
          <ReturnPicker
            bill={bill}
            supplierId={supplierId}
            onForm={
              new Set(
                lines.flatMap((line) => {
                  const lineId = line.returnLineId ?? '';
                  return lineId === '' ? [] : [lineId];
                }),
              )
            }
            add={add}
            onReturnSources={onReturnSources}
          />
        )}
      </Dialog>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

- **The row is the sales line editor's grid** (`SALES_LINE_COLUMNS`) with the same boxes, so a debit note reads like
  the bill it corrects.
- **Under the item:** which bill line or return it takes off, and for a bill line what is still left to take off
  (`debitLeft()`), the limit the API checks.
- **The VAT rate is fixed for a bill's line, and a select without a bill** (decision 43): with a bill, the VAT taken
  off must be what was claimed; without one, it is on the supplier's credit note. The select lists the active rates
  and keeps a saved archived one, like the sales editor.
- **"Add bill lines" shows only with a bill.** Without one there is nothing to pick from; only returned goods can be
  debited (decision 9).

```tsx
// "Add bill lines": a line of the bill as it was billed, for a price cut (keep the quantity, type
// the cut per unit) or a billing mistake. Lines taken off in full are left out.
function BillLinePicker({
  bill,
  add,
}: {
  bill: Bill;
  add: (lines: readonly DebitNoteLineFormValues[]) => boolean;
}) {
  const { t, format } = useLocale();
  const quantity = useQuantity();
  const [added, setAdded] = useState<ReadonlySet<string>>(new Set());
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const open = bill.lines.filter((line) => compareMoney(debitLeft(line), '0') > 0);

  const pick = (line: BillLine) => {
    setProblem(null);
    if (add(wholeBillDebit({ lines: [line], expenses: [] }).lines)) {
      setAdded((before) => new Set(before).add(line.id));
    } else {
      setProblem(t('salesLines.tooMany', { max: MAX_BILL_LINES }));
    }
  };

  return (
    <DialogContent
      title={t('debitNotes.billLinePickerTitle')}
      description={t('debitNotes.billLinePickerDescription')}
    >
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4">
        <PickProblem message={problem} />
        {open.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={InvoiceIcon}
            title={t('debitNotes.billLinePickerEmpty')}
            description={t('debitNotes.billLinePickerDescription')}
          />
        ) : (
          <ul className="grid max-h-[min(420px,55dvh)] grid-cols-1 gap-px overflow-y-auto">
            {open.map((line) => (
              <li
                key={line.id}
                className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg px-2 py-2 hover:bg-subtle"
              >
                <span className="grid min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className="truncate text-body-sm font-medium">{line.description}</span>
                  <span className="truncate text-caption text-ink-3 tabular-nums">
                    {t('debitNotes.fromBillLine', { number: bill.lines.indexOf(line) + 1 })} ·{' '}
                    {quantity(line.quantity, line.unitId)} ·{' '}
                    {t('debitNotes.leftToDebit', {
                      amount: format.money(debitLeft(line), { decimals: 2 }),
                    })}
                  </span>
                </span>
                <PickButton
                  added={added.has(line.id)}
                  loading={false}
                  onClick={() => {
                    pick(line);
                  }}
                />
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>
    </DialogContent>
  );
}

// "Add returned goods": the supplier's posted returns. A click opens the return and adds its lines
// that this bill billed and debit notes have not taken off yet, at the bill's price; without a bill,
// its lines on their own, with the price and the rate to type. The list cannot say which returns
// hold such lines, so one with none says so when opened.
function ReturnPicker({
  bill,
  supplierId,
  onForm,
  add,
  onReturnSources,
}: {
  bill: Bill | null;
  supplierId: string;
  onForm: ReadonlySet<string>;
  add: (lines: readonly DebitNoteLineFormValues[]) => boolean;
  onReturnSources: (entries: readonly (readonly [string, DebitReturnSource])[]) => void;
}) {
  const { t, errorText } = useLocale();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const isoDate = useIsoDate();
  const { data: returns } = useQuery(postedPurchaseReturnsQuery(tenantId, supplierId));
  const [added, setAdded] = useState<ReadonlySet<string>>(new Set());
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const billLines = new Map(bill?.lines.map((line) => [line.id, line]));
  const description = bill
    ? t('debitNotes.returnPickerDescription')
    : t('debitNotes.returnPickerOwnDescription');

  const pick = async (returnId: string) => {
    setLoading(returnId);
    setProblem(null);
    try {
      const purchaseReturn = await queryClient.query(purchaseReturnQuery(tenantId, returnId));
      const found = debitableReturnLines(purchaseReturn, bill?.id ?? null, onForm).flatMap(
        (line) => {
          if (bill === null) return [{ line, debit: ownReturnLineToDebit(line) }];
          const billLine = billLines.get(line.billLineId ?? '');
          return billLine ? [{ line, debit: returnLineToDebit(line, billLine) }] : [];
        },
      );
      if (found.length === 0) {
        setProblem(t('debitNotes.returnPickerEmpty'));
        return;
      }
      if (!add(found.map((entry) => entry.debit))) {
        setProblem(t('salesLines.tooMany', { max: MAX_BILL_LINES }));
        return;
      }
      onReturnSources(
        found.map(
          (entry) =>
            [
              entry.line.id,
              { number: purchaseReturn.number ?? '', item: returnLineItem(entry.line) },
            ] as const,
        ),
      );
      setAdded((before) => new Set(before).add(returnId));
    } catch (error) {
      setProblem(errorText(failureOf(error instanceof Error ? error : null) ?? 'unknown_error'));
    } finally {
      setLoading(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <DialogContent title={t('debitNotes.returnPickerTitle')} description={description}>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4">
        <PickProblem message={problem} />
        {returns?.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={TruckReturnIcon}
            title={t('debitNotes.returnPickerEmpty')}
            description={description}
          />
        ) : (
          <ul className="grid max-h-[min(420px,55dvh)] grid-cols-1 gap-px overflow-y-auto">
            {returns?.map((purchaseReturn) => (
              <li
                key={purchaseReturn.id}
                className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg px-2 py-2 hover:bg-subtle"
              >
                <span className="grid min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className="font-mono text-body-sm font-medium tabular-nums">
                    {purchaseReturn.number ?? ''}
                  </span>
                  <span className="truncate text-caption text-ink-3 tabular-nums">
                    {isoDate(purchaseReturn.date)} ·{' '}
                    {t('salesLines.lineCount', { count: purchaseReturn.lineCount })}
                  </span>
                </span>
                <PickButton
                  added={added.has(purchaseReturn.id)}
                  loading={loading === purchaseReturn.id}
                  onClick={() => void pick(purchaseReturn.id)}
                />
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>
    </DialogContent>
  );
}
```

- **`BillLinePicker` adds a line as it was billed** (`wholeBillDebit()` of one line), for a price cut (keep the
  quantity, type the cut per unit as the price) or a billing mistake. Lines taken off in full are left out.
- **`ReturnPicker` opens a return and adds its lines that can still be debited:** with a bill, at the bill line's
  price; without, with the price and the rate to type. The list cannot say which returns hold such lines, so one
  with none says so when it is opened, like the credit note's picker.

```tsx
// One template for the header and every row on a wide card; below it each box shows its label
const EXPENSE_COLUMNS =
  '@3xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_9.5rem_9.5rem_7.5rem_2.25rem] @3xl:items-start @3xl:gap-2';

// The bill's expenses a debit note takes money off, by money only: a transport charge billed
// twice, a repair the supplier agreed to charge less for. Each names its bill expense, whose
// account, description and VAT rate it keeps. Shown only with a bill.
export function DebitNoteExpensesEditor({
  expenses,
  onChange,
  bill,
  pricesIncludeVat,
  errors,
}: {
  expenses: DebitNoteExpenseFormValues[];
  onChange: (expenses: DebitNoteExpenseFormValues[]) => void;
  bill: Bill;
  pricesIncludeVat: boolean;
  errors: DebitNoteExpensesErrors;
}) {
  const { t, format, errorText } = useLocale();
  const rateText = useRateText();
  const [picking, setPicking] = useState(false);
  const billExpenses = new Map(bill.expenses.map((expense) => [expense.id, expense]));
  const money = (value: string) => format.money(value, { decimals: 2 });
  const listError = errors?.root?.message ?? errors?.message;

  const update = (index: number, amount: string) => {
    onChange(expenses.map((expense, at) => (at === index ? { ...expense, amount } : expense)));
  };
  const remove = (index: number) => {
    onChange(expenses.filter((_, at) => at !== index));
  };
  const add = (expense: BillExpense): boolean => {
    if (expenses.length >= MAX_BILL_EXPENSES) return false;
    onChange([...expenses, expenseToDebit(expense)]);
    return true;
  };

  // A value that is shown, not typed: its label hides on a wide card, like a box's
  const cell = (label: string, value: ReactNode, amount: boolean) => (
    <div className="grid content-start gap-1.5">
      <span className="text-label font-medium text-ink @3xl:sr-only">{label}</span>
      <span
        className={cn('py-2.5 text-body-sm tabular-nums', amount && 'font-medium @3xl:text-right')}
      >
        {value}
      </span>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <Card className="@container grid grid-cols-1 overflow-hidden">
      <CardHeader
        title={t('debitNotes.expensesTitle')}
        subtitle={t('debitNotes.expensesSubtitle')}
      />
      {expenses.length > 0 && (
        <div
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={cn(
            'mt-3 hidden bg-subtle px-5 py-2 text-caption font-medium text-ink-3 @3xl:grid',
            EXPENSE_COLUMNS,
          )}
        >
          <span>{t('salesLines.description')}</span>
          <span>{t('salesLines.vatRate')}</span>
          <span className="text-right">{t('debitNotes.expenseAmount')}</span>
          <span className="text-right">{t('salesLines.amount')}</span>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className={cn('grid grid-cols-1', expenses.length === 0 && 'mt-3')}>
        {expenses.map((expense, index) => {
          const source = billExpenses.get(expense.billExpenseId);
          if (!source) return null;
          const number = index + 1;
          const id = `expenses.${String(index)}.amount`;
          const expenseErrors = errors?.[index];
          const error = expenseErrors?.amount?.message ?? expenseErrors?.billExpenseId?.message;
          const amounts = draftExpenseAmounts(
            { amount: expense.amount, taxRateId: source.taxRate.id },
            source.taxRate.rate,
            pricesIncludeVat,
          );
          return (
            <div
              key={expense.billExpenseId}
              role="group"
              aria-label={t('salesLines.line', { number })}
              className={cn(
                'grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 border-t border-line px-5 py-4',
                EXPENSE_COLUMNS,
              )}
            >
              <div className="col-span-2 grid min-w-0 content-start gap-0.5 @3xl:col-span-1">
                <span className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="pt-2 text-body-sm text-ink">{source.description}</span>
                  <span className="@3xl:hidden">
                    <IconButton
                      icon={Delete02Icon}
                      label={t('debitNotes.removeExpense', { number })}
                      onClick={() => {
                        remove(index);
                      }}
                    />
                  </span>
                </span>
                <span className="text-caption text-ink-3 tabular-nums">
                  {t('debitNotes.leftToDebit', { amount: money(debitLeft(source)) })}
                </span>
              </div>
              {cell(
                t('salesLines.vatRate'),
                `${source.taxRate.name} · ${rateText(source.taxRate.rate)}`,
                false,
              )}
              <SalesField id={id} label={t('debitNotes.expenseAmount')} error={error}>
                <MoneyInput
                  id={id}
                  value={expense.amount}
                  invalid={error !== undefined}
                  aria-describedby={error ? `${id}-error` : undefined}
                  onChange={(value) => {
                    update(index, value);
                  }}
                />
              </SalesField>
              {cell(
                t('salesLines.amount'),
                amounts ? money(pricesIncludeVat ? amounts.total : amounts.net) : '—',
                true,
              )}
              <div className="hidden @3xl:block @3xl:pt-1">
                <IconButton
                  icon={Delete02Icon}
                  label={t('debitNotes.removeExpense', { number })}
                  onClick={() => {
                    remove(index);
                  }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      {listError && (
        <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 border-t border-line px-5 py-3 text-label text-crit">
          <HugeiconsIcon icon={Alert02Icon} size={15} strokeWidth={1.5} className="shrink-0" />
          {errorText(listError)}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="border-t border-line px-5 py-3">
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          size="sm"
          onClick={() => {
            setPicking(true);
          }}
        >
          <HugeiconsIcon icon={PlusSignIcon} size={16} strokeWidth={1.5} />
          {t('debitNotes.addExpenses')}
        </Button>
      </div>
      <Dialog open={picking} onOpenChange={setPicking}>
        {picking && (
          <ExpensePicker
            bill={bill}
            onForm={new Set(expenses.map((expense) => expense.billExpenseId))}
            add={add}
          />
        )}
      </Dialog>
    </Card>
  );
}

// "Add bill expenses": the bill's expenses with money left to take off. Each click adds one with
// what is left of it.
function ExpensePicker({
  bill,
  onForm,
  add,
}: {
  bill: Bill;
  onForm: ReadonlySet<string>;
  add: (expense: BillExpense) => boolean;
}) {
  const { t, format } = useLocale();
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState<string | null>(null);
  // What was on the form when the dialog opened: an expense added here stays in the list, marked
  const [open] = useState(() => debitableExpenses(bill.expenses, onForm));
  const [added, setAdded] = useState<ReadonlySet<string>>(new Set());

  return (
    <DialogContent
      title={t('debitNotes.expensePickerTitle')}
      description={t('debitNotes.expensePickerDescription')}
    >
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4">
        <PickProblem message={problem} />
        {open.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={InvoiceIcon}
            title={t('debitNotes.expensePickerEmpty')}
            description={t('debitNotes.expensePickerDescription')}
          />
        ) : (
          <ul className="grid max-h-[min(420px,55dvh)] grid-cols-1 gap-px overflow-y-auto">
            {open.map((expense) => (
              <li
                key={expense.id}
                className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg px-2 py-2 hover:bg-subtle"
              >
                <span className="grid min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className="truncate text-body-sm font-medium">{expense.description}</span>
                  <span className="truncate text-caption text-ink-3 tabular-nums">
                    {t('debitNotes.leftToDebit', {
                      amount: format.money(debitLeft(expense), { decimals: 2 }),
                    })}
                  </span>
                </span>
                <PickButton
                  added={added.has(expense.id)}
                  loading={false}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setProblem(null);
                    if (added.has(expense.id)) return;
                    if (add(expense)) setAdded((before) => new Set(before).add(expense.id));
                    else setProblem(t('salesLines.tooMany', { max: MAX_BILL_EXPENSES }));
                  }}
                />
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>
    </DialogContent>
  );
}
```

- **`DebitNoteExpensesEditor` is a card of its own,** shown only for a bill with expenses: an expense is taken off by
  money only, so its row is the description, the bill expense's rate, the amount and what it comes to.
- **A row is keyed by its bill expense,** which is on the form once (`debit_note_expense_twice`), so the key is
  stable when a row above it is removed.
- **`ExpensePicker` keeps the list it opened with:** an expense added in the dialog stays in the list with a tick,
  instead of jumping out from under the pointer.

```tsx
import { Calendar03Icon, Delete02Icon, UserIcon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { HugeiconsIcon } from '@hugeicons/react';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import {
  type Bill,
  contractErrorMap,
  type DebitNote,
  type DebitNoteExpenseFormValues,
  type DebitNoteFormValues,
  type DebitNoteLineFormValues,
  type DebitNoteReason,
  DEBIT_NOTE_REASONS,
  type PartyRef,
  plainQuantity,
  routes,
  updateDebitNoteInputSchema,
} from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import {
  Button,
  Card,
  Checkbox,
  FormAlert,
  FormField,
  Input,
  PageHeader,
  SelectField,
  TextField,
  toast,
} from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useMutation, useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useNavigate } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { lazy, Suspense, useState } from 'react';
import { Controller, type Path, useForm, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form';

import { call } from '../lib/api';
import { applyApiError } from '../lib/field-errors';
import { rowPath } from '../lib/products';
import { debitFormTotals, debitLineItem, toDebitFormLine } from '../lib/purchase-returns';
import { billQuery, branchesQuery, postedBillsQuery, taxRatesQuery } from '../lib/queries';
import { debitReasonKey } from '../lib/returns';
import { Fact } from './adjustment-view';
import type { DebitReturnSource } from './debit-note-lines';
import { failureOf } from './journal-parts';
import { PurchaseBackLink, usePurchaseRefresh } from './purchase-parts';
import { SalesTotals } from './sales-parts';
import { useTenantId } from './stock-parts';

// The debit note form (step 17d): its own chunk, loaded by routes/debit-note.tsx. The supplier, then
// one of their posted bills (or none, decision 9), then the lines and expenses that come off it.
// The credit note form of 15d seen from the buyer's side.

// The editors, the supplier box and the date box as chunks of their own, like the credit note
// form's: they bring the money boxes and the popover
const DebitNoteLinesEditor = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('./debit-note-lines')).DebitNoteLinesEditor,
}));
const DebitNoteExpensesEditor = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('./debit-note-lines')).DebitNoteExpensesEditor,
}));
const PartyPicker = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('./party-picker')).PartyPicker,
}));
const DatePicker = lazy(async () => ({ default: (await import('./date-input')).DatePicker }));

type FormValues = DebitNoteFormValues;

function fieldNames(lines: number, expenses: number): Path<FormValues>[] {
  return [
    'supplierId',
    'billId',
    'date',
    'branchId',
    'pricesIncludeVat',
    'reason',
    'supplierCreditNumber',
    'supplierCreditDate',
    'note',
    'lines',
    'expenses',
    ...Array.from({ length: lines }, (_, index) => [
      rowPath('lines', index, 'billLineId'),
      rowPath('lines', index, 'returnLineId'),
      rowPath('lines', index, 'taxRateId'),
      rowPath('lines', index, 'unitId'),
      rowPath('lines', index, 'quantity'),
      rowPath('lines', index, 'description'),
      rowPath('lines', index, 'unitPrice'),
      rowPath('lines', index, 'discountType'),
      rowPath('lines', index, 'discount'),
    ]).flat(),
    ...Array.from({ length: expenses }, (_, index) => [
      rowPath('expenses', index, 'billExpenseId'),
      rowPath('expenses', index, 'amount'),
    ]).flat(),
  ];
}

// What a new debit note starts with: "Write debit note" on a bill (no lines), "Debit whole bill"
// is saved by the bill's page itself, and "Write debit note" on a return (that return's lines of
// its first bill still to debit, or its lines on their own without a bill)
export interface DebitNoteStart {
  supplier: PartyRef;
  bill: Bill | null;
  lines: DebitNoteLineFormValues[];
  expenses: DebitNoteExpenseFormValues[];
  returnSources: readonly (readonly [string, DebitReturnSource])[];
  reason: DebitNoteReason;
}

// Writing a new debit note, or changing a draft. "Save draft" keeps it a draft; "Post debit note"
// saves and posts in one request: the purchase, its VAT and what the company owes come off, and its
// money is applied to its bill, all or nothing.
export function DebitNoteForm({
  debitNote,
  start,
  today,
}: {
  debitNote: DebitNote | null;
  start: DebitNoteStart | null;
  today: string;
}) {
  const { t, format } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const refresh = usePurchaseRefresh();
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);
  const branches = useQuery(branchesQuery(tenantId, 'active')).data ?? [];
  const rates = useQuery(taxRatesQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const rateOf = (id: string) => rates?.find((rate) => rate.id === id)?.rate ?? null;
  const savedSupplier = debitNote?.supplier ?? start?.supplier ?? null;
  // The return number and item of each return line on the form, for its row
  const [returnSources, setReturnSources] = useState<ReadonlyMap<string, DebitReturnSource>>(
    () =>
      new Map([
        ...(debitNote?.lines ?? []).flatMap((line) =>
          line.returnLineId !== null && line.returnNumber !== null
            ? [
                [
                  line.returnLineId,
                  { number: line.returnNumber, item: debitLineItem(line) },
                ] as const,
              ]
            : [],
        ),
        ...(start?.returnSources ?? []),
      ]),
  );
  const {
    register,
    control,
    handleSubmit,
    setError,
    setValue,
    getValues,
    formState: { errors, isSubmitting },
  } = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(updateDebitNoteInputSchema, { error: contractErrorMap }),
    defaultValues: {
      supplierId: savedSupplier?.id ?? '',
      billId: debitNote?.bill?.id ?? start?.bill?.id ?? '',
      date: debitNote?.date ?? today,
      // Read by the server only without a bill; one branch needs no choice
      branchId:
        debitNote?.branchId ??
        start?.bill?.branchId ??
        (branches.length === 1 ? (branches[0]?.id ?? '') : ''),
      pricesIncludeVat: debitNote?.pricesIncludeVat ?? start?.bill?.pricesIncludeVat ?? false,
      reason:
        DEBIT_NOTE_REASONS.find((reason) => reason === debitNote?.reason) ??
        start?.reason ??
        'price_adjustment',
      supplierCreditNumber: debitNote?.supplierCreditNumber ?? '',
      supplierCreditDate: debitNote?.supplierCreditDate ?? '',
      note: debitNote?.note ?? '',
      lines: debitNote?.lines.map(toDebitFormLine) ?? start?.lines ?? [],
      expenses:
        debitNote?.expenses.map((expense) => ({
          billExpenseId: expense.billExpenseId,
          amount: plainQuantity(expense.amount),
        })) ??
        start?.expenses ??
        [],
      post: false,
      version: debitNote?.version ?? 1,
    },
  });
  const supplierId = useWatch({ control, name: 'supplierId' });
  const billId = useWatch({ control, name: 'billId' }) ?? '';
  const lines = useWatch({ control, name: 'lines' });
  const expenses = useWatch({ control, name: 'expenses' });
  const ownPricing = useWatch({ control, name: 'pricesIncludeVat' });
  const bill = useQuery({ ...billQuery(tenantId, billId), enabled: billId !== '' }).data ?? null;
  const postedBills = useQuery({
    ...postedBillsQuery(tenantId, supplierId),
    enabled: supplierId !== '',
  }).data;
  // Lines of one bill never sit under another: the supplier and bill boxes wait until the lines
  // and expenses are gone
  const locked = lines.length > 0 || expenses.length > 0;
  // A debit note for a bill writes its prices the bill's way, whatever the box says (the server
  // takes the bill's), so a line debited in full takes off exactly what it charged
  const pricesIncludeVat = billId === '' ? ownPricing : (bill?.pricesIncludeVat ?? ownPricing);
  const totals = debitFormTotals(lines, expenses, bill, rateOf, pricesIncludeVat);
  const money = (value: string) => format.money(value, { decimals: 2 });
```

- **`DebitNoteStart` is what a new debit note opens with:** the supplier, the bill or none, the lines from a return,
  and their return sources. The route works it out; the form only starts from it.
- **The supplier is a form value with a box of its own** (decision 42). Changing it empties the bill, because another
  supplier's bill is not this one's to debit.
- **The branch and "prices include VAT" are sent either way** (the contract has them); the server reads them only
  without a bill. The branch starts as the bill's or the only branch.
- **`pricesIncludeVat` on the page follows the bill** whatever the box says, the same rule as the server's, so the
  totals shown are the ones posting books.
- **Both boxes lock while lines or expenses are on the form:** a line names a bill line, and moving it under another
  bill would make it wrong.

```tsx
  // The bill box: "No bill" first (decision 9), the supplier's posted bills, and the draft's own
  // bill when it is older than the 100 the list reads
  const billOptions = [
    {
      value: '',
      label: supplierId === '' ? t('debitNotes.pickSupplierFirst') : t('debitNotes.billNone'),
    },
    ...(postedBills ?? []).map((posted) => ({
      value: posted.id,
      label: t('debitNotes.billOption', {
        number: posted.number ?? '',
        supplierBillNumber: posted.supplierBillNumber,
        total: money(posted.total),
      }),
    })),
    ...(debitNote?.bill &&
    supplierId === debitNote.supplier.id &&
    !(postedBills ?? []).some((posted) => posted.id === debitNote.bill?.id)
      ? [{ value: debitNote.bill.id, label: debitNote.bill.number }]
      : []),
  ];
  const billHint = locked
    ? t('debitNotes.billLocked')
    : supplierId !== '' && postedBills?.length === 0
      ? t('debitNotes.noBills')
      : billId === ''
        ? t('debitNotes.noBillHint')
        : t('debitNotes.billHint');

  const save = (post: boolean) =>
    handleSubmit(async ({ version, ...values }) => {
      try {
        const body = { ...values, post };
        const saved = debitNote
          ? await call(routes.debitNotes.update, {
              params: { id: debitNote.id },
              body: { ...body, version },
            })
          : await call(routes.debitNotes.create, { body });
        await refresh();
        toast(
          saved.status === 'posted'
            ? t('debitNotes.posted', { number: saved.number ?? '' })
            : t('debitNotes.draftSaved'),
        );
        if (!debitNote) {
          void navigate({
            to: '/debit-notes/$debitNoteId',
            params: { debitNoteId: saved.id },
            replace: true,
          });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        applyApiError(
          error,
          fieldNames(getValues('lines').length, getValues('expenses').length),
          setError,
        );
      }
    });

  const removeDraft = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (draft: DebitNote) =>
      call(routes.debitNotes.remove, {
        params: { id: draft.id },
        query: { version: draft.version },
      }),
    onSuccess: async () => {
      await refresh();
      toast(t('debitNotes.deleted'));
      void navigate({ to: '/debit-notes' });
    },
  });

  const failure = errors.root?.server?.message ?? failureOf(removeDraft.error);

  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
      <PurchaseBackLink to="/debit-notes" label={t('debitNotes.back')} />
      <PageHeader
        title={debitNote ? t('debitNotes.draftTitle') : t('debitNotes.newTitle')}
        description={t('debitNotes.description')}
      />
      <form
        noValidate
        onSubmit={(event) => void save(false)(event)}
        className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5"
      >
        {failure && <FormAlert message={failure} />}
        <Card className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 p-5 sm:grid-cols-2 sm:gap-x-4 lg:grid-cols-3">
          <FormField
            control={control}
            name="supplierId"
            label={t('debitNotes.supplier')}
            hint={locked ? t('debitNotes.billLocked') : undefined}
          >
            {(field) => (
              <Suspense fallback={<Input id={field.id} icon={UserIcon} disabled />}>
                <PartyPicker
                  {...field}
                  role="supplier"
                  saved={savedSupplier}
                  disabled={locked}
                  onChange={(next) => {
                    setValue('supplierId', next, {
                      shouldValidate: errors.supplierId !== undefined,
                    });
                    // Another supplier's bill is not this one's to debit
                    setValue('billId', '');
                  }}
                />
              </Suspense>
            )}
          </FormField>
          <div className="sm:col-span-2">
            {/* Controlled, not registered: the options come from a query that answers after the
                form already holds its bill (a debit note started from a bill or a return) */}
            <Controller
              control={control}
              name="billId"
              render={({ field }) => (
                <SelectField
                  {...field}
                  value={field.value ?? ''}
                  label={t('debitNotes.bill')}
                  hint={billHint}
                  options={billOptions}
                  disabled={supplierId === '' || locked}
                  error={errors.billId?.message}
                />
              )}
            />
          </div>
          <FormField control={control} name="date" label={t('debitNotes.date')}>
            {(field) => (
              <Suspense fallback={<Input id={field.id} icon={Calendar03Icon} disabled />}>
                <DatePicker {...field} />
              </Suspense>
            )}
          </FormField>
          <SelectField
            label={t('debitNotes.reason')}
            options={DEBIT_NOTE_REASONS.map((reason) => ({
              value: reason,
              label: t(debitReasonKey(reason)),
            }))}
            {...register('reason')}
            error={errors.reason?.message}
          />
          {billId === '' ? (
            <SelectField
              label={t('debitNotes.branch')}
              hint={t('debitNotes.branchHint')}
              options={[
                { value: '', label: t('debitNotes.branch') },
                ...branches.map((branch) => ({ value: branch.id, label: branch.name })),
              ]}
              {...register('branchId')}
              error={errors.branchId?.message}
            />
          ) : (
            <Fact
              label={t('debitNotes.branch')}
              value={
                bill
                  ? `${branches.find((branch) => branch.id === bill.branchId)?.name ?? '—'} · ${t('debitNotes.branchFromBill')}`
                  : '—'
              }
            />
          )}
          <TextField
            label={t('debitNotes.supplierCreditNumber')}
            optional
            hint={t('debitNotes.supplierCreditNumberHint')}
            placeholder={t('debitNotes.supplierCreditNumberPlaceholder')}
            autoComplete="off"
            {...register('supplierCreditNumber')}
            error={errors.supplierCreditNumber?.message}
          />
          <FormField
            control={control}
            name="supplierCreditDate"
            label={t('debitNotes.supplierCreditDate')}
            optional
          >
            {(field) => (
              <Suspense fallback={<Input id={field.id} icon={Calendar03Icon} disabled />}>
                <DatePicker {...field} value={field.value ?? ''} />
              </Suspense>
            )}
          </FormField>
          <div className="grid gap-2">
            <Controller
              control={control}
              name="pricesIncludeVat"
              render={({ field }) => (
                <Checkbox
                  id="pricesIncludeVat"
                  label={t('debitNotes.pricesIncludeVat')}
                  checked={pricesIncludeVat}
                  disabled={billId !== '' || locked}
                  onCheckedChange={(checked) => {
                    field.onChange(checked === true);
                  }}
                />
              )}
            />
            <p className="pl-[27px] text-label text-ink-3">
              {t('debitNotes.pricesIncludeVatHint')}
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="sm:col-span-2 lg:col-span-3">
            <TextField
              label={t('debitNotes.note')}
              optional
              placeholder={t('debitNotes.notePlaceholder')}
              {...register('note')}
              error={errors.note?.message}
            />
          </div>
        </Card>

        <Controller
          control={control}
          name="lines"
          render={({ field }) => (
            <Suspense fallback={<Card className="min-h-24" />}>
              <DebitNoteLinesEditor
                lines={field.value}
                onChange={field.onChange}
                getLines={() => getValues('lines')}
                bill={bill}
                supplierId={supplierId}
                pricesIncludeVat={pricesIncludeVat}
                returnSources={returnSources}
                onReturnSources={(entries) => {
                  setReturnSources((before) => new Map([...before, ...entries]));
                }}
                errors={errors.lines}
              />
            </Suspense>
          )}
        />
        {bill && (bill.expenses.length > 0 || expenses.length > 0) && (
          <Controller
            control={control}
            name="expenses"
            render={({ field }) => (
              <Suspense fallback={<Card className="min-h-24" />}>
                <DebitNoteExpensesEditor
                  expenses={field.value}
                  onChange={field.onChange}
                  bill={bill}
                  pricesIncludeVat={pricesIncludeVat}
                  errors={errors.expenses}
                />
              </Suspense>
            )}
          />
        )}
        {(lines.length > 0 || expenses.length > 0) && (
          <Card className="overflow-hidden">
            <SalesTotals totals={totals} pricesIncludeVat={pricesIncludeVat} />
          </Card>
        )}

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2">
          {debitNote && (
            <div className="mr-auto flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                disabled={removeDraft.isPending}
                onClick={() => {
                  if (confirming) removeDraft.mutate(debitNote);
                  else setConfirming(true);
                }}
              >
                <HugeiconsIcon icon={Delete02Icon} size={17} strokeWidth={1.5} />
                {confirming ? t('debitNotes.confirmDelete') : t('debitNotes.deleteDraft')}
              </Button>
              {confirming && (
                <span className="text-body-sm text-ink-2">{t('debitNotes.deleteWarning')}</span>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          <Button type="submit" variant="secondary" disabled={isSubmitting}>
            {t('debitNotes.saveDraft')}
          </Button>
          <Button
            disabled={isSubmitting || (lines.length === 0 && expenses.length === 0)}
            onClick={() => void save(true)()}
          >
            {isSubmitting ? t('debitNotes.posting') : t('debitNotes.post')}
          </Button>
        </div>
        <p className="text-right text-label text-ink-3">{t('debitNotes.postHint')}</p>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}
```

- **The bill box's first choice is "No bill"** (decision 42), then the supplier's posted bills with their own bill
  numbers, which is how the supplier's accountant names them. A draft's own bill is added when it is older than the
  100 the list reads, so the box never shows a blank for a saved draft.
- **The hint says what each choice means:** with a bill, the VAT is the bill's; without, the lines are returned
  goods with a typed price and rate; while locked, how to unlock.
- **The supplier's credit note number and date** sit under the dates, both optional; a date without a number is
  refused by the contract (`debit_note_supplier_credit_required`).
- **One totals card under both editors,** like the bill's (17c): the total counts the expenses too.
- **"Post debit note" needs a line or an expense,** the contract's own rule, so the button waits for one.

```tsx
import { MoneyReceiveCircleIcon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { HugeiconsIcon } from '@hugeicons/react';
import { type DebitNote, isZeroMoney, routes, subtractMoney, unappliedOf } from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import { Button, Card, cn, Dialog, PageHeader } from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Link, useNavigate } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { lazy, Suspense, useState } from 'react';

import { call } from '../lib/api';
import { useCan } from '../lib/permissions';
import { debitReasonKey } from '../lib/returns';
import { accountsQuery, branchesQuery } from '../lib/queries';
import { Fact } from './adjustment-view';
import { EntryLinks } from './entry-links';
import { ExpensesTable } from './expenses-table';
import { DebitNotePrint, PrintButton } from './print-documents';
import { PurchaseBackLink, SupplierLink } from './purchase-parts';
import { SalesLinesTable } from './sales-lines-table';
import { DocumentNotice, LINK_NUMBER, LINK_ROW, LinkList } from './sales-parts';
import { DocumentStatusPill } from './sales-pills';
import { useIsoDate, useTenantId } from './stock-parts';

// "Apply money" is the supplier payment's dialog (payment-dialogs.tsx), loaded when it opens
const BillApplyForm = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('./payment-dialogs')).BillApplyForm,
}));

const LINK = 'font-medium text-brand underline-offset-3 hover:underline';

// A posted debit note (or a draft for someone who may not write them), read only, like the credit
// note of 15d. A posted one never changes (17d.1: no void). Where its money went can: "Apply money"
// moves it over the supplier's bills, and "Record money back" records the supplier paying what is
// left back with a supplier refund.
export function DebitNoteView({ debitNote }: { debitNote: DebitNote }) {
  const { t, format } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isoDate = useIsoDate();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const accounts = useQuery(accountsQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const branches = useQuery(branchesQuery(tenantId, 'active')).data;
  const can = useCan();
  const canWrite = can('purchase.debit_note.manage');
  const canRefund = can('purchase.refund.manage');
  const [applying, setApplying] = useState(false);
  const money = (value: string) => format.money(value, { decimals: 2 });
  const posted = debitNote.status === 'posted';
  const { bill } = debitNote;
  const unapplied = unappliedOf({
    amount: debitNote.total,
    applied: debitNote.applied,
    refunded: debitNote.refunded,
  });
  const hasExpenses = debitNote.expenses.length > 0;

  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
      <PurchaseBackLink to="/debit-notes" label={t('debitNotes.back')} />
      <PageHeader
        title={debitNote.number ?? t('debitNotes.draftTitle')}
        description={debitNote.supplier.name}
        actions={
          <>
            <DocumentStatusPill
              status={debitNote.status}
              label={t(`debitNotes.statuses.${debitNote.status}`)}
            />
            {posted && <PrintButton />}
          </>
        }
      />
      {posted && !isZeroMoney(unapplied) && (
        <DocumentNotice tone="neutral">
          {t('debitNotes.unappliedNotice', { amount: money(unapplied) })}
        </DocumentNotice>
      )}
      <Card className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-6 gap-y-4 p-5 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <div className="grid min-w-0 gap-0.5">
          <span className="text-caption font-medium text-ink-3">{t('debitNotes.supplier')}</span>
          <span className="text-body-sm">
            <SupplierLink supplier={debitNote.supplier} />
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="grid min-w-0 gap-0.5">
          <span className="text-caption font-medium text-ink-3">{t('debitNotes.bill')}</span>
          {bill === null ? (
            <span className="text-body-sm text-ink-2">{t('debitNotes.noBillColumn')}</span>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Link
                to="/bills/$billId"
                params={{ billId: bill.id }}
                className={cn('font-mono text-body-sm tabular-nums', LINK)}
              >
                {bill.number}
              </Link>
              <span className="text-caption text-ink-3 tabular-nums">
                {bill.supplierBillNumber} · {isoDate(bill.date)}
              </span>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
        <Fact label={t('debitNotes.date')} value={isoDate(debitNote.date)} />
        <Fact label={t('debitNotes.reason')} value={t(debitReasonKey(debitNote.reason))} />
        <Fact
          label={t('debitNotes.branch')}
          value={branches?.find((branch) => branch.id === debitNote.branchId)?.name ?? '—'}
        />
        {debitNote.supplierCreditNumber !== null && (
          <Fact
            label={t('debitNotes.supplierCreditNumber')}
            value={
              debitNote.supplierCreditDate === null
                ? debitNote.supplierCreditNumber
                : `${debitNote.supplierCreditNumber} · ${isoDate(debitNote.supplierCreditDate)}`
            }
          />
        )}
        {posted && (
          <>
            <Fact label={t('debitNotes.applied')} value={money(debitNote.applied)} />
            {!isZeroMoney(debitNote.refunded) && (
              <Fact label={t('debitNotes.refunded')} value={money(debitNote.refunded)} />
            )}
          </>
        )}
        {debitNote.postedAt !== null && (
          <Fact
            label={t('debitNotes.statuses.posted')}
            // A moment, not a date: shown in the reader's own time zone
            value={t('debitNotes.postedOn', { date: format.date(new Date(debitNote.postedAt)) })}
          />
        )}
        {posted && (
          <EntryLinks
            label={t('debitNotes.entry')}
            entries={debitNote.entry ? [debitNote.entry] : []}
            none={t('debitNotes.noEntry')}
          />
        )}
        {debitNote.note !== null && (
          <div className="sm:col-span-3">
            <Fact label={t('debitNotes.note')} value={debitNote.note} />
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>
      {debitNote.lines.length > 0 && (
        <SalesLinesTable
          lines={debitNote.lines}
          // With expenses, the totals sit under them: they count both
          totals={hasExpenses ? null : debitNote}
          pricesIncludeVat={debitNote.pricesIncludeVat}
          note={(line) =>
            line.returnNumber !== null && (
              <span className="text-caption text-ink-3">
                {t('debitNotes.fromReturn', { number: line.returnNumber })}
              </span>
            )
          }
        />
      )}
      {hasExpenses && (
        <ExpensesTable
          title={t('debitNotes.expensesTitle')}
          subtitle={t('debitNotes.expensesSubtitle')}
          expenses={debitNote.expenses}
          totals={debitNote}
          pricesIncludeVat={debitNote.pricesIncludeVat}
          accountOf={(id) => accounts?.find((account) => account.id === id)}
        />
      )}

      {posted && (
        <LinkList
          title={t('debitNotes.billsTitle')}
          empty={debitNote.allocations.length === 0 ? t('debitNotes.noAllocations') : undefined}
        >
          {debitNote.allocations.map((allocation) => (
            <li key={allocation.billId}>
              <Link to="/bills/$billId" params={{ billId: allocation.billId }} className={LINK_ROW}>
                <span className={LINK_NUMBER}>{allocation.billNumber}</span>
                <span className="text-ink-2">
                  {t('supplierPayments.supplierBill', { number: allocation.supplierBillNumber })}
                </span>
                <span className="ml-auto font-medium tabular-nums">{money(allocation.amount)}</span>
              </Link>
            </li>
          ))}
        </LinkList>
      )}

      {posted && (canWrite || canRefund) && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2">
          {canRefund && !isZeroMoney(unapplied) && (
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() =>
                void navigate({
                  to: '/supplier-refunds/new',
                  search: { debitNoteId: debitNote.id },
                })
              }
            >
              <HugeiconsIcon icon={MoneyReceiveCircleIcon} size={17} strokeWidth={1.5} />
              {t('debitNotes.refund')}
            </Button>
          )}
          {canWrite && (
            <Button
              onClick={() => {
                setApplying(true);
              }}
            >
              {t('debitNotes.apply')}
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      <Dialog open={applying} onOpenChange={setApplying}>
        <Suspense fallback={null}>
          {applying && (
            <BillApplyForm
              title={t('debitNotes.applyDialogTitle', { number: debitNote.number ?? '' })}
              supplierId={debitNote.supplier.id}
              // What refunds paid back cannot go on a bill too (debit_note_over_allocated)
              amount={subtractMoney(debitNote.total, debitNote.refunded)}
              version={debitNote.version}
              allocations={debitNote.allocations}
              document="debit_note"
              save={async (body) => {
                const saved = await call(routes.debitNotes.allocate, {
                  params: { id: debitNote.id },
                  body,
                });
                return t('debitNotes.allocated', { number: saved.number ?? '' });
              }}
              onDone={() => {
                setApplying(false);
              }}
            />
          )}
        </Suspense>
      </Dialog>
      {posted && <DebitNotePrint debitNote={debitNote} />}
    </div>
  );
}
```

A posted debit note, read only (17d.1: no void). The bill links to its page with the supplier's bill number and date
under it; without a bill it says so. With expenses, the lines table has no totals and the expenses table carries them,
because the total counts both. "Bills it took money off" lists where its money went. "Record money back" opens a
supplier refund with this debit note while money is left; "Apply money" moves the money over the supplier's bills
with the shared dialog, capped at the total less what refunds paid back (`debit_note_over_allocated`).

```tsx
import { AlertCircleIcon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import type { Bill, PurchaseReturn } from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import { EmptyState } from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useParams, useSearch } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { lazy, Suspense } from 'react';

import type { DebitNoteStart } from '../components/debit-note-form';
import { PurchaseBackLink } from '../components/purchase-parts';
import { useTenantId, useToday } from '../components/stock-parts';
import { useCan } from '../lib/permissions';
import {
  debitableReturnLines,
  debitStartOf,
  ownReturnLineToDebit,
  returnLineItem,
  returnLineToDebit,
} from '../lib/purchase-returns';
import {
  billQuery,
  branchesQuery,
  debitNoteQuery,
  purchaseReturnQuery,
  unitsQuery,
} from '../lib/queries';

// The page loads the data and picks the form or the view, each a lazy chunk of its own
const DebitNoteForm = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('../components/debit-note-form')).DebitNoteForm,
}));
const DebitNoteView = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('../components/debit-note-view')).DebitNoteView,
}));

// The units (the lines) and the branches (the form's default branch is worked out once, as it
// opens)
function useReady(): boolean {
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const units = useQuery(unitsQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const branches = useQuery(branchesQuery(tenantId, 'active')).data;
  return units !== undefined && branches !== undefined;
}

function CantFind({ message }: { message: string }) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
      <PurchaseBackLink to="/debit-notes" label={t('debitNotes.back')} />
      <EmptyState icon={AlertCircleIcon} title={t('debitNotes.title')} description={message} />
    </div>
  );
}

// What a new debit note starts with. From a return: its goods of the first bill not debited yet at
// that bill's prices, or (no bill left) its lines on their own, for a debit note without a bill.
// From a bill: the bill, no lines. Only a posted bill or return can be debited; anything else
// starts the form empty.
function startOf(
  bill: Bill | undefined,
  purchaseReturn: PurchaseReturn | undefined,
): DebitNoteStart | null {
  const postedBill = bill?.status === 'posted' ? bill : null;
  if (purchaseReturn?.status === 'posted') {
    const billLines = new Map(postedBill?.lines.map((line) => [line.id, line]));
    const lines = debitableReturnLines(purchaseReturn, postedBill?.id ?? null, new Set()).flatMap(
      (line) => {
        if (postedBill === null) return [{ line, debit: ownReturnLineToDebit(line) }];
        const billLine = billLines.get(line.billLineId ?? '');
        return billLine ? [{ line, debit: returnLineToDebit(line, billLine) }] : [];
      },
    );
    return {
      supplier: purchaseReturn.supplier,
      bill: postedBill,
      lines: lines.map((entry) => entry.debit),
      expenses: [],
      returnSources: lines.map(
        (entry) =>
          [
            entry.line.id,
            { number: purchaseReturn.number ?? '', item: returnLineItem(entry.line) },
          ] as const,
      ),
      reason: 'goods_returned',
    };
  }
  if (postedBill === null) return null;
  return {
    supplier: postedBill.supplier,
    bill: postedBill,
    lines: [],
    expenses: [],
    returnSources: [],
    reason: 'price_adjustment',
  };
}

// A new debit note. "Write debit note" on a bill comes with ?billId=; on a return with ?returnId=,
// and then the bill is the first one that billed goods of the return not debited yet, or none.
export function NewDebitNotePage() {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const canWrite = useCan()('purchase.debit_note.manage');
  const today = useToday();
  const ready = useReady();
  const { billId = '', returnId = '' } = useSearch({ strict: false });
  const purchaseReturn = useQuery({
    ...purchaseReturnQuery(tenantId, returnId),
    enabled: returnId !== '',
  });
  const fromReturn = purchaseReturn.data ? debitStartOf(purchaseReturn.data) : null;
  const startId = returnId === '' ? billId : (fromReturn?.billId ?? '');
  const bill = useQuery({ ...billQuery(tenantId, startId), enabled: startId !== '' });
  if (!canWrite) {
    return (
      <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
        <PurchaseBackLink to="/debit-notes" label={t('debitNotes.back')} />
        <p className="text-body-sm text-ink-3">{t('debitNotes.cantWrite')}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (purchaseReturn.isError) return <CantFind message={t('purchaseReturns.notFound')} />;
  if (bill.isError) return <CantFind message={t('bills.notFound')} />;
  // The form waits for its start: drawing it empty and filling it a moment later would let the
  // person type into a form that is about to be replaced
  if (!ready || (returnId !== '' && !purchaseReturn.data) || (startId !== '' && !bill.data)) {
    return null;
  }
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={null}>
      <DebitNoteForm
        debitNote={null}
        start={startOf(bill.data, purchaseReturn.data)}
        today={today}
      />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

export function DebitNotePage() {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const { debitNoteId = '' } = useParams({ strict: false });
  const canWrite = useCan()('purchase.debit_note.manage');
  const today = useToday();
  const ready = useReady();
  const { data: debitNote, isError } = useQuery({
    ...debitNoteQuery(tenantId, debitNoteId),
    enabled: debitNoteId !== '',
  });

  if (isError) return <CantFind message={t('debitNotes.notFound')} />;
  if (!debitNote || !ready) return null;
  if (debitNote.status === 'draft' && canWrite) {
    // key: a saved draft comes back with a new version, and the form starts from it again
    return (
      <Suspense fallback={null}>
        <DebitNoteForm
          key={`${debitNote.id}-${String(debitNote.version)}`}
          debitNote={debitNote}
          start={null}
          today={today}
        />
      </Suspense>
    );
  }
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={null}>
      <DebitNoteView debitNote={debitNote} />
    </Suspense>
  );
}
```

- **`startOf()` builds the start:** from a return, its goods of `debitStartOf()`'s bill at that bill's prices, or
  its lines on their own without a bill (reason "Goods sent back"); from a bill, the bill with no lines (reason "Price
  cut", the usual reason to open a bill and write one). Anything not posted starts the form empty.
- **The page waits for the return, then for the bill it names,** so the form opens once, filled.
- **`useReady()` waits for the units and the branches:** the lines need the units, and the form's default branch is
  worked out once, as it opens.

import { NoteRemoveIcon, PlusSignIcon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { HugeiconsIcon } from '@hugeicons/react';
import {
  DEBIT_NOTE_STATUSES,
  type DebitNoteStatus,
  type DebitNoteSummary,
  unappliedOf,
} from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import {
  Button,

} from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useInfiniteQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useNavigate } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { SupplierFilter } from '../components/purchase-parts';
import { DocumentStatusPill } from '../components/sales-pills';
import { useIsoDate, useTenantId } from '../components/stock-parts';
import { useCan } from '../lib/permissions';
import { debitNotesQuery } from '../lib/queries';

const column = dataTableColumns<DebitNoteSummary>();

// What the supplier still owes back on a debit note: its total, less what is applied to bills and
// what supplier refunds paid back
function unappliedOfNote(note: DebitNoteSummary): string {
  return unappliedOf({ amount: note.total, applied: note.applied, refunded: note.refunded });
}

// The debit notes (step 17d): which bill each takes money off, how much, and what is left of it,
// like the credit notes of 15d
export function DebitNotesPage() {
  const { t, format } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const canWrite = useCan()('purchase.debit_note.manage');
  const isoDate = useIsoDate();
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<DebitNoteStatus | ''>('');
  const [supplierId, setSupplierId] = useState('');
  const { data, isError, hasNextPage, isFetchingNextPage, fetchNextPage } = useInfiniteQuery(
    debitNotesQuery(useTenantId(), { status, supplierId }),
  );
  const rows = useMemo(() => data?.pages.flatMap((page) => page.items), [data]);
  const loadMore = useCallback(() => {
    if (hasNextPage && !isFetchingNextPage) void fetchNextPage();
  }, [hasNextPage, isFetchingNextPage, fetchNextPage]);

  const columns = useMemo(
    () =>
      column.columns([
        column.accessor('number', {
          header: t('debitNotes.columns.number'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { card: 'title' },
          cell: ({ row }) => (
            <span className="grid">
              <span className="font-mono font-medium tabular-nums">
                {row.original.number ?? t('debitNotes.statuses.draft')}
              </span>
              <span className="text-caption text-ink-3 tabular-nums">
                {isoDate(row.original.date)}
              </span>
            </span>
          ),
        }),
        column.accessor((note) => note.supplier.name, {
          id: 'supplier',
          header: t('debitNotes.columns.supplier'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { card: 'subtitle' },
          cell: ({ row }) => (
            <span className="grid min-w-0 max-w-[18rem]">
              <span className="truncate">{row.original.supplier.name}</span>
              <span className="truncate font-mono text-caption text-ink-3">
                {row.original.supplier.code}
              </span>
            </span>
          ),
        }),
        column.accessor((note) => note.bill?.number ?? null, {
          id: 'bill',
          header: t('debitNotes.columns.bill'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { card: 'detail' },
          // Decision 9: a debit note without a bill says so, not an empty cell
          cell: ({ getValue }) => {
            const number = getValue();
            return number === null ? (
              <span className="text-ink-3">{t('debitNotes.noBillColumn')}</span>
            ) : (
              <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">{number}</span>
            );
          },
        }),
        column.accessor('total', {
          header: t('debitNotes.columns.total'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { align: 'end', card: 'detail' },
          // A list shows whole taka; the debit note's page shows paisa
          cell: ({ getValue }) => <span className="font-medium">{format.money(getValue())}</span>,
        }),
        column.accessor((note) => unappliedOfNote(note), {
          id: 'unapplied',
          header: t('debitNotes.columns.unapplied'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { align: 'end', card: 'detail' },
          // A draft holds no money yet
          cell: ({ row, getValue }) =>
            row.original.status === 'draft' ? (
              <span className="text-ink-3">—</span>

              format.money(getValue())
            ),
        }),
        column.accessor('status', {
          header: t('debitNotes.columns.status'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { card: 'trailing' },
          cell: ({ getValue }) => (
            <DocumentStatusPill
              status={getValue()}
              label={t(`debitNotes.statuses.${getValue()}`)}
            />
          ),
        }),
      ]),
    [t, format, isoDate],
  );

  const write = canWrite && (
    <Button onClick={() => void navigate({ to: '/debit-notes/new' })}>
      <HugeiconsIcon icon={PlusSignIcon} size={17} strokeWidth={1.5} />
      {t('debitNotes.new')}

  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
      <PageHeader
        title={t('debitNotes.title')}

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-3">

            saved={null}
            onChange={setSupplierId}
