  rows say `payment_bill_invalid` and `payment_over_bill`, a debit note's `debit_note_allocation_invalid` and
  `debit_note_over_bill`, each under the row the form shows.
- **What refunds paid back cannot be applied,** and **a payment with a refund is not voided** (`payment_has_refunds`):
  that refund would pay back money that was never paid. The page hides "Void payment" for the same reason; the
  mock refuses it anyway, like the API.

### Returns, debit notes and refunds: `mocks/purchase-return-data.ts` (new)

```ts
import {
  addMoney,
  addQuantity,
  compareMoney,
  compareQuantity,
  type DebitNote,
  type DebitNoteInput,
  type DebitNoteLine,
  type DebitNoteStatus,
  defaultLineDescription,
  documentTotals,
  type DocumentRef,
  type EntryRef,
  type ErrorCode,
  expenseLineAmounts,
  fitsDecimals,
  isZeroMoney,
  keptQuantity,
  lineAmounts,
  type LineAmounts,
  moneyAccountIds,
  negateMoney,
  overAllocated,
  prorateMoney,
  type PurchaseReturn,
  type PurchaseReturnInput,
  type PurchaseReturnLine,
  type SalesLineInput,
  type StockDocumentStatus,
  subtractMoney,
  subtractQuantity,
  sumMoney,
  sumQuantity,
  type SupplierRefund,
  type SupplierRefundInput,
  type SupplierRefundStatus,
  toBaseQuantity,
  unappliedOf,
  unappliedPaymentOf,
} from '@omnivo/contracts';

import {
  allocationRefs,
  type Amount,
  asStored,
  assertBranch,
  assertPeriodOpen,
  type BillAllocationErrors,
  checkBillAllocations,
  dueOn,
  type MockBill,
  type MockBillAllocation,
  paymentSummaryOf,
  priceDifferenceAccount,
  purposeAccount,
  receiptLineOf,
  refundedFrom,
  summed,
} from './bill-data';
import { refOf, side } from './invoice-data';
import { findEntry, postNew, postStockEntry, reverseEntry } from './journal-data';
import { MockProblem } from './mock';
import { supplierOf } from './purchase-order-data';
import { fieldProblem, newestFirst, now, seriesNumber } from './sales-document-data';
import {
  assertDate,
  assertWarehouses,
  averageCostOf,
  bookAccounts,
  branchOf,
  decimalsOf,
  issuesError,
  postMoves,
  resolveLines,
} from './stock-data';
import type { WorkspaceData } from './workspace-data';

// The mock's step 17d: purchase returns, debit notes and supplier refunds. The API's rules
// (purchase-returns.service.ts, debit-notes.service.ts, supplier-refunds.service.ts and their
// books) on plain arrays, shortened, so `pnpm dev:mock` and the e2e tests walk the same paths as
// the real API. None of them needs an approval (decision 5): "Post" posts.

// A return as stored. What debit notes took off each line, the goods receipts it names and the
// debit notes written for it are worked out on read, like the API's joins.
export type MockPurchaseReturnLine = Omit<PurchaseReturnLine, 'debitedQuantity'>;
export type MockPurchaseReturn = Omit<PurchaseReturn, 'lines' | 'receipts' | 'debitNotes'> & {
  lines: MockPurchaseReturnLine[];
};

// A debit note as stored: the bills its money is applied to, by id, like a supplier payment's.
// What it applied and what refunds paid back from it are worked out on read.
export type MockDebitNote = Omit<DebitNote, 'applied' | 'refunded' | 'allocations'> & {
  allocations: MockBillAllocation[];
};

function conflict(code: ErrorCode): MockProblem {
  return new MockProblem(409, code);
}
```

- **A return line stores everything but `debitedQuantity`,** which the posted debit notes give on read. Its
  receipt's and bill's numbers are stored: a posted receipt and a posted bill never change their numbers.
- **A debit note stores its allocations by bill id,** like a payment: what it applied and what refunds paid back are
  worked out on read.

```ts
// --- Purchase returns ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

type ReturnFields = Omit<PurchaseReturnInput, 'post'>;

// What a line names, as the form sends it and as a draft keeps it
interface ReturnLineRefs {
  receiptLineId: string | null;
  variantId: string;
  unitId: string;
  quantity: string;
  batchId: string | null;
  serialNumbers: readonly string[];
}

export function findPurchaseReturn(data: WorkspaceData, id: string): MockPurchaseReturn {
  const found = data.purchase.returns.find((item) => item.id === id);
  if (!found) throw new MockProblem(404, 'not_found');
  return found;
}

// What posted debit note lines took off for a return line, in the base unit: the API's
// purchase_return_lines.debited_quantity
function debitedQuantityOf(data: WorkspaceData, returnLineId: string): string {
  return sumQuantity(
    data.purchase.debitNotes
      .filter((item) => item.status === 'posted')
      .flatMap((item) => item.lines)
      .filter((line) => line.returnLineId === returnLineId)
      .map((line) => line.baseQuantity),
  );
}

const byNumber = (a: DocumentRef, b: DocumentRef) => (a.number ?? '').localeCompare(b.number ?? '');

export function toPurchaseReturn(data: WorkspaceData, stored: MockPurchaseReturn): PurchaseReturn {
  const receipts = new Map<string, DocumentRef>();
  for (const line of stored.lines) {
    const found = line.receiptLineId === null ? undefined : receiptLineOf(data, line.receiptLineId);
    if (found)
      receipts.set(found.receipt.id, { id: found.receipt.id, number: found.receipt.number });
  }
  const lineIds = new Set(stored.lines.map((line) => line.id));
  // Drafts too: a second debit note for the same goods is then easy to spot
  const debitNotes = data.purchase.debitNotes
    .filter((item) =>
      item.lines.some((line) => line.returnLineId !== null && lineIds.has(line.returnLineId)),
    )
    .map((item) => ({ id: item.id, number: item.number }));
  return {
    ...stored,
    lines: stored.lines.map((line) => ({
      ...line,
      debitedQuantity: debitedQuantityOf(data, line.id),
    })),
    receipts: [...receipts.values()].toSorted(byNumber),
    debitNotes: debitNotes.toSorted(byNumber),
  };
}

export function listPurchaseReturns(
  data: WorkspaceData,
  query: {
    status?: StockDocumentStatus | undefined;
    supplierId?: string | undefined;
    warehouseId?: string | undefined;
  },
): PurchaseReturn[] {
  return newestFirst(data.purchase.returns)
    .filter(
      (item) =>
        (query.status === undefined || item.status === query.status) &&
        (query.supplierId === undefined || item.supplier.id === query.supplierId) &&
        (query.warehouseId === undefined || item.warehouseId === query.warehouseId),
    )
    .map((item) => toPurchaseReturn(data, item));
}
```

- **A return lists its debit notes with the drafts,** like the API: a second debit note for the same goods is then
  easy to spot on the return's page.

```ts
// The API's checkLines(): a line from a receipt line is a line of a posted goods receipt of this
// supplier, of the same item (in any of its units), with the receipt line's batch, no more than it
// kept (accepted less what went back already), and only serial numbers that came in on it. A line
// on its own is a stock line that goes out (an existing batch), of an item with an average cost to
// leave at (decision 2). Every problem at once, under its own line.
function checkReturnLines(
  data: WorkspaceData,
  supplierId: string,
  lines: readonly ReturnLineRefs[],
) {
  const receiptOf = (line: ReturnLineRefs) =>
    line.receiptLineId === null ? undefined : receiptLineOf(data, line.receiptLineId);
  const issues: { path: string; code: ErrorCode }[] = [];
  lines.forEach((line, index) => {
    if (line.receiptLineId === null) return;
    const found = receiptOf(line);
    if (
      found?.receipt.supplier.id !== supplierId ||
      found.receipt.status !== 'posted' ||
      found.line.variantId !== line.variantId
    ) {
      issues.push({
        path: `lines.${String(index)}.receiptLineId`,
        code: 'purchase_return_receipt_line_invalid',
      });
    }
  });
  if (issues.length > 0) throw issuesError(issues);

  // A receipt line's goods go back in its own batch: the form sends none, and a stored draft line
  // keeps the one written when it was saved
  const resolved = resolveLines(
    data,
    lines.map((line) => ({
      variantId: line.variantId,
      unitId: line.unitId,
      quantity: line.quantity,
      batchId: receiptOf(line)?.line.batchId ?? line.batchId,
      serialNumbers: [...line.serialNumbers],
    })),
    'out',
  );
  resolved.forEach((line, index) => {
    const typed = lines[index];
    const found = typed === undefined ? undefined : receiptOf(typed);
    if (found === undefined) {
      // A line on its own leaves at the average cost: an item that never had one has nothing to
      // leave at
      if (averageCostOf(data.stock, line.variantId) === null) {
        issues.push({
          path: `lines.${String(index)}.variantId`,
          code: 'purchase_return_cost_unknown',
        });
      }
      return;
    }
    if (compareQuantity(line.baseQuantity, keptQuantity(found.line)) > 0) {
      issues.push({
        path: `lines.${String(index)}.quantity`,
        code: 'purchase_return_over_received',
      });
    }
    const came = new Set(found.line.serialNumbers);
    if (line.serialNumbers.some((serial) => !came.has(serial))) {
      issues.push({
        path: `lines.${String(index)}.serialNumbers`,
        code: 'purchase_return_serial_invalid',
      });
    }
  });
  if (issues.length > 0) throw issuesError(issues);
  return resolved.map((line, index) => {
    const typed = lines[index];
    return { line, receipt: typed === undefined ? undefined : receiptOf(typed) };
  });
}

// A new draft, or a draft changed. Its number comes at posting. A draft keeps its supplier after
// it was archived, like every draft.
export function savePurchaseReturn(
  data: WorkspaceData,
  input: ReturnFields,
  existing?: MockPurchaseReturn,
): MockPurchaseReturn {
  if (existing && existing.status !== 'draft') throw conflict('stock_not_draft');
  const supplier = supplierOf(data, input.supplierId, existing?.supplier.id ?? null);
  assertWarehouses(data, [{ field: 'warehouseId', id: input.warehouseId }]);
  const checked = checkReturnLines(data, supplier.id, input.lines);
  const saved: MockPurchaseReturn = {
    id: existing?.id ?? crypto.randomUUID(),
    number: null,
    date: input.date,
    supplier,
    warehouseId: input.warehouseId,
    reason: input.reason,
    status: 'draft',
    note: input.note,
    lineCount: checked.length,
    postedAt: null,
    version: (existing?.version ?? 0) + 1,
    updatedAt: now(),
    lines: checked.map(({ line, receipt }) => ({
      ...line,
      receiptLineId: receipt?.line.id ?? null,
      receiptNumber: receipt?.receipt.number ?? null,
      // Set at posting, from the bill that billed the receipt line by then
      billed: false,
      billLineId: null,
      billId: null,
      billNumber: null,
      value: null,
    })),
    entry: null,
  };
  const { returns } = data.purchase;
  data.purchase.returns = existing
    ? returns.map((item) => (item.id === saved.id ? saved : item))
    : [saved, ...returns];
  return saved;
}

// Only a draft. It sent nothing back, so nothing is undone.
export function removePurchaseReturn(data: WorkspaceData, target: MockPurchaseReturn): void {
  if (target.status !== 'draft') throw conflict('stock_not_draft');
  data.purchase.returns = data.purchase.returns.filter((item) => item.id !== target.id);
}
```

- **`checkReturnLines()` is the API's `checkLines()`:** a receipt line of a posted receipt of this supplier, of the
  same item; no more than it kept; only serial numbers that came in on it; and a line on its own needs an average
  cost to leave at (`purchase_return_cost_unknown`, under the item). Every problem at once, each under its line.
- **A receipt line's goods go back in its own batch:** the contract refuses a batch on such a line, and the check
  hands the receipt line's to the stock rules, so a tracked item never asks the store keeper for one.
- **Billing is set at posting, not at saving:** a draft holds nothing (decision 10), and a bill may bill the receipt
  line in between.

```ts
// What `quantity` going back from a receipt line puts back on goods received not billed: its share
// of what the line came in at, counted over everything sent back from it so far, so a line that
// goes back in three goes gives back exactly its value (the API's returnValue)
function returnValue(
  line: { value: string | null; baseQuantity: string; returnedQuantity: string },
  quantity: string,
): string {
  if (line.value === null) throw new Error('A posted receipt line has no value');
  const after = addQuantity(line.returnedQuantity, quantity);
  return subtractMoney(
    prorateMoney(line.value, after, line.baseQuantity),
    prorateMoney(line.value, line.returnedQuantity, line.baseQuantity),
  );
}

// The posted bill line that billed a receipt line, with its bill
function billingOf(data: WorkspaceData, receiptLineId: string) {
  for (const bill of data.purchase.bills) {
    if (bill.status !== 'posted') continue;
    const line = bill.lines.find((item) => item.receiptLineId === receiptLineId);
    if (line) return { bill, line };
  }
  return undefined;
}

// What went back before a bill billed it comes off its order line (decision 3): the received
// quantity comes down, and a received order is approved again (partly received), so the supplier
// can send the goods again on it. An approved one gets a new version too (its page shows old
// received quantities). A closed order keeps its status and its version.
function returnOnOrder(data: WorkspaceData, orderLineId: string, quantity: string): void {
  for (const order of data.purchase.orders) {
    const line = order.lines.find((item) => item.id === orderLineId);
    if (!line) continue;
    line.receivedQuantity = subtractQuantity(line.receivedQuantity, quantity);
    if (order.status === 'received' || order.status === 'approved') {
      Object.assign(order, { status: 'approved', version: order.version + 1, updatedAt: now() });
    }
    return;
  }
}

// The API's postAndLog(), in its order: the date, the warehouse, the supplier and the lines checked
// again, the number, the stock out (a receipt line's at the cost it came in at, a line of its own
// at the average cost), the bill line of each billed receipt line, the receipt lines and the
// orders, and the cost booked back. The handler runs it in a transaction(): a refused step leaves
// nothing, not even the number.
export function postPurchaseReturn(data: WorkspaceData, draft: MockPurchaseReturn): void {
  if (draft.status !== 'draft') throw conflict('stock_not_draft');
  assertDate(data, draft.date);
  assertPeriodOpen(data, draft.date);
  assertWarehouses(data, [{ field: 'warehouseId', id: draft.warehouseId }]);
  // Active now: the return goes in the supplier's file
  supplierOf(data, draft.supplier.id, null);
  // Again: another return may have sent the same goods back since the draft was saved
  const checked = checkReturnLines(data, draft.supplier.id, draft.lines);
  const accounts = bookAccounts(data);
  const notBilled = accounts.use('received_not_billed');
  data.purchase.counters.return += 1;
  const number = seriesNumber(data, 'purchase.return', data.purchase.counters.return, draft.date);

  // What each line puts back on goods received not billed: a receipt line's cost; a line on its
  // own at the average cost (null: the stock posting works it out)
  const given = checked.map(({ line, receipt }) =>
    receipt === undefined ? null : returnValue(receipt.line, line.baseQuantity),
  );
  const moved = postMoves(
    data,
    { date: draft.date, kind: 'purchase_return', direction: 'out', documentId: draft.id, number },
    checked.map(({ line }, index) => ({
      line: index,
      warehouseId: draft.warehouseId,
      stockLine: line,
      batchId: line.batchId,
      quantity: line.baseQuantity,
      serialNumbers: line.serialNumbers,
      value: given[index] ?? null,
    })),
  );
  const values = checked.map((_, index) => given[index] ?? moved[index] ?? '0');

  const lines = draft.lines.map((line, index): MockPurchaseReturnLine => {
    const receipt = checked[index]?.receipt;
    // Billed already: a debit note takes the money off this bill line
    const billed = receipt?.line.billed === true ? billingOf(data, receipt.line.id) : undefined;
    return {
      ...line,
      billed: billed !== undefined,
      billLineId: billed?.line.id ?? null,
      billId: billed?.bill.id ?? null,
      billNumber: billed?.bill.number ?? null,
      value: values[index] ?? null,
    };
  });
  // What went back, on each receipt line; not billed yet and from an order: the order counts it
  // as not received
  checked.forEach(({ line, receipt }) => {
    if (receipt === undefined) return;
    receipt.line.returnedQuantity = addQuantity(receipt.line.returnedQuantity, line.baseQuantity);
    if (!receipt.line.billed && receipt.line.orderLineId !== null) {
      returnOnOrder(data, receipt.line.orderLineId, line.baseQuantity);
    }
  });

  // Dr Goods received not billed at the receipt's cost (the branch of the receipt's warehouse; a
  // line of its own: the return warehouse's) / Cr Inventory at what the stock gave up (the return
  // warehouse's branch). The two differ only when the stock could not give the receipt's cost
  // (decision 32); the difference goes to the price difference account.
  const inventoryBranch = branchOf(data, draft.warehouseId);
  const difference = sumMoney(
    values.map((value, index) => subtractMoney(moved[index] ?? '0', value)),
  );
  const entry = postStockEntry(data, {
    date: draft.date,
    source: 'purchase_return',
    document: { id: draft.id, number },
    narration: `Purchase return ${number}`,
    amounts: [
      ...values.map((value, index) => ({
        accountId: notBilled,
        branchId: branchOf(data, checked[index]?.receipt?.receipt.warehouseId ?? draft.warehouseId),
        amount: value,
      })),
      ...moved.map((value) => ({
        accountId: accounts.inventory,
        branchId: inventoryBranch,
        amount: negateMoney(value),
      })),
      ...(isZeroMoney(difference)
        ? []
        : [
            {
              accountId: priceDifferenceAccount(data),
              branchId: inventoryBranch,
              amount: difference,
            },
          ]),
    ],
  });
  Object.assign(draft, {
    lines,
    number,
    entry,
    status: 'posted',
    postedAt: now(),
    version: draft.version + 1,
    updatedAt: now(),
  });
}
```

- **`returnValue()` counts over everything sent back so far,** the API's way: three returns of one line give back
  exactly its value, with no paisa lost to rounding.
- **`returnOnOrder()` is decision 3:** what went back before a bill comes off its order line, and a received order is
  approved again (partly received), so the supplier can send the goods again on it. A closed order keeps its status.
- **`postPurchaseReturn()` runs the API's steps in their order:** the date, the period, the warehouse, the supplier
  and the lines checked again, the accounts (a missing one refuses before anything moves), the number, the stock out
  at the receipt's cost, the lines' billing and values, the receipt lines and the orders, and the entry last.
- **The entry is decision 1 with decision 32:** Dr goods received not billed at the receipt's cost (with the branch
  of the receipt's warehouse), Cr inventory at what the stock gave up, and the difference, when the stock could not
  give the receipt's cost, on the price difference account.

```ts
// --- Debit notes --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

type DebitNoteFields = Omit<DebitNoteInput, 'post'>;

// What a line names, as the form sends it and as a draft keeps it
interface DebitLineRefs {
  billLineId: string | null;
  returnLineId: string | null;
  // Only on a debit note without a bill; a line of a bill takes the bill line's rate
  taxRateId: string | null;
  unitId: string;
  quantity: string;
  description: string | null;
  unitPrice: string;
  discountType: SalesLineInput['discountType'];
  discount: string;
}

const DEBIT_NOTE_ERRORS = {
  bill: 'debit_note_allocation_invalid',
  over: 'debit_note_over_bill',
} as const satisfies BillAllocationErrors;

export function findDebitNote(data: WorkspaceData, id: string): MockDebitNote {
  const found = data.purchase.debitNotes.find((item) => item.id === id);
  if (!found) throw new MockProblem(404, 'not_found');
  return found;
}

export function toDebitNote(data: WorkspaceData, stored: MockDebitNote): DebitNote {
  const { allocations, ...debitNote } = stored;
  return {
    ...debitNote,
    applied: sumMoney(allocations.map((allocation) => allocation.amount)),
    refunded: refundedFrom(data, 'debit_note', stored.id),
    allocations: allocationRefs(data, allocations),
  };
}

export function listDebitNotes(
  data: WorkspaceData,
  query: {
    status?: DebitNoteStatus | undefined;
    supplierId?: string | undefined;
    billId?: string | undefined;
  },
): DebitNote[] {
  return newestFirst(data.purchase.debitNotes)
    .filter(
      (item) =>
        (query.status === undefined || item.status === query.status) &&
        (query.supplierId === undefined || item.supplier.id === query.supplierId) &&
        (query.billId === undefined || item.bill?.id === query.billId),
    )
    .map((item) => toDebitNote(data, item));
}

// The bill a debit note debits: a posted bill of this workspace
function postedBill(data: WorkspaceData, billId: string): MockBill & { number: string } {
  const bill = data.purchase.bills.find((item) => item.id === billId);
  const number = bill?.number ?? null;
  if (bill?.status !== 'posted' || number === null) {
    throw fieldProblem('debit_note_bill_invalid', 'billId');
  }
  return Object.assign(bill, { number });
}

// A return line, with its return
function returnLineOf(data: WorkspaceData, returnLineId: string) {
  for (const purchaseReturn of data.purchase.returns) {
    const line = purchaseReturn.lines.find((item) => item.id === returnLineId);
    if (line) return { purchaseReturn, line };
  }
  return undefined;
}

// A stored line as the check reads it again at posting. A line of a bill names no rate: only a
// line without a bill keeps its own.
function storedRefs(line: DebitNoteLine): DebitLineRefs {
  return {
    billLineId: line.billLineId,
    returnLineId: line.returnLineId,
    taxRateId: line.billLineId === null ? line.taxRate.id : null,
    unitId: line.unitId,
    quantity: line.quantity,
    description: line.description,
    unitPrice: line.unitPrice,
    discountType: line.discountType,
    discount: line.discount,
  };
}
```

- **`postedBill()` returns the stored bill,** not a copy: the posting writes `debited` on its lines and expenses.
  `Object.assign()` narrows its number to a string for TypeScript without a cast; the value does not change.
- **`storedRefs()` gives a stored line back as the form sent it:** a line of a bill names no VAT rate (the bill
  line's is used), a line without a bill names its own. Posting checks the stored lines again with it.

```ts
// The API's resolve(). With a bill: each line debits a line of that bill, in any unit of its item,
// at the VAT the bill line claimed and the bill's price setting, so debiting a line in full takes
// off exactly what it charged. Without a bill (decision 9): each line names a return line of its
// own of this supplier, with that line's item and a VAT rate of the workspace. The caps: no line
// more than its bill line's quantity; a return line no more than went back less what was debited;
// the lines on one bill line no more money than it charged less what posted debit notes took off.
// Every problem at once, under its own line.
function resolveDebitLines(
  data: WorkspaceData,
  supplierId: string,
  bill: MockBill | null,
  pricesIncludeVat: boolean,
  lines: readonly DebitLineRefs[],
  keptRateIds: ReadonlySet<string>,
): { line: DebitNoteLine; amounts: LineAmounts }[] {
  const issues: { path: string; code: ErrorCode }[] = [];
  const resolved = lines.flatMap((input, index) => {
    const at = (field: string, code: ErrorCode) => {
      issues.push({ path: `lines.${String(index)}.${field}`, code });
    };
    const billed =
      bill === null || input.billLineId === null
        ? undefined
        : bill.lines.find((line) => line.id === input.billLineId);
    const back = input.returnLineId === null ? undefined : returnLineOf(data, input.returnLineId);
    let item: Omit<
      DebitNoteLine,
      | 'id'
      | 'unitId'
      | 'quantity'
      | 'baseQuantity'
      | 'description'
      | 'unitPrice'
      | 'discountType'
      | 'discount'
      | 'net'
      | 'vat'
      | 'total'
      | 'billLineId'
      | 'returnLineId'
      | 'returnNumber'
    >;
    if (bill !== null) {
      if (billed === undefined) {
        at('billLineId', 'debit_note_line_invalid');
        return [];
      }
      item = { ...billed, taxRate: billed.taxRate };
    } else {
      // Without a bill: a return line on its own, of a posted return of this supplier
      if (
        back?.purchaseReturn.supplier.id !== supplierId ||
        back.purchaseReturn.status !== 'posted' ||
        back.line.receiptLineId !== null
      ) {
        at('returnLineId', 'debit_note_return_invalid');
        return [];
      }
      const rate = data.sales.taxRates.find((candidate) => candidate.id === input.taxRateId);
      if (!rate || (rate.archivedAt !== null && !keptRateIds.has(rate.id))) {
        at('taxRateId', 'tax_rate_invalid');
        return [];
      }
      // Only goods go back on a return
      item = {
        ...back.line,
        productType: 'goods',
        taxRate: { id: rate.id, name: rate.name, kind: rate.kind, rate: rate.rate },
      };
    }
    // Any unit of the item: 3 strips off a line of 2 boxes
    const factor =
      input.unitId === item.baseUnitId
        ? '1'
        : item.units.find((pack) => pack.unitId === input.unitId)?.factor;
    if (factor === undefined) {
      at('unitId', 'stock_unit_invalid');
      return [];
    }
    if (!fitsDecimals(input.quantity, decimalsOf(data, input.unitId))) {
      at('quantity', 'stock_quantity_decimals');
      return [];
    }
    const baseQuantity = toBaseQuantity(input.quantity, factor, decimalsOf(data, item.baseUnitId));
    if (billed !== undefined && compareQuantity(baseQuantity, billed.baseQuantity) > 0) {
      at('quantity', 'debit_note_over_quantity');
    }
    // With a bill, the return line this bill line billed, on a posted return
    if (
      bill !== null &&
      input.returnLineId !== null &&
      (back?.line.billLineId !== billed?.id || back?.purchaseReturn.status !== 'posted')
    ) {
      at('returnLineId', 'debit_note_return_invalid');
    }
    if (
      back !== undefined &&
      compareQuantity(
        baseQuantity,
        subtractQuantity(back.line.baseQuantity, debitedQuantityOf(data, back.line.id)),
      ) > 0
    ) {
      at('quantity', 'debit_note_over_return');
    }
    const amounts = lineAmounts(
      {
        quantity: input.quantity,
        unitPrice: input.unitPrice,
        discountType: input.discountType,
        discount: input.discount,
        rate: item.taxRate.rate,
      },
      pricesIncludeVat,
    );
    const line: DebitNoteLine = {
      variantId: item.variantId,
      productId: item.productId,
      productCode: item.productCode,
      productName: item.productName,
      optionValues: item.optionValues,
      sku: item.sku,
      baseUnitId: item.baseUnitId,
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      productType: item.productType,
      tracking: item.tracking,
      hasExpiry: item.hasExpiry,
      units: item.units,
      unitId: input.unitId,
      quantity: addQuantity(input.quantity, '0'),
      baseQuantity,
      description: input.description ?? defaultLineDescription(item),
      unitPrice: addMoney(input.unitPrice, '0'),
      discountType: input.discountType,
      discount: addMoney(input.discount, '0'),
      taxRate: item.taxRate,
      net: amounts.net,
      vat: amounts.vat,
      total: amounts.total,
      billLineId: billed?.id ?? null,
      returnLineId: input.returnLineId,
      returnNumber: back?.purchaseReturn.number ?? null,
    };
    return [{ line, amounts }];
  });
  if (issues.length > 0) throw issuesError(issues);

  // The money on each bill line, all of this debit note's lines on it together
  const byBillLine = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const { line } of resolved) {
    if (line.billLineId === null) continue;
    byBillLine.set(line.billLineId, [...(byBillLine.get(line.billLineId) ?? []), line.total]);
  }
  for (const [id, totals] of byBillLine) {
    const billed = bill?.lines.find((line) => line.id === id);
    if (billed === undefined) continue;
    if (compareMoney(sumMoney(totals), subtractMoney(billed.total, billed.debited)) <= 0) continue;
    // Under every line that takes from it: the person decides which one to lower
    lines.forEach((line, index) => {
      if (line.billLineId === id) {
        issues.push({ path: `lines.${String(index)}.unitPrice`, code: 'debit_note_over_line' });
      }
    });
  }
  if (issues.length > 0) throw issuesError(issues);
  return resolved;
}

// The bill's expenses, debited by money at the expense's own VAT and the bill's price setting,
// each no more than it charged less what posted debit notes took off
function resolveDebitExpenses(
  bill: MockBill,
  expenses: readonly { billExpenseId: string; amount: string }[],
): { expense: DebitNote['expenses'][number]; amounts: LineAmounts }[] {
  const issues: { path: string; code: ErrorCode }[] = [];
  const resolved = expenses.flatMap((input, index) => {
    const billed = bill.expenses.find((expense) => expense.id === input.billExpenseId);
    if (billed === undefined) {
      issues.push({
        path: `expenses.${String(index)}.billExpenseId`,
        code: 'debit_note_expense_invalid',
      });
      return [];
    }
    const amounts = expenseLineAmounts(
      { amount: input.amount, rate: billed.taxRate.rate },
      bill.pricesIncludeVat,
    );
    if (compareMoney(amounts.total, subtractMoney(billed.total, billed.debited)) > 0) {
      issues.push({ path: `expenses.${String(index)}.amount`, code: 'debit_note_over_line' });
    }
    return [
      {
        expense: {
          id: crypto.randomUUID(),
          billExpenseId: billed.id,
          accountId: billed.accountId,
          description: billed.description,
          amount: addMoney(input.amount, '0'),
          taxRate: billed.taxRate,
          net: amounts.net,
          vat: amounts.vat,
          total: amounts.total,
        },
        amounts,
      },
    ];
  });
  if (issues.length > 0) throw issuesError(issues);
  return resolved;
}

// A debit note is written for something the bill billed, so it is not dated before it
function assertDebitDate(date: string, bill: MockBill): void {
  if (date < bill.date) throw fieldProblem('debit_note_date', 'date');
}
```

- **`resolveDebitLines()` is the API's `resolve()`.** With a bill, a line takes the bill line's item and VAT rate,
  whatever the form sent, so the VAT taken off is the VAT that was claimed. Without a bill (decision 9), a line names
  a return line on its own of a posted return of this supplier, and a VAT rate of the workspace.
- **The caps are 17d.1's:** a line no more than its bill line's quantity; a return line no more than went back less
  what posted debit notes took; all the lines on one bill line no more money than it charged less what was debited,
  that error under every line that takes from it.
- **An expense is debited by money,** at its own VAT rate and the bill's price setting, no more than is left of it.

```ts
// A new draft, or a draft changed. With a bill: the bill's supplier, branch and price setting,
// whatever the form sent (decision 19). A draft keeps its supplier and its VAT rates after they
// were archived, like every draft.
export function saveDebitNote(
  data: WorkspaceData,
  input: DebitNoteFields,
  existing?: MockDebitNote,
): MockDebitNote {
  if (existing && existing.status !== 'draft') throw conflict('purchase_not_draft');
  const supplier = supplierOf(data, input.supplierId, existing?.supplier.id ?? null);
  const bill = input.billId === null ? null : postedBill(data, input.billId);
  if (bill !== null && bill.supplier.id !== supplier.id) {
    throw fieldProblem('debit_note_bill_invalid', 'billId');
  }
  if (bill !== null) assertDebitDate(input.date, bill);
  // The contract makes sure a debit note without a bill names a branch
  const branchId = bill?.branchId ?? input.branchId;
  if (branchId === null) throw new Error('A debit note without a bill names no branch');
  if (bill === null) assertBranch(data, branchId);
  const pricesIncludeVat = bill?.pricesIncludeVat ?? input.pricesIncludeVat;
  const keptRateIds = new Set(existing?.lines.map((line) => line.taxRate.id) ?? []);
  const lines = resolveDebitLines(
    data,
    supplier.id,
    bill,
    pricesIncludeVat,
    input.lines,
    keptRateIds,
  );
  const expenses = bill === null ? [] : resolveDebitExpenses(bill, input.expenses);
  const saved: MockDebitNote = {
    id: existing?.id ?? crypto.randomUUID(),
    number: null,
    date: input.date,
    supplier,
    bill:
      bill === null
        ? null
        : {
            id: bill.id,
            number: bill.number,
            date: bill.date,
            supplierBillNumber: bill.supplierBillNumber,
          },
    branchId,
    reason: input.reason,
    status: 'draft',
    supplierCreditNumber: input.supplierCreditNumber,
    supplierCreditDate: input.supplierCreditDate,
    ...documentTotals([
      ...lines.map((item) => item.amounts),
      ...expenses.map((item) => item.amounts),
    ]),
    lineCount: lines.length,
    postedAt: null,
    version: (existing?.version ?? 0) + 1,
    updatedAt: now(),
    pricesIncludeVat,
    note: input.note,
    lines: lines.map((item) => item.line),
    expenses: expenses.map((item) => item.expense),
    allocations: [],
    entry: null,
  };
  const { debitNotes } = data.purchase;
  data.purchase.debitNotes = existing
    ? debitNotes.map((item) => (item.id === saved.id ? saved : item))
    : [saved, ...debitNotes];
  return saved;
}

// Only a draft. It took nothing off, so nothing is undone.
export function removeDebitNote(data: WorkspaceData, target: MockDebitNote): void {
  if (target.status !== 'draft') throw conflict('purchase_not_draft');
  data.purchase.debitNotes = data.purchase.debitNotes.filter((item) => item.id !== target.id);
}

// Replaces its allocations with `wanted`, each row checked like a supplier payment's (decision 24)
function applyDebitAllocations(
  data: WorkspaceData,
  debitNote: MockDebitNote,
  wanted: readonly MockBillAllocation[],
): void {
  checkBillAllocations(data, {
    supplierId: debitNote.supplier.id,
    current: debitNote.allocations,
    wanted,
    errors: DEBIT_NOTE_ERRORS,
  });
  debitNote.allocations = asStored(wanted);
}
```

- **With a bill, its branch and price setting win** (decision 19): what the form sent for them is used only without
  a bill. A bill of another supplier, or a date before the bill's, is refused under its own box.
- **`applyDebitAllocations()` uses the payments' check,** with the debit note's codes. It replaces the whole list,
  like the API.

```ts
// What `quantity` of a return line takes off goods received not billed: its share of what the
// return put there, counted over everything debited from the line so far (the API's returnShare)
function returnShare(data: WorkspaceData, line: MockPurchaseReturnLine, quantity: string): string {
  if (line.value === null) throw new Error('A posted return line has no value');
  const debited = debitedQuantityOf(data, line.id);
  const after = addQuantity(debited, quantity);
  return subtractMoney(
    prorateMoney(line.value, after, line.baseQuantity),
    prorateMoney(line.value, debited, line.baseQuantity),
  );
}

// The entry (decision 1): Dr Accounts payable (the supplier) for the total / Cr Goods received not
// billed for the goods' receipt cost (the branch where the return put it back) / Cr or Dr the price
// difference for the rest of a goods line's net / Cr a service line's or an expense's account / Cr
// VAT input. Everything else on the debit note's branch. Worked out before the posting changes
// what the return lines say was debited.
function debitNoteAmounts(
  data: WorkspaceData,
  draft: MockDebitNote,
  bill: MockBill | null,
): Amount[] {
  const at = (accountId: string, amount: string, branchId = draft.branchId): Amount => ({
    accountId,
    branchId,
    partyId: null,
    amount,
  });
  const amounts: Amount[] = [
    {
      accountId: purposeAccount(data, 'accounts_payable'),
      branchId: draft.branchId,
      partyId: draft.supplier.id,
      amount: draft.total,
    },
  ];
  for (const line of draft.lines) {
    const accountId =
      line.billLineId === null
        ? null
        : (bill?.lines.find((item) => item.id === line.billLineId)?.accountId ?? null);
    if (accountId !== null) {
      amounts.push(at(accountId, negateMoney(line.net)));
      continue;
    }
    const back = line.returnLineId === null ? undefined : returnLineOf(data, line.returnLineId);
    let share = '0';
    if (back !== undefined) {
      share = returnShare(data, back.line, line.baseQuantity);
      // Where the return put it: the receipt's warehouse, or the return's for a line on its own
      const receipt =
        back.line.receiptLineId === null ? undefined : receiptLineOf(data, back.line.receiptLineId);
      const warehouseId = receipt?.receipt.warehouseId ?? back.purchaseReturn.warehouseId;
      amounts.push(
        at(
          bookAccounts(data).use('received_not_billed'),
          negateMoney(share),
          branchOf(data, warehouseId) ?? draft.branchId,
        ),
      );
    }
    const difference = subtractMoney(line.net, share);
    if (!isZeroMoney(difference)) {
      amounts.push(at(priceDifferenceAccount(data), negateMoney(difference)));
    }
  }
  for (const expense of draft.expenses) {
    amounts.push(at(expense.accountId, negateMoney(expense.net)));
  }
  amounts.push(at(purposeAccount(data, 'vat_input'), negateMoney(draft.vat)));
  return amounts;
}

// The API's postAndLog(): the date, the bill, the supplier and the lines checked again (another
// debit note may have taken off the same lines), the number, the sums on the bill's lines and
// expenses, the entry, and its money applied to its own bill up to what the bill still owes; the
// rest is money the supplier owes the company (decision 4). Returns what it applied, for the audit
// row. The handler runs it in a transaction().
export function postDebitNote(data: WorkspaceData, draft: MockDebitNote): string {
  if (draft.status !== 'draft') throw conflict('purchase_not_draft');
  assertPeriodOpen(data, draft.date);
  const bill = draft.bill === null ? null : postedBill(data, draft.bill.id);
  // Active now: the journal will not book a payable line for an archived supplier
  supplierOf(data, draft.supplier.id, null);
  if (bill !== null) assertDebitDate(draft.date, bill);
  else assertBranch(data, draft.branchId);
  const keptRateIds = new Set(draft.lines.map((line) => line.taxRate.id));
  resolveDebitLines(
    data,
    draft.supplier.id,
    bill,
    draft.pricesIncludeVat,
    draft.lines.map(storedRefs),
    keptRateIds,
  );
  if (bill !== null) resolveDebitExpenses(bill, draft.expenses);
  data.purchase.counters.debitNote += 1;
  const number = seriesNumber(
    data,
    'purchase.debit_note',
    data.purchase.counters.debitNote,
    draft.date,
  );
  const amounts = isZeroMoney(draft.total) ? [] : debitNoteAmounts(data, draft, bill);

  // What it takes off, on the bill's lines and expenses. The return lines' debited quantity is
  // read from the posted debit notes, so it goes up with the status below.
  for (const line of draft.lines) {
    const billed = bill?.lines.find((item) => item.id === line.billLineId);
    if (billed) billed.debited = addMoney(billed.debited, line.total);
  }
  for (const expense of draft.expenses) {
    const billed = bill?.expenses.find((item) => item.id === expense.billExpenseId);
    if (billed) billed.debited = addMoney(billed.debited, expense.total);
  }

  // A debit note of ৳0 has no entry
  let entry: EntryRef | null = null;
  if (amounts.length > 0) {
    entry = refOf(
      postNew(
        data,
        { date: draft.date, narration: `Debit note ${number}`, lines: summed(amounts) },
        'purchase_debit_note',
        { id: draft.id, number },
      ),
    );
  }
  // Read before the change: what the bill still owes
  const due = bill === null ? '0' : dueOn(data, bill);
  Object.assign(draft, {
    status: 'posted',
    number,
    entry,
    postedAt: now(),
    version: draft.version + 1,
    updatedAt: now(),
  });
  const applied = compareMoney(draft.total, due) <= 0 ? draft.total : due;
  if (bill !== null && compareMoney(applied, '0') > 0) {
    applyDebitAllocations(data, draft, [{ billId: bill.id, amount: applied }]);
  }
  return applied;
}

// A draft has no money to apply yet: before the version check, like the API's lockPosted()
export function assertDebitNotePosted(debitNote: MockDebitNote): void {
  if (debitNote.status !== 'posted') throw conflict('debit_note_not_posted');
}

// Apply its money again, like a supplier payment's. What refunds paid back is gone: only the rest
// can be applied.
export function allocateDebitNote(
  data: WorkspaceData,
  debitNote: MockDebitNote,
  allocations: readonly MockBillAllocation[],
): void {
  const left = subtractMoney(debitNote.total, refundedFrom(data, 'debit_note', debitNote.id));
  if (overAllocated(left, allocations)) {
    throw fieldProblem('debit_note_over_allocated', 'allocations');
  }
  applyDebitAllocations(data, debitNote, allocations);
  Object.assign(debitNote, { version: debitNote.version + 1, updatedAt: now() });
}
```

- **`debitNoteAmounts()` is decision 1:** Dr accounts payable (the supplier) for the total; for a goods line, Cr goods
  received not billed for the return line's share (at the branch where the return put it back) and the rest of its
  net on the price difference account, a debit when the share is more than the net; Cr a service line's or an
  expense's account; Cr VAT input. A price cut has no return line, so its whole net is a price difference.
- **The amounts are worked out before anything changes:** `returnShare()` reads what was debited from the return line
  so far, and the posting is about to add this debit note to it.
- **Its money goes on its own bill first, up to what the bill still owes** (decision 4), read before the posting
  changes it. The rest, and all of a debit note without a bill, is money the supplier owes the company.

```ts
// --- Supplier refunds ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function findSupplierRefund(data: WorkspaceData, id: string): SupplierRefund {
  const found = data.purchase.refunds.find((item) => item.id === id);
  if (!found) throw new MockProblem(404, 'not_found');
  return found;
}

export function listSupplierRefunds(
  data: WorkspaceData,
  query: { status?: SupplierRefundStatus | undefined; supplierId?: string | undefined },
): SupplierRefund[] {
  return newestFirst(data.purchase.refunds).filter(
    (item) =>
      (query.status === undefined || item.status === query.status) &&
      (query.supplierId === undefined || item.supplier.id === query.supplierId),
  );
}

// The debit note or payment the money comes from: posted, and this supplier's, with what it has
// left to give back. Another supplier's, a voided payment and a draft debit note all get the same
// answer, under the box that named it.
function sourceOf(data: WorkspaceData, supplierId: string, input: SupplierRefundInput) {
  if (input.debitNoteId !== null) {
    const debitNote = data.purchase.debitNotes.find((item) => item.id === input.debitNoteId);
    const number = debitNote?.number ?? null;
    if (debitNote?.supplier.id !== supplierId || debitNote.status !== 'posted' || number === null) {
      throw fieldProblem('supplier_refund_source_invalid', 'debitNoteId');
    }
    const money = toDebitNote(data, debitNote);
    return {
      source: { type: 'debit_note', id: debitNote.id, number } as const,
      left: unappliedOf({ amount: money.total, applied: money.applied, refunded: money.refunded }),
    };
  }
  if (input.paymentId !== null) {
    const payment = data.purchase.payments.find((item) => item.id === input.paymentId);
    const number = payment?.number ?? null;
    if (payment?.supplier.id !== supplierId || payment.status !== 'posted' || number === null) {
      throw fieldProblem('supplier_refund_source_invalid', 'paymentId');
    }
    return {
      source: { type: 'supplier_payment', id: payment.id, number } as const,
      left: unappliedPaymentOf(paymentSummaryOf(data, payment)),
    };
  }
  // The contract makes sure one of the two is there
  throw fieldProblem('supplier_refund_source', 'debitNoteId');
}

// Saved = posted: numbered and booked (Dr the money account / Cr Accounts payable with the
// supplier). The source's `refunded` is worked out on read, so it goes up with the refund.
export function createSupplierRefund(
  data: WorkspaceData,
  input: SupplierRefundInput,
): SupplierRefund {
  const supplier = supplierOf(data, input.supplierId, null);
  assertBranch(data, input.branchId);
  if (!moneyAccountIds(data.accounts).has(input.accountId)) {
    throw fieldProblem('supplier_refund_account_invalid', 'accountId');
  }
  const { source, left } = sourceOf(data, supplier.id, input);
  const amount = addMoney(input.amount, '0');
  if (compareMoney(amount, left) > 0) throw fieldProblem('supplier_refund_over_source', 'amount');
  data.purchase.counters.refund += 1;
  const number = seriesNumber(data, 'purchase.refund', data.purchase.counters.refund, input.date);
  const id = crypto.randomUUID();
  const entry = postNew(
    data,
    {
      date: input.date,
      narration: `Supplier refund ${number}`,
      lines: [
        side(input.accountId, input.branchId, null, { debit: amount }),
        side(purposeAccount(data, 'accounts_payable'), input.branchId, supplier.id, {
          credit: amount,
        }),
      ],
    },
    'purchase_refund',
    { id, number },
  );
  const refund: SupplierRefund = {
    id,
    number,
    date: input.date,
    supplier,
    amount,
    method: input.method,
    reference: input.reference,
    accountId: input.accountId,
    branchId: input.branchId,
    source,
    status: 'posted',
    version: 1,
    updatedAt: now(),
    note: input.note,
    entry: refOf(entry),
    voidEntry: null,
    voidDate: null,
    voidReason: null,
  };
  data.purchase.refunds = [refund, ...data.purchase.refunds];
  return refund;
}

// A voided refund is final: before the version check, like the API's lock()
export function assertSupplierRefundNotVoided(refund: SupplierRefund): void {
  if (refund.status === 'voided') throw conflict('supplier_refund_voided');
}

// Money that never came: the entry is reversed on the void date, and the money is the source's
// again (worked out on read). The refund stays, with its number.
export function voidSupplierRefund(
  data: WorkspaceData,
  refund: SupplierRefund,
  input: { date: string; reason: string },
): void {
  if (input.date < refund.date) throw fieldProblem('payment_void_date', 'date');
  const reversal = reverseEntry(data, findEntry(data, refund.entry.id), input.date, {
    allowPurchase: true,
    narration: `Supplier refund ${refund.number} voided: ${input.reason}`,
  });
  Object.assign(refund, {
    status: 'voided',
    voidDate: input.date,
    voidReason: input.reason,
    voidEntry: refOf(reversal),
    version: refund.version + 1,
    updatedAt: now(),
  });
}
```

- **`sourceOf()` takes back from one place:** a posted debit note or a posted payment of this supplier, up to what is
  left on it (`unappliedOf()`). Another supplier's, a draft and a voided one all get the same answer, under the box
  that named it.
- **Saved = posted:** a refund is numbered and booked at once, Dr the money account / Cr accounts payable (the
  supplier). The source's `refunded` is worked out on read, so it goes up with the refund and down with its void.
- **A void reverses the entry with `allowPurchase`,** the way a payment's void does: the Reverse button refuses a
  refund's entry (`journal_is_purchase`).

```diff
+    const query = readQuery(routes.supplierRefunds.list.query, request);
+    return reply(routes.supplierRefunds.list, pageOf(listSupplierRefunds(current(), query), query));
+  }),
+
+  mock(
+    routes.supplierRefunds.get,
+    guarded(({ params }) => {
+      const { id } = routes.supplierRefunds.get.params.parse(params);
+      return reply(routes.supplierRefunds.get, findSupplierRefund(current(), id));
+    }),
+  ),
+
+  mock(
+    routes.supplierRefunds.create,
+    guarded(async ({ request }) => {
+      const body = await readBody(routes.supplierRefunds.create.body, request);
+      const data = current();
+      const saved = transaction(data, () => {
+        const refund = createSupplierRefund(data, body);
+        record(
+          data,
+          'supplier_refund.created',
+          'supplier_refund',
+          refund.id,
+          diff(
+            {},
+            {
+              number: refund.number,
+              amount: refund.amount,
+              source: refund.source.number,
+              entry: refund.entry.number,
+            },
+          ),
+        );
+        return refund;
+      });
+      await delay();
+      return reply(routes.supplierRefunds.create, saved);
+    }),
+  ),
+
+  mock(
+    routes.supplierRefunds.void,
+    guarded(async ({ request, params }) => {
+      const { id } = routes.supplierRefunds.void.params.parse(params);
+      const { version, ...input } = await readBody(routes.supplierRefunds.void.body, request);
+      const data = current();
+      const target = findSupplierRefund(data, id);
+      assertSupplierRefundNotVoided(target);
+      checkVersion(target.version, version);
+      transaction(data, () => {
+        voidSupplierRefund(data, target, input);
+        record(
+          data,
+          'supplier_refund.voided',
+          'supplier_refund',
+          id,
+          diff(
+            {},
+            { date: input.date, reason: input.reason, reversal: target.voidEntry?.number ?? null },
+          ),
+        );
+      });
+      await delay();
+      return reply(routes.supplierRefunds.void, target);
+    }),
+  ),
+
   mock(routes.purchaseAccounts.get, () =>
     reply(routes.purchaseAccounts.get, current().purchaseAccounts),
   ),
```

- **Every route of `routes.purchaseReturns`, `routes.debitNotes` and `routes.supplierRefunds`,** each reading its
  body with the contract's schema and answering with the contract's response, like every mock route.
- **A save that also posts runs in one `transaction()`,** like the API and like 15d's returns: a refused posting
  leaves no new draft behind, and an old draft as it was. A refund's save and a void are one `transaction()` each.
- **"Apply money" checks the status before the version,** like 15d's credit note: a draft has no money to apply,
  and that answer says more than "someone changed it".

### The end-to-end tests: `e2e/purchase-returns.e2e.ts` (new)

```ts
import { expect, type Page, test } from '@playwright/test';

import { expectNoSideScroll, listItem, openFromNav, toastShown } from './helpers.js';

// Step 17d in the mock garments workspace, where the signed-in person is the Owner. 17b's
// PO-…-0001 orders 1,000 gross of shirt buttons from Unitex at ৳62 a gross before VAT (15%);
// nothing came in yet. The Main store holds 7,200 buttons from before Omnivo, at ৳0.45 each.
// Bills below ৳1,00,000 post at once. The mock seeds no return, debit note or refund.
//
// Most tests write three or four documents, more on a phone-sized page: test.slow() gives them
// three times the usual 30 seconds, so a busy machine does not fail them half-way (15d's rule).

const number = (prefix: string) => (value: number) =>
  new RegExp(`${prefix}-\\d{4}-\\d{2}-${String(value).padStart(4, '0')}`);
const BILL = number('BILL');
const DN = number('DN');
const GRN = number('GRN');
const PO = number('PO');
const PRN = number('PRN');
const PV = number('PV');
const SRF = number('SRF');

test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/');
});

const line = (page: Page, value: number) =>
  page.getByRole('group', { name: `Line ${String(value)}` });

async function openOrder(page: Page) {
  await openFromNav(page, 'Purchase orders');
  await listItem(page, PO(1)).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: PO(1) })).toBeVisible();
}

// GRN-…-0001: 600 of PO-…-0001's 1,000 gross, booked at ৳62 a gross (৳37,200)
async function receiveButtons(page: Page) {
  await openOrder(page);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Receive goods' }).click();
  await line(page, 1).getByLabel('Accepted').fill('600');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Post goods receipt' }).click();
  await toastShown(page, /^GRN-\d{4}-\d{2}-0001 posted$/);
}

// BILL-…-0002 (the seed's waiting bill is 0001): the receipt billed at the order's price,
// 600 × ৳62 = ৳37,200 + 15% VAT = ৳42,780
async function billTheButtons(page: Page) {
  await receiveButtons(page);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Make bill' }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: 'New supplier bill' })).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByLabel('Branch').selectOption({ label: 'Head office' });
  await page.getByLabel(/^Supplier’s bill number/).fill('UT-INV-0921');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Post bill' }).click();
  await toastShown(page, /^BILL-\d{4}-\d{2}-0002 posted$/);
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: BILL(2) })).toBeVisible();
}

// PRN-…-0001: 100 gross go back from GRN-…-0001, opened from the receipt's page
async function sendHundredBack(page: Page) {
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send goods back' }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: 'New purchase return' })).toBeVisible();
  await line(page, 1).getByLabel('Quantity').fill('100');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Post return' }).click();
  await toastShown(page, /^PRN-\d{4}-\d{2}-0001 posted$/);
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: PRN(1) })).toBeVisible();
}
```

- **The tests start from 17b's order:** 1,000 gross of buttons at ৳62, nothing received. `receiveButtons()` posts
  GRN-…-0001 for 600 gross, `billTheButtons()` bills it (BILL-…-0002: the seed's waiting bill is 0001), and
  `sendHundredBack()` sends 100 gross back from the receipt's page.
- **`test.slow()`:** most tests write three or four documents, more on a phone-sized page, so they get three times
  the usual 30 seconds, 15d's rule. On a busy machine (the load average was above 100 while this was written) two of
  them ran out of time on the phone without it.

```ts
test('sends goods back before the bill, and the bill bills the rest', async ({ page }) => {
  test.slow();
  await receiveButtons(page);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send goods back' }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: 'New purchase return' })).toBeVisible();
  // Every line the receipt kept, from its own warehouse; what is left is in the base unit
  await expect(line(page, 1).getByText(/^From GRN-\d{4}-\d{2}-0001/)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(line(page, 1).getByText('86,400 pcs can still go back')).toBeVisible();
  await expectNoSideScroll(page);
  await line(page, 1).getByLabel('Quantity').fill('100');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Post return' }).click();
  await toastShown(page, /^PRN-\d{4}-\d{2}-0001 posted$/);

  // At the receipt's cost, ৳62 a gross; not billed yet, so no debit note is needed
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: PRN(1) })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText('৳6,200.00').first()).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText('Not billed yet: the bill bills less')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Write debit note' })).toHaveCount(0);
  // The goods-out slip is in the page for the browser's Print
  const sheet = page.locator('[data-print-sheet]');
  await expect(sheet).toBeHidden();
  await expect(sheet).toContainText('Purchase return');
  await expect(sheet).toContainText('Unitex Trims & Accessories');
  await expectNoSideScroll(page);

  // The receipt says what went back, and its bill bills the 500 gross that stayed
  await page
    .getByRole('link', { name: GRN(1) })
    .first()
    .click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: GRN(1) })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText('Partly returned').first()).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: PRN(1) })).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Make bill' }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: 'New supplier bill' })).toBeVisible();
  // In gross, as it came: 500 is a whole number of them, so the price stays the order's
  await expect(line(page, 1).getByText(/^86,400 pcs went back before billing/)).toBeHidden();
  await expect(line(page, 1).getByText(/^14,400 pcs went back before billing/)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(line(page, 1)).toContainText(/Unit\s*gross\s*Quantity\s*500/);
  await page.getByLabel('Branch').selectOption({ label: 'Head office' });
  await page.getByLabel(/^Supplier’s bill number/).fill('UT-INV-0921');
  // 500 × ৳62 = ৳31,000 + 15% VAT = ৳35,650, at the order's price: no difference
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Post bill' }).click();
  await toastShown(page, /^BILL-\d{4}-\d{2}-0002 posted$/);
  await expect(page.getByText('৳35,650.00').first()).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText(/^The prices differ from the orders/)).toBeHidden();
});
```

- **A return before the bill** leaves at ৳62 a gross (৳6,200), says "Not billed yet: the bill bills less", offers no
  debit note, and prints a goods-out slip. The receipt is "Partly returned" and names the return.
- **Its bill bills the 500 gross left, in gross,** with "14,400 pcs went back before billing" under it, and posts at
  ৳35,650 with no price difference. This is the check that found the rounding of decision 40.

```ts
test('debits goods sent back after the bill, and the money comes off it', async ({ page }) => {
  test.slow();
  await billTheButtons(page);
  await page.getByRole('link', { name: GRN(1) }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: GRN(1) })).toBeVisible();
  await sendHundredBack(page);
  // Billed already: a debit note takes the money off
  await expect(page.getByText(/^Billed on BILL-\d{4}-\d{2}-0002/)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText(/^Some of these goods were billed already/)).toBeVisible();

  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Write debit note' }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: 'New debit note' })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(line(page, 1).getByText(/^Goods sent back on PRN-\d{4}-\d{2}-0001/)).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByLabel(/^Supplier’s credit note/).fill('UT-CN-0112');
  await expectNoSideScroll(page);
  // 100 × ৳62 = ৳6,200 + 15% VAT = ৳7,130
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Post debit note' }).click();
  await toastShown(page, /^DN-\d{4}-\d{2}-0001 posted$/);
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: DN(1) })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText('৳7,130.00').first()).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText('UT-CN-0112').first()).toBeVisible();
  const sheet = page.locator('[data-print-sheet]');
  await expect(sheet).toContainText('Debit note');
  await expect(sheet).toContainText('UT-INV-0921');

  // Dr Accounts payable ৳7,130 / Cr Goods received not billed ৳6,200 / Cr VAT input ৳930
  await page.getByRole('link', { name: /^JV-/ }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText('৳6,200.00').first()).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText('৳930.00').first()).toBeVisible();

  // The bill: ৳7,130 settled by the debit note, the rest still owed
  await openFromNav(page, 'Supplier bills');
  await listItem(page, BILL(2)).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: BILL(2) })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText('Partly debited').first()).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText('Partly paid').first()).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: DN(1) })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Debit whole bill' })).toHaveCount(0);
  await expectNoSideScroll(page);
});
```

- **A return after the bill** says "Billed on BILL-…" and offers "Write debit note", which starts with the bill and
  the returned goods at the bill's price. The debit note (৳7,130) keeps the supplier's credit note number, prints
  the supplier's bill number, and books Dr payable / Cr goods received not billed ৳6,200 / Cr VAT input ৳930.
- **The bill is "Partly debited" and "Partly paid":** money a debit note took off settles a bill like money paid.
  "Debit whole bill" is gone once a debit note was posted for it (`canDebitWhole()`).

```ts
test('debits a whole bill in one click', async ({ page }) => {
  test.slow();
  await billTheButtons(page);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Debit whole bill' }).click();
  await toastShown(page, /^Draft debit note written for every line and expense/);

  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Post debit note' }).click();
  await toastShown(page, /^DN-\d{4}-\d{2}-0001 posted$/);
  await expect(page.getByText('৳42,780.00').first()).toBeVisible();

  // Nothing is owed on it any more, and it says why
  await page
    .getByRole('link', { name: BILL(2) })
    .first()
    .click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: BILL(2) })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText('Debited', { exact: true }).first()).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText('Paid', { exact: true }).first()).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Pay bill' })).toBeHidden();
});
```

- **"Debit whole bill"** writes a draft with every line and expense; posted, the bill is "Debited" and "Paid", and
  "Pay bill" is gone.

```ts
test('records an advance the supplier paid back, and voids it', async ({ page }) => {
  test.slow();
  await openOrder(page);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Pay advance' }).click();
  await page.getByLabel('Amount', { exact: true }).fill('20000');
  await page.getByLabel('Paid from').selectOption({ label: '1110 · Cash in hand' });
  await page.getByLabel('Paid by').selectOption({ label: 'Cash' });
  await page.getByLabel('Branch').selectOption({ label: 'Head office' });
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Post payment' }).click();
  await toastShown(page, /^PV-\d{4}-\d{2}-0001 posted$/);

  // Unitex cannot make the rest: ৳5,000 of the advance comes back by bank transfer
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Record money back' }).click();
  await expect(
    page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: 'Record money a supplier paid back' }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByLabel('Amount', { exact: true }).fill('5000');
  await page
    .getByLabel('Received into')
    .selectOption({ label: '1121 · Dutch-Bangla Bank CD A/C 1234' });
  await page.getByLabel('Paid by').selectOption({ label: 'Bank transfer' });
  await page.getByLabel('Branch').selectOption({ label: 'Head office' });
  await expectNoSideScroll(page);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save refund' }).click();
  await toastShown(page, /^SRF-\d{4}-\d{2}-0001 saved$/);
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: SRF(1) })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: /^JV-/ })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator('[data-print-sheet]')).toContainText('Supplier refund');

  // The payment: ৳15,000 left, and it cannot be voided while the refund stands
  await page.getByRole('link', { name: PV(1) }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: PV(1) })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText(/^৳15,000\.00 is not applied to a bill yet/)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Void payment' })).toBeHidden();

  // The transfer bounced: the refund is voided, and the payment may be voided again
  await openFromNav(page, 'Supplier refunds');
  await expect(listItem(page, SRF(1))).toContainText(PV(1));
  await listItem(page, SRF(1)).click();
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Void refund' }).click();
  const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: SRF(1) });
  await dialog.getByLabel('Reason').fill('Their transfer was returned by the bank');
  await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Void refund' }).click();
  await toastShown(page, /^SRF-\d{4}-\d{2}-0001 voided$/);
  await expect(page.getByText(/^Voided on .*: Their transfer was returned/)).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole('link', { name: PV(1) }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText(/^৳20,000\.00 is not applied to a bill yet/)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Void payment' })).toBeVisible();
});
```

- **An advance the supplier paid back:** "Record money back" on the payment starts the refund with the payment as
  its source. Afterwards the payment has ৳15,000 left and no "Void payment"; voiding the refund gives the ৳20,000
  back to the payment and brings "Void payment" back.
- **The refund is opened from the Supplier refunds list,** which names its payment: the payment's page shows how much
  was paid back, not a link to each refund.

```ts
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: 'New debit note' })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByLabel('Bill').locator('option:checked')).toHaveText(

  await page.getByLabel('Branch').selectOption({ label: 'Head office' });
  // The supplier's credit note says ৳60 a gross, 15% VAT
  await expect(line(page, 1).getByText(/^Goods sent back on PRN-\d{4}-\d{2}-0001/)).toBeVisible();
  await line(page, 1).getByLabel('Price before VAT').fill('60');

  await expectNoSideScroll(page);

  await toastShown(page, /^DN-\d{4}-\d{2}-0001 posted$/);

  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: DN(1) })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText('৳690.00').first()).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText(/^৳690\.00 is not applied to a bill yet/)).toBeVisible();
  // Dr Accounts payable ৳690 / Cr Goods received not billed ৳648 / Dr price difference ৳48 /
  // Cr VAT input ৳90
  await page.getByRole('link', { name: /^JV-/ }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText('৳648.00').first()).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText('৳48.00').first()).toBeVisible();
});
```

- **Decision 9, end to end:** 10 gross of the buttons that were in the Main store before Omnivo go back on their own
  line, at the average cost (৳0.45 a piece, ৳648). "Write debit note" starts a debit note with no bill; the person
  picks the branch and types the supplier's ৳60 a gross and 15% VAT. Its ৳690 is money the supplier owes, and the
  entry has a debit of ৳48 on the price difference: the supplier credits less than the goods cost.

- **`openFromNav()` takes a regular expression too.** A string is a part match, Playwright's default, and the
  sidebar's "Supplier refunds" (17d.6) holds "Refunds", so 15d's test found two links and failed. The match is not
  made exact for every test: a nav item with a count, like Approvals, has the count in its name.

```bash
pnpm --filter @omnivo/app exec playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
```

Build the three packages first: the app reads their `dist/`. The last command runs every e2e test, on a desktop and
on a phone; on a busy machine run it with `--workers=4`.

## 17d.8 — Role templates, the OpenAPI document, and every check once

### `setup/templates.ts`: who sends goods back, who debits, who takes money back

The role templates give a new workspace its roles (step 8). Each module's step adds its permissions to them; 15d's
notes ask every step to check this file when it adds a permission. Nothing fails if you forget: a new workspace
simply gives nobody but the owner the right to send goods back. So this part does it on purpose (decision 50):

```diff
@@ -153,6 +153,15 @@ const RECEIVING = ['purchase.receipt.manage'] as const;
 // approval levels (Settings → Approvals) decide who lets a bill or a payment through.
 const BILLING = ['purchase.bill.manage'] as const;
 const PAYING = ['purchase.payment.manage'] as const;
+// Step 17d. Goods that go back to a supplier are loaded by the people who took them in at the gate
+// (the goods receipt's people): a purchase return moves stock, not money. A debit note lowers what
+// the company owes a supplier and the VAT it claims, so it is the accountant's, next to the bills:
+// the person who signed the goods in does not also write down what the company owes for them. A
+// supplier refund is money a supplier pays back against the payable: the accountant's too, next to
+// the payments.
+const SENDING_BACK = ['purchase.return.manage'] as const;
+const DEBITING = ['purchase.debit_note.manage'] as const;
+const TAKING_REFUNDS = ['purchase.refund.manage'] as const;
 
 // Some roles have few permissions today because the modules they will use (stock, sales) do not
 // exist yet. Each of those steps adds its permissions to these templates for new workspaces.
@@ -184,6 +193,9 @@ const ACCOUNTANT: RoleTemplate = {

+    // Step 17d: debit notes and the money suppliers pay back

+    ...TAKING_REFUNDS,
   ],
 };
 
@@ -200,6 +212,7 @@ const STORE_KEEPER: RoleTemplate = {
     ...RETURNING,
     ...REQUESTING,
     ...RECEIVING,
+    ...SENDING_BACK,
   ],
 };
 
@@ -494,6 +507,7 @@ export const INDUSTRY_TEMPLATES = {
           ...RETURNING,
           ...REQUESTING,
           ...RECEIVING,
+          ...SENDING_BACK,
         ],
       },
       {
@@ -568,6 +582,7 @@ export const INDUSTRY_TEMPLATES = {
           ...RETURNING,
           ...REQUESTING,
           ...RECEIVING,
+          ...SENDING_BACK,
         ],
       },

@@ -686,8 +701,11 @@ export const INDUSTRY_TEMPLATES = {

@@ -747,8 +765,11 @@ export const INDUSTRY_TEMPLATES = {

```

- **Three groups, named like 17b's and 17c's** (`BUYING`, `RECEIVING`, `BILLING`, `PAYING`): `SENDING_BACK`,
  `DEBITING` and `TAKING_REFUNDS`. A role lists groups, not keys, so the next role that needs one of them cannot
  pick half of it.
- **`SENDING_BACK` goes wherever `RECEIVING` is:** the store keeper, both depot managers, a shop's manager and the
  "other" manager. The person who signed the goods in at the gate is the one who loads them back on the truck, and
  a return moves stock, not money.
- **`DEBITING` and `TAKING_REFUNDS` go wherever `BILLING` and `PAYING` are:** the accountant and the two managers
  who run everything. A debit note lowers what the company owes and the VAT it claims, so it sits with the bills;
  a refund is money a supplier pays back against the payable, so it sits with the payments. The store keeper gets
  neither: the person who sends goods back does not also decide how much money comes off for them.

The setup test lists every template permission of the garments roles, so it learns the three keys (in their sorted
places):

```diff

           'inventory.stock.revalue',
           'inventory.stock.value',
           'purchase.bill.manage',
+          'purchase.debit_note.manage',
           'purchase.payment.manage',
+          'purchase.refund.manage',
           'purchase.supplier.balance',
           'purchase.supplier.manage',
           'sales.credit_note.manage',
@@ -175,6 +177,7 @@ describe('starting the setup', () => {
           'inventory.stock.transfer',
           'purchase.receipt.manage',
           'purchase.requisition.manage',
+          'purchase.return.manage',

           'sales.return.manage',
         ],
```

As in 15d and 17c, this changes **new** workspaces only. Your existing roles keep what they have; tick the new
permissions on the Roles page (17d.10).

### The OpenAPI document

No root file changes: no new package, no new script, no new `.env` line. Generate the API document again and
commit it:

```bash
pnpm gen:openapi      # packages/contracts/openapi.json — 206 paths (196 before)
```

The 10 new paths:

- **Purchase returns:** `/purchase-returns` (list and create), `/purchase-returns/{id}` (read, change, delete) and
  `/purchase-returns/{id}/post`.
- **Debit notes:** `/debit-notes` (list and create), `/debit-notes/{id}` (read, change, delete),
  `/debit-notes/{id}/post` and `/debit-notes/{id}/allocations` (apply a posted debit note's money again).
- **Supplier refunds:** `/supplier-refunds` (list and create), `/supplier-refunds/{id}` (read) and
  `/supplier-refunds/{id}/void`.

A list and its POST share one path, and so do a read, a change and a delete, so 17 routes make these 10 paths.
"Debit whole bill" has no route of its own: the app writes the lines with `wholeBillDebit()` and creates the draft
with the usual POST (decision 45). Older paths changed their shape without a new path: the goods receipts
(`returnState`, `returns`, a line's `returnedQuantity`, the `return=returnable` filter), the bills (`amountDebited`,
`debitNoteTotal`, `debitNotes`, `openDebitNotes`, a line's and an expense's `debited`), the supplier payments
(`refunded`), the number series (the three new document types), the audit log (the three entity types) and the
roles (the three permissions). The purchase orders' shape did not change: their received quantity only means less
after a return. `pnpm test:openapi` fails if the committed file and the routes disagree.

The Drizzle snapshots (`migrations/meta/0041_snapshot.json`, `0042_snapshot.json`, `_journal.json`) are written by
`drizzle-kit generate`; commit them as they are.

### Every check once

Then run the whole checklist (at the end of this guide) once. Each part ran only its own package's checks; this is
the first time everything runs together.

Every check passed. The integration and tenant-leak suites ran with `--maxWorkers=3` (`cd apps/api && npx vitest
run .int.spec --maxWorkers=3`), because at full speed this Mac's Docker misses the test containers' start-up time.

The first integration run had two failures, both in 17d.4's file: the test of a bill and a return of one receipt
line at the same moment, and the books test after it, which counts what that test posted. The code was right; the
test expected an order that Postgres does not promise ("What we found on the way"). 17d.4's file in this guide is
the fixed one: the race test holds the journal's number counter now, not the receipt line. It passed 8 runs in 8
(the old one failed 3 in 6), the whole file passed twice, and so did the whole suite, 483 tests. (A second full run,
while the machine was swapping, had 6 files time out in their start-up hook with no test failing; run again with 2
workers, they passed.)

The end-to-end suite ran 258 tests in 9 minutes on 4 workers, and every one passed the first time. 17d.7's run of
the same tests, on a machine that was swapping, had 34 time out.

If a test times out on your machine, run
`pnpm --filter @omnivo/app exec playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts --last-failed --workers=2` before
looking for a bug.
